With imp. (or infin. as imp.) in command, challenge, entreaty, remonstrance, persuasion, encouragement, indignation, etc., nay but, come now ! ἴθι Il. 1.32, πίθεσθε Il. 1.259. Cf. Il. 1.393, Il. 1.508, Il. 1.565, Il. 2.163, 360, etc.: μένʼ αὖθι Od. 2.369, ὧδʼ ἔρδειν Od. 6.258. Cf. Od. 3.323, 380, Od. 4.28, 35, 379, etc.
Sim. with subj.: ἴομεν Il. 6.526, etc.: φραζώμεσθα Od. 2.167, φθεγγώμεθα Od. 10.228, etc.
With opt.: ἐπιτρέψειας ἕκαστα δμῳάων ἥ τις . . . Od. 15.24.
To pick up, gather up: ὀστέα Il. 21.321, Il. 23.253.

div.head: b
div.p: ἄλλος ἀ., one in one quarter, one in another Od. 8.516.

div.head: a
div.p: Elsewhither, in another direction Il. 1.120, Il. 5.187, Il. 15.464, Il. 21.557: Od. 2.127 = Od. 18.288, Od. 17.478.

div.head: b
div.p: In a direction other than the right: ἀ. ἀποκλίναντα (wresting the meaning) Od. 19.556.

div.head: c
div.p: ἄλλυδις ἀ., some or part in this direction, some or part in another Od. 5.369, Od. 9.458, Od. 11.385.

div.head: b
div.p: ἄλλυδις ἀ.: τρέπεται χρὼς ἄλλυδις ἀ. (now to one hue, now to another) Il. 13.279.
Unceasing, never still: ἄη νότος Od. 12.325.
In neut. ἄλληκτον as adv, without intermission or pause: πολεμίζειν Il. 2.452 = Il. 11.12 = Il. 14.152.

One another, each other: ἀλλήλοισι κέλευον Il. 2.151. Cf. Il. 3.9, 15, 115, 155, Il. 4.449, 472, 536, etc.: ξεῖνοι ἀλλήλων Od. 1.187. Cf. Od. 1.209, Od. 2.149, Od. 4.620, Od. 5.79, Od. 6.211, Od. 9.55, etc.
App., known to be other; hence, strange, foreign: δήμῳ Od. 2.366.
Absol., a foreigner or alien Il. 3.48, Il. 16.550: Od. 3.74 = Od. 9.255.
Of another, i. e. of strange, appearance: ἀλλοειδέα φαινέσκετο πάντα Od. 13.194 (ἀ. to be scanned in three long syllables; v. l. ἀλλοειδέʼ ἐφαίνετο).

div.head: a
div.p: From another place or source, from elsewhere: ἵνα μή ποθεν ἀ. αὕῃ Od. 5.490, καλεῖ ἀ. Od. 17.382.

div.head: b
div.p: ἀ. ἄλλος, some or one from one side or quarter, some or one from anotherIl. 2.75, Il. 9.311, 671, Il. 13.551: Od. 9.401, 493 = Od. 10.442, Od. 10.119, Od. 11.42, Od. 4.231, Od. 24.415.
Sim. νείκεον ἀ. ἄλλον, one beginning with one man, one with anotherOd. 12.392.
From another or strange land, from abroad: εἰλήλουθεν Od. 3.318. Cf. Od. 6.283, Od. 7.33, 52, Od. 16.26, Od. 17.112, Od. 20.360.
In another place, elsewhere Od. 4.684, Od. 16.44, Od. 18.401.
On his part, he too: κλαῖεν Od. 21.83.

div.head: a
div.p: In another or strange land, abroad: ἐπὴν ἀ. ὄληται Od. 14.130.–ἀ. γαίης, elsewhere in the world, somewhere abroadOd. 2.131.

div.head: b
div.p: App., with genit., elsewhere away from (one's home): ἀ. πάτρης (i.e. in some strange land) Od. 17.318.
Speaking a strange tongue, foreign, alien Od. 1.183, Od. 3.302, Od. 14.43, Od. 15.453.
Of another sort or kind: ἔργῳ Il. 4.258: ἀ. φάνης Od. 16.181, ἄνδρα Od. 19.265.
3 sing. subj. ἅληται Il. 21.536. ἅλεται Il. 11.192, 207. (ἀνεφ-, ἐκκατεφ-, ἐξ-, ἐσ-, ἐφ-, καθ-, κατεφ-, μεθ-, ὑπερ-.)
Of an inanimate object: ἆλτʼ ὀϊστός Il. 4.125.
One thing to one person, another to another, doublefaced Il. 5.831, 889.
-η, -ο. Crasis with τά gives τἆλλα Il. 1.465, Il. 2.428: Od. 3.462, Od. 12.365.

div.head: a
div.p: Another or additional person or thing: ἄλλο τοι ἐρέω Il. 1.297, οἴσομεν ἄλλον Il. 3.104. Cf. Il. 10.146, Il. 11.663, Il. 14.262, etc.: Od. 11.454, Od. 12.65, etc.
In apposition: ἄλλο τό γε οἶδα Od. 16.470.

div.head: α
div.p: Another or different person or thing, another, someone or something else: ἐγὼ ἢ ἄλλος Ἀχαιῶν Il. 2.231, πείθεόο τʼ ἄλλῳ Il. 2.360. Cf. Il. 2.271, Il. 9.101, Il. 11.410, Il. 13.229, Il. 19.181 (in the case of another matter, i.e. for the future), Il. 24.46, etc.: ἄλλος εἴπεσκε νέων Od. 2.331, μεῖζον ἄλλο φράζονται Od. 4.698. Cf. Od. 3.94, Od. 4.29, Od. 8.202, Od. 11.176, Od. 13.205, Od. 17.404, etc.
With τις: ὡς ὄφελέν τις ἀνδρῶν ἄλλος ἔχειν Il. 4.316. Cf. Il. 13.272, Il. 14.90, etc.: ἄλλο τί τοι μελέτω Od. 7.208. Cf. Od. 14.461, Od. 18.334, Od. 20.297, etc.

Predicatively: ἄλλο τι τόδε μήδεαι (it is
some other thing that you are planning) Od. 5.173.
With τίς: τίς τοι ἄλλος ὁμοῖος; Il. 17.475. Cf. Il. 17.586.
With the article, the other: ἴἡ ἄλλη σῖτον ἔφερεν Od. 13.69.
With οὗτος and τις: ἄλλος τις οὗτος ἀνέστη Od. 20.380.

div.head: β
div.p: With the notion of difference obscured, someone.
With τις: μή ποτέ τις εἴπῃσι κακώτερος ἄλλος Il. 22.106: Od. 21.324.

div.head: γ
div.p: ἄλλο adverbially, app., in another matter Il. 14.249.–(τὸ) ἄλλο τόσον, for the rest to a certain extent, i.e. so farIl. 22.322, Il. 23.454.

div.head: α

p.gloss: Any other or additional person or thing.

div.p: With τις: οὐδέ τις ἄλλος ᾔδεεν Il. 18.403. Cf. Il. 23.592.

div.head: β
div.p: Another, any other or different person or thing, any one or anything else: οὐκ ἐθέλεσκες ἅμʼ ἄλλῳ ἰέναι Il. 9.486, εἴ με κελεύεις οἴκοθεν ἄλλʼ ἐπιδοῦναι Il. 23.558. Cf. Il. 14.244, Il. 16.141, Il. 23.274, etc.: οὐδέ κεν ἡμέας ἄλλο διέκρινεν (anything but death) Od. 4.179, etc.

With τις: οὔτε σοὶ οὔτε τῳ ἄλλῳ Il. 1.299, εἴ τευ ἐξ ἄλλου γένευ Il. 5.897. Cf. Il. 2.80, Il. 5.827, Il. 9.104, Il. 12.248, Il. 16.225, etc.: εἴ τίς μʼ ἄλλη ἤγγειλεν Od. 23.21. Cf. Od. 6.68, Od. 7.67, Od. 9.520, Od. 10.32, etc.
Interrog.: τί σευ ἄλλος ὀνήσεται; Il. 16.31. Cf. Od. 4.649.
With τις: πῶς κέν τίς σʼ ἄλλος ἵκοιτο; Od. 9.351.

div.head: γ
div.p: With the notion of difference obscured, any one, anything: οὐ σέο κύντερον ἄλλο Il. 8.483, οὐ δύναμαι γλυκερώτερον ἄλλο ἰδέσθαι Od. 9.28. Cf. Od. 11.427, Od. 15.343, 533, Od. 20.392.
With τις: οὔ τις σεῖο ὀλοώτερος ἄλλος Il. 3.365. Cf. Il. 15.569, Il. 19.321, Il. 23.439, 580: οὔ τι κύντερον ἄλλο Od. 7.216. Cf. Od. 8.32, 138, Od. 20.201, 376.

div.head: d
div.p: Every other, every one, any one, all: ὄφρα στυγέῃ ἄλλος Il. 1.186, ἄλλον κε σεῦ ἀπαλεξήσαιμι Il. 24.370, etc.: ὡς ἀπόλοιτο καὶ ἄλλος ὅτις . . . Od. 1.47, ἄλλῃ νεμεσῶ ἥ τις . . . Od. 6.286, etc.
With τις: ἵνα τις στυγέῃσιν ἄλλος Il. 8.515.

div.head: α
div.p: Another or additional: ἄλλον ὀϊστόν Il. 8.300. Cf. Il. 4.334, Il. 8.309, Il. 15.458, Il. 22.293, Il. 24.551: ἄλλην ὁδόν Od. 10.490, 563. Cf. Od. 15.449.
With τις: εἴ τίς μοι ἀνὴρ ἅμʼ ἕποιτο καὶ ἄλλος Il. 10.222. Cf. Od. 10.380, Od. 15.27.

div.head: β
div.p: Other, additional: μείζων κʼ ἄλλος χόλος ἐτύχθη (i.e. matters would have gone further) Il. 15.121.

div.head: γ
div.p: Besides, in addition: δόλον ἄλλον ὕφαινεν Il. 6.187. Cf. Il. 9.365: τέρας ἄλλο φανήτω Od. 20.101. Cf. Od. 2.93 Od. 24.128–With τις: σῆμʼ ἄλλο τι δείξω (εἴπω) Od. 21.217, Od. 23.73.

div.head: α
div.p: Another or different, some other: πρόμον Il. 7.116. Cf. Il. 3.226, Il. 7.358 = Il. 12.232, Il. 9.423, Il. 14.84, Il. 23.460: ῥάκος ἄλλο (other than his own raiment) Od. 13.434, Od. 14.342. Cf. Od. 3.243, Od. 10.392, Od. 11.127, Od. 15.518, Od. 16.9, Od. 22.6, Od. 23.186, 274.
With τις: μή τις Τρῶας ἐγείρῃσιν θεὸς ἄλλος Il. 10.511: δήμόν τι ἄλλο Od. 2.32, 44. Cf. Od. 13.325.

div.head: β
div.p: With a collective sb., the other, the rest of the . . . : λαόν Il. 11.189, etc.: δήμῳ Od. 2.239.

div.head: α
div.p: Any other or additional: υἱὸν οὐ τέκετʼ ἄλλον Il. 5.154. Cf. Il. 19.233.
With τις: μηδέ τις ἄλλος ἴτω ἀνήρ Il. 24.148 = 177. Cf. Il. 24.505: Od. 5.179 = Od. 10.344, Od. 5.187, Od. 10.300, Od. 4.48.
Interrogatively: ἦέ τινʼ ἄλλον ἀμύντορα μερμηρίξω Od. 16.261.

div.head: β
div.p: Any other or different: οὐ θεὸς ἄλλος ἀνῷγεν Il. 14.168. Cf. Il. 6.411, Il. 10.330, Il. 23.606: ἄλλος κʼ ἀνὴρ ἵετο . . . Od. 13.333. Cf. Od. 5.104 = 138, Od. 11.623, etc.
With τις: οὐδέ τις ἄλλος ἀνὴρ ἀνέτλη Od. 10.327. Cf. Od. 21.70, etc.

div.head: γ
div.p: With the notion of difference obscured, merely marking a contrast.
With τις: μή τί τοι ἄλλο κακὸν μελέτω ἔργον . . . ἀλλʼ ἐδθιέμεν Od. 2.303.
Any: οὐκ ἂν ἐρίσσειε βροτὸς ἄλλος Il. 3.223. Cf. Il. 2.248: Od. 15.69, 321.

div.head: d
div.p: Every: ὄφρʼ ἄλλος πρωχὸς ἀλεύεται ἠπεροπεύειν Od. 14.400.

div.head: a
div.p: Other or additional persons or things: εἴ ποθεν ἄλλα γένοιτο Il. 9.380. Cf. Il. 7.364, Il. 22.350, etc.: τρεῖς οἱ ἄλλοι ἔδαν Od. 2.21. Cf. Il. 7.364, Il. 22.350, etc.: τρεῖς οἱ ἄλλοι ἔσαν Od. 2.21. Cf. Od. 2.166, Od. 17.422, Od. 22.62, etc.

div.head: b
div.p: Other or different persons or things, others: πάῤ ἔμοιγε καὶ ἄλλοι Il. 1.174, ἄλλων μῦθον ἄκουε Il. 2.200. Cf. Il. 1.287, Il. 3.168, Il. 4.292, Il. 5.786, Il. 23.193, etc.: ἄλλα μεμήλει Od. 1.151. Cf. Od. 2.314, Od. 4.166, Od. 7.119, Od. 9.188, Od. 11.381, Od. 14.226, etc.
With the article: τὰ ἄλλα ἄγγελός ἐσσι (in other matters) Od. 5.29, τὰ ἄλλα μετάλλα Od. 19.115. Cf. Od. 15.540, Od. 17.273, Od. 23.209.

div.head: c
div.p: The other or different persons or things, the others: ἄτερ ἥμενον ἄλλων Il. 1.498, πρόσθʼ ἄλλων Il. 4.304. Cf. Il. 2.211, Il. 3.102, Il. 5.877, Il. 12.245, 285, etc.: ἄλλοι πάντες οἴκοι ἔσαν Od. 1.11. Cf. Od. 2.209, Od. 3.33, 58, Od. 8.93, Od. 9.172, etc.

With the article: τῶν ἄλλων οὔ τις ὁρᾶτο Il. 1.198. Cf. Il. 1.465, Il. 3.73, Il. 4.429, Il. 6.41, Il. 8.211, etc.: οἱ ἄλλοι ἀθρόοι ἦσαν Od. 1.26. Cf. Od. 3.427, Od. 8.204, Od. 9.61, 331, Od. 10.132, etc.

div.head: d
div.p: All others, all men or things, all: ἔξοχον ἄλλων Il. 6.194. Cf. Il. 3.42, Il. 4.375, Il. 6.208, Il. 7.112, Il. 13.631, etc.: περὶ ἄλλων φασὶ γενέσθαι Od. 4.201. Cf. Od. 5.118, Od. 8.102, Od. 23.110, etc.
In genit. pl. after superl., as compared with all others: νείατος ἄλλων Il. 6.295. Cf. Il. 1.505, Il. 10.434, Il. 23.532: ὀϊζυρώτατον ἄλλων Od. 5.105. Cf. Od. 15.108.

div.head: e
div.p: Men: δίκας ἠδὲ θρόνιν ἄλλων Od. 3.244.

div.head: α
div.p: Other or additional: πολλοὶ ἄλλοι φῶτες ὄλοντο Od. 1.355. Cf. Od. 1.394, Od. 3.113, Od. 14.200, Od. 22.28, etc.

div.head: β
div.p: Besides, in addition: ἦ οὐχ ἅλις ἦμιν ἀλήμονές εἰσι καὶ ἄλλοι; Od. 17.376. Cf. Od. 2.65.

div.head: b
div.p: Other or different: ἄλλα δίδου γέρα Il. 9.334. Cf. Il. 17.328, Il. 23.459, 700, etc.: ἄλλα κήδεα Od. 1.244. Cf. Od. 1.374, Od. 8.558, Od. 12.22, etc.

div.head: c
div.p: The other or different: Ἀτρεΐδαι τε καὶ ἄλλοιʼ Ἀχαιοί (ye other . . .) Il. 1.17, ἄλλοι θεοί Il. 2.1. Cf. Il. 1.22, Il. 3.68, Il. 5.524, 709, Il. 6.426, etc.: ἄλλους θεράποντας Od. 4.37. Cf. Od. 1.210, Od. 8.379, Od. 9.543, Od. 10.320, Od. 11.563, etc.

With the article: τοῖς ἄλλοισι θεοῖς Il. 1.597. Cf. Il. 2.674, Il. 11.75, 406, Il. 14.189, Il. 16.763, Il. 18.103, Il. 19.83, etc.: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων Od. 5.383. Cf. Od. 6.176, Od. 9.100, Od. 10.250, Od. 11.541, Od. 16.133, etc.

div.head: d
div.p: All the other: Ἀχαιῶν ἔξοχον ἄλλων Il. 17.358. Cf. Od. 4.171.
All other, all: ἄλλων νόον ἐσθλῶν Il. 9.514, etc.: εἴ τι γυναικῶν ἀλλάων περίειμι Od. 19.326, etc.

div.head: III
div.p: Of other kind or sort: οὐκ ἔα πόνος ἄλλος Il. 5.517 (i.e. it was no time for curiosity), ὄρνεον ἄλλο Il. 13.64. Cf. Il. 13.622, Il. 21.22: ἄλλῳ αὐτὸν θωτὶ ἤϊσκεν Od. 4.247. Cf. Od. 11.54.
A stranger: ἄλοχοι ἄλλοισι δαμεῖεν Il. 3.301. Cf. Il. 6.456, Il. 9.594, Il. 22.489, Il. 24.481: ἕλωρ ἄλλοισιν Od. 13.208. Cf. Od. 13.419, Od. 14.417, Od. 15.228, Od. 20.213, etc.
In apposition: ἄλλος τις πτωχὸς ἐλθών Od. 8.327.
A foe: ἀδελφεὸν ἄλλος ἔπεφνεν Od. 4.91.
In contrast with something following, an ordinary man: ἄλλος μογέων ἀποκινήσασκεν Il. 11.636.
Something not according to custom. Predicatively: ἄλλο τι τόδε περιμηχανόωνται Od. 7.200.
Something other than the true: οὐκ ἄν ἄλλα παρὲξ εἴποιμι Od. 4.348 = Od. 17.139.
Other than the right, the wrong: ἄλλην ὁδόν, ἄλλα κέλευθα Od. 9.261, ἐς ἄλλην γαῖαν Od. 13.211.

div.head: V
div.p: Implying in terms the inclusion in a class of a person or thing not in fact included in it: αὐτὸς κάθησο καὶ ἄλλους ἵδρυε λαούς Il. 2.191. Cf. Il. 5.485, 621, Il. 11.189, etc.: Ὀδυσσεὺς ἠδὲ καὶ ἄλλοι Φαίηκες Od. 8.368. Cf. Od. 1.128, Od. 5.489, Od. 6.84, Od. 11.470, Od. 15.407, etc.
Repeated: ἄλλος . . . ἄλλος . . . (ἄλλος . . .), one (some) . . . another (the other, others) . . . Il. 7.473, Il. 8.429, Il. 13.730, etc.: Od. 3.26, Od. 4.692, Od. 8.169, etc.
Sim.: ἄλλος ἄλλῳ ἔρεζε θεῶν Il. 2.400. Cf. Il. 12.175, etc.: Od. 14.228, Od. 18.301, etc.– For ἄλλος ἄλλος ἄλλῃ, ἄλλοθεν ἄλλος, ἄλλοτε ἄλλος, ἄλλυδις ἄλλος, see these words.
At another time, at other times Il. 10.120, Il. 13.776, Il. 19.200, Il. 20.53, Il. 22.171, Il. 24.511.
With ἄλλος: ἀ. ἐπʼ ἄλλον (now on to one, now on to another) Il. 15.684: ἀ. ἄλλῳ (now to one, now to another) Od. 4.236.
At another time, on a former occasion: ἀ. με ῥίψεν Il. 1.590. Cf. Il. 20.90, 187.
Of or belonging to others, not one's own Il. 20.298: Od. 1.160, Od. 9.535, Od. 11.115, Od. 18.280, Od. 19.119, Od. 20.171, 221, Od. 24.301.
As if not one's own: γναθμοῖσι γελώων ἀλλοτρίοισιν Od. 20.347 (not expressing their real feelings).
Absol. in neut. pl., things of others, what is not one's own: ἀλλοτρίων χαρίσασθαι Od. 17.452. Cf. Od. 17.456, Od. 18.18.
[ a first element poss. conn. with ἠλεός + φρονέω.]
Troubled or dashed in spirit Od. 10.374.
ἀ. ἄλλος, some or part in this direction, some or part in anotherIl. 11.486, 745, Il. 12.461, Il. 17.729, Il. 21.503: Od. 5.71, Od. 6.138, Od. 14.25, 35.
Otherwise, differently, so as to bring about a different result Il. 14.53.
Reversing a previous decision: μετεβούλευσαν Od. 5.286.
In some other form: εἰ ἀ. δοίης δωτίνην Od. 9.267.
καὶ ἀ., as it is, at the best of times, without that: ἀγήνωρ ἐστὶ καὶ ἀ. Il. 9.699. Cf. Il. 20.99: Od. 21.87.
Otherwise (connoting improvement): πάρος οὐκ ἔσσεται ἀ. Il. 5.218.
In other and better wise, better, more effectually: σαωσέμεν Il. 19.401. Cf. Il. 11.391: οὔ κεν ἀ. θεὸς τεύξειεν Od. 8.176. Cf. Od. 20.211, Od. 24.107.
Otherwise than with due regard to truth, idly, at random: ἀ. ψεύδονται Od. 14.124.
With other result than that hoped for, in vain, fruitlessly: ἀ. ἠρήσατο Il. 23.144.
In pl.: περιγιγνόμεθʼ ἄλλων ἅλμασιν Od. 8.103.
To pay no heed or regard Il. 15.162, 178.
Tallow applied to a bow Od. 8.179.
Oil or grease used for dressing a hide Il. 17.390, 392.
Hog's lard or grease: συὸς ῥάχιν τεθαλυῖαν ἀλοιθῇ Il. 9.208. Cf. Il. 9.467, 32: Od. 8.476, Od. 13.410.
[sense unknown. Traditionally explained as 'daughter of the sea' (ἅλς1).]
In pl.: ἅλεσσι μεμιγμένον εἶδαρ Od. 11.123 = Od. 23.270.
A sacred grove: Ὀγχηστόν, Ποσιδήϊον ἀ. (i.e. O. with its grove) Il. 2.506: Ἀθήνης Od. 6.291. Cf. Od. 6.321, Od. 9.200, Od. 10.509, Od. 20.278.
Absol., to play the shirker Il. 5.253, Il. 6.443.
To get away from, effect one's escape or release from (something in which one is involved): χρέος καὶ δεσμόν (getting out of the debt and freeing himself from the bonds) Od. 8.353.
To get free from the company of: ἑταίρους Od. 12.335.

Absol., to effect one's escape, escape,
save oneself Il. 21.243, Il. 10.348, Il. 22.201: Od. 4.416, Od. 5.345, Od. 11.113 = Od. 12.140, Od. 22.460.
Not to be loosed: πέδας Il. 13.37, πεῖραρ 360: δεσμούς Od. 8.275.
To be beside oneself from pain or grief: ἀλύουσʼ ἀπεβήσετο Il. 5.352. Cf. Il. 24.12.
To manifest distraction by gestures: χερσὶν ἀλύων Od. 9.398.
3 sing. opt. ἄλθοι Od. 15.453, Od. 17.250, Od. 20.383.
To bring in, yield (a price) (always of a human chattel): ἑκατόμβοιον Il. 21.79. Cf. Od. 15.453, Od. 17.250, Od. 20.383.
Bringing (her parents many) oxen (as bride-price) Il. 18.593.
Epithet of men, gain-getting, having to labour for their bread Od. 1.349, Od. 6.8, Od. 13.261.
Barley (i.e. the prepared corn): ἀλθίτου ἀκτήν (barley-meal) Il. 11.631. Cf. Od. 2.355, Od. 14.429.
A piece of levelled or prepared ground, a garden, orchard, vineyard Il. 5.90, Il. 9.534, 540, Il. 18.57 = 438, Il. 21.36, 77, 346: Od. 6.293.
As a vineyard Il. 18.561, 566 (in both cases referring to a representation in metal): Od. 1.193, Od. 7.122, Od. 11.193.
[σα-. Cf. ἀ-2, ἅπαξ, ἅπας, ἁπλοΐς, L. simul.]

With, along with, a person or persons, in his or their company: ἁ. ἕποντο Il. 1.424, θέρει ἁ. παῖδα Il. 6.389. Cf. Il. 3.447, Il. 4.274, Il. 9.170, Il. 10.194, Il. 11.344, etc.: κήρυχʼ ἁ. ὀπάσσας Od. 9.90. Cf. Od. 2.287, 413, Od. 6.319, Od. 8.109, Od. 13.68, etc.

All or both together, in a body, without exception: πάντες ἁ. Il. 1.495, ταῦθʼ ἁ. χρὴ σπεύδειν (with united effort) Il. 13.235. Cf. Il. 1.533, Il. 6.59, Il. 8.8, Il. 15.718, Il. 18.50, etc.: ἁ. πλέομεν Od. 3.276. Cf. Od. 8.121, Od. 10.259, Od. 11.232, Od. 12.110, Od. 13.82, etc.
In reference to things, all at once, without exception: ἁ. πάνθʼ ἑλέσθαι Il. 13.729. Cf. Il. 4.320.
At the same time: σκεψάμενος ἐς νῆʼ ἁ. καὶ μεθʼ ἑταίρους Od. 12.247. Cf. Od. 10.123, Od. 18.356.
Together, at the same moment: ἁ. ἄμφω σύν ῥʼ ἔπεσον Il. 7.255. Cf. Il. 13.613, Il. 19.242, etc.: ὁμαρτήσαντες ἁ. ἄμφω Od. 8.188.
In reference to something done while others are doing other things: τῇ ἁ. Ἀ. κλισίην ἔθηκεν, Ἀ. δὲ . . . Φ. δὲ . . . Od. 4.123.

At the same time, besides, too, also: ἁ. δʼ ἄλλʼ ἀποδάσσεσθαι Il. 22.117. Cf. Il. 24.304: Od. 19.376.–ἁ. . . . καὶ . . . , both . . . and . . . : ἁ. πρόσσω καὶ ὀπίσσω Il. 1.343. Cf. Il. 2.707, Il. 13.299, etc.: Od. 3.111, Od. 19.471, etc.

div.head: II
div.p: Prep. with dat. (freq. following the case).
With, along with, in company with: ἁ. ἡγεμόνεσσιν Il. 3.1. Cf. Il. 1.158, 226, 251, Il. 2.249, 524, etc.: τῷ ἁ. πομπὸν ἕπεσθαι Od. 4.162. Cf. Od. 1.98, 331, 428, Od. 2.11, Od. 3.359, etc.

At the same time with, at the time of: ἁ. ἠελίῳ καταδύντι Il. 1.592. Cf. Il. 7.331, Il. 9.618, Il. 11.685, Il. 18.136, Il. 24.600, etc.: ἁ. ἠοῖ Od. 4.407. Cf. Od. 6.31, Od. 12.24, Od. 14.266, Od. 16.2, Od. 23.362, etc.
To level with the dust, destroy: πόλιν Il. 9.593.
Thus, of very great size or height: χίμαιραν Il. 6.179, Il. 16.329: ἱστὸν νηός Od. 14.311.
Of young animals, tender, feeble: ἄρνα Il. 22.310: σκυλάκεσσιν Od. 20.14.
3 sing. impf. ἡμάρτανε Il. 10.372, Il. 24.68: Od. 11.511.
Fut. infin. in mid. form ἁμαρτήσεσθαι Od. 9.512.
To discharge a missile vainly, miss one's aim: ἤμβροτες οὐδʼ ἔτυχες Il. 5.287. Cf. Il. 8.311, Il. 11.233 = Il. 13.605, Il. 13.518, Il. 22.279.
Sim., to miss (a person) in throwing something to be caught Od. 6.116.
Sim., to lose (a person) by death Il. 22.505.
To fall short, be lacking or deficient in.

With genit.: δώρων (failed to give in due measure) Il. 24.68: νοήματος ἐσθλοῦ (failed in the matter of) Od. 7.292, μύθων (failed in finding in the matter of) Od. 7.292, μύθων (failed in finding the right) Od. 11.511.
To commit wrong, sin: ὅτε κέν τις ἁμάρτῃ Il. 9.501. Cf. Od. 13.214, Od. 8.155.
To neglect one's duty: τόδε γʼ ἤμβροτον (in this) Od. 22.154.
Both or all together: δούρατʼ ἤϊξαν Il. 5.656, ῥήσσοντες Il. 18.571.
At the same moment, simultaneously Il. 21.162: Od. 22.81.
A coming of wheels together, a coming of chariots abreast of each other Il. 23.422.
To reap, act as reaper Il. 18.551.
To slice off: ἀπʼ οὔατʼ ἀμήσαντες Od. 8.301.
In mid. : ἐν ταλάροισιν ἀμησάμενος Od. 9.247.
Capable of being scaled: πόλις Il. 6.434: οὐρανός Od. 11.316.
Lifting up the voice Il. 22.476. (Cf. ἀνεβάλλετʼ ἀείδειν under ἀναβάλλω 2.)
Spirting up: λέβης ζεῖ ἀ. Il. 21.364.
The food of the gods Od. 5.93, 199, Od. 9.359, Od. 12.63.
By Here as a cleansing (and doubtless perfuming) cosmetic Il. 14.170.
Applied by divine agency as a preservative or for purification to the corpse of Sarpedon Il. 16.670, 680.
Introduced by divine agency into the corpse of Patroclus Il. 19.38.

Sweet-smelling, fragrant: χαῖται Il. 1.529, νύκτα Il. 2.57 (prob. referring to the fragrance of a still warm night), ὕπνος Il. 2.19 (prob. a transference of epithet from νύξ). Cf. Il. 5.338, 369, Il. 8.434, Il. 10.41, 142, Il. 13.35, Il. 14.172, 177, 178, Il. 18.268, Il. 21.507, Il. 23.187 (here no doubt with a reference to preservative properties of the divine food; cf. ἀμβροσίη 2), Il. 24.341, 363: =Od. 1.97 = Od. 5.45, Od. 4.429 = 574, Od. 7.283, Od. 9.404, Od. 15.8, Od. 18.193.
-ον. = ἀμβρόσιος.: εἵματα Il. 16.670, 680: Od. 7.260, 265, Od. 24.59, ἐλαίῳ Od. 8.365, νύξ Od. 11.330.
Of or belonging to a god, divine Il. 5.339, 870: Od. 5.347.
App., conferring divine qualities: δῶρα Od. 18.191.

p.gloss: Not to be envied or desired.

div.p: Of a person in depreciation, miserable, wretched Od. 17.219, Od. 8.362.
The rafters, sloping to each other in pairs, of a pitched roof Il. 23.712 (the wrestlers, with shoulders together but standing wide apart with their feet, being compared with a pair).
3 sing. aor. mid. ἠμείψατο Il. 23.542. ἀμείψατο Il. 4.403.
Infin. ἀμείψασθαι Il. 23.489: Od. 2.83, Od. 4.286, Od. 16.91. (ἀπ-, ἐπ-, παρ-.)
With genit. of what is taken in exchange: τεύχεα πρὸς Διομήδεα χρύσεα χαλκείων Il. 6.235.
Sim., to exchange (the support of) one thing for (that of) another: γόνυ γουνός Il. 11.547.
To cause persons to exchange: τεύχεα Il. 14.381.

div.head: a
div.p: To requite: εὖ σε δώροισιν ἀμειψάμενος (making a good return to you in gifts) Od. 24.285.

div.head: b
div.p: To take turns with one another: ἀμειβόμενοι θυλακὰς ἔχον Il. 9.471.

So ἀμειβόμεναι ὀπὶ καλῇ (taking up the strain from each other) Il. 1.604: Od. 24.60.– ἀμειβόμενοι κατὰ οἴκους (each in turn giving the feast in his house) Od. 1.375 = Od. 2.140.– ταρφέʼ ἀμειβομένω (with frequent change (from side to side)) Od. 8.379.

div.head: c
div.p: To pass from one position or place to another: ἄλλοτʼ ἐπʼ ἄλλον [ἵππον] ἀμείβεται Il. 15.684.

div.head: d
div.p: To pass from, leave, quit: ἕρκος ὀδόντων Il. 9.409.

div.head: g
div.p: To speak in answer, make answer Il. 13.823, Il. 23.489, 492, Il. 24.200, 424: Od. 3.148, Od. 4.382, 484, Od. 6.67, etc.
In pres. pple. ἀμειβόμενος, -η, making answer, in answerIl. 3.437, Il. 7.356, Il. 14.270, etc.: Od. 2.84, Od. 4.234, 375, etc.
Inflexible, implacable, relentless: Ἀΐδης Il. 9.158, ἦτορ 572, ἄνακτος Il. 24.734.
Acc. sing. masc. and fem. ἀμείνω Il. 3.11, Il. 4.400, Il. 9.423.
Used as comp. of ἀγαθός or ἐσθλός.
Better, more worthy, serviceable or skilful: ἀγορῇ Il. 4.400. Cf. Il. 6.350, Il. 18.106, Il. 23.315, 479, 605 (your betters): Od. 2.180, Od. 7.51, Od. 22.156.
In reference to personal appearance Od. 24.374.

Of things or abstractions, better of their kind, better, more excellent, helpful or in place: ὀμίχλην νυκτὸς ἀμείνω Il. 3.11. Cf. Il. 1.116, Il. 7.358 = Il. 12.232, Il. 9.104, 256, 423, Il. 12.412, Il. 14.107, Il. 15.509: ἀμείνω αἴσιμα πάντα Od. 7.310, Od. 15.71. Cf. Od. 1.376 = Od. 2.141, Od. 5.364, Od. 14.466, Od. 22.374.
Impers. with infin.: πείθεσθαι ἄμεινόν [ἐστιν] Il. 1.274. Cf. Il. 11.469: Od. 22.104.
Good rather than ill: οὔ οἱ τό γʼ ἄμεινον Il. 24.52.
In pass. with the milk in acc.: ἀμελγόμεναι γάλα Il. 4.434.
To disregard the claims of, fail to aid: οὐκ ἀμέλησε κασιγνήτοιο Il. 8.330. Cf. Il. 13.419.
In sinister sense of holding back from attempting to despoil Il. 17.9.
To disregard, fail to carry out: ἐθημοσύνης Il. 17.697.
Of ghosts, fleeting, feeble Od. 10.521, 536, Od. 11.29, 49.
To deprive of efficiency or effect: αἰχμήν Il. 13.562.
2 sing. aor. subj. pass. ἀμερθῇς Il. 22.58.
To deprive of or debar from.
With genit.: αἰῶνος Il. 22.58. Cf. Od. 8.64, Od. 8.290.
To deprive of lustre, tarnish Od. 19.18.
Immeasurable, endless: πένθος Od. 19.512, πόνος Od. 23.249.
Unmeasured in words. Of Thersites Il. 2.212.
Unmanageable, difficult to deal with: ἀ. παραρρητοῖσι πιθέσθαι (in that you will not listen to persuasion) Il. 13.726.
Against which no contrivance avails Il. 8.130 = Il. 11.310.
Impracticable, not to be attempted Il. 14.262.
Difficult to deal with or expound: ὄνειροι Od. 19.560.
Wearing no μίτρη with the χιτών, not wearing theμίτρη Il. 16.419.
Thus, misty, steaming. Of Lemnos Il. 24.753. (Lemnos is not volcanic. The reference may be to some jet of natural gas which has now disappeared.)
App., what (of good) fate does not bestow, ill fortune Od. 20.76.
Denied the just dues of mankind, ill - fated Il. 6.408, Il. 24.773.

p.gloss: Having no share in, not entering.

div.p: With genit.: λοετρῶν Ὠκεανοῖο Il. 18.489: = Od. 5.275.
A vessel for collecting the blood of a sacrificial victim Od. 3.444.
From any point (of a narrative): τῶν ἁ. εἰπέ Od. 1.10.
Of a garment, kept for a change (= ἐπημοιβός 1): χλαῖνα Od. 14.521.
A return or requital: ἄξιον ἔσται ἀμοιβῆς (will bring a (full) return) Od. 1.318, ἑκατόμβης (for . . . ) Od. 3.58.
Compensation: βοῶν (for the loss of . . . ) Od. 12.382.
A relieving force: ἦλθον ἀμοιβοί (as a . . . ) Il. 13.793.

gen. rendered, in the depth or gloom of night Il. 11.173, Il. 15.324, Il. 22.28, 317: Od. 4.841. (But Sirius, referred to in Il. 22.27 as shining ὀπώρης, is not then seen in the depth of night; and ἀστὴρ ἕσπερος in Il. 22.317 also causes difficulty.)

-ή, -όν. Our ( = ἡμέτερος) Il. 6.414, Il. 8.178, Il. 10.448, Il. 13.96, Il. 16.830: Od. 11.166 = 481. (But the sense my (cf. ἡμέτερος 2) is always admissible, and in Il. 6.414, and perh. in Il. 8.178, is preferable.)
In neut. ἄμοτον as adv., insatiably, continually, incessantly, without pause or intermission Il. 4.440, Il. 5.518, Il. 13.40, 80, Il. 19.300, Il. 22.36, Il. 23.567: Od. 6.83, Od. 17.520.
Nom. pl. masc. aor. pple. ἀμπείραντες.
Epithet of places Il. 2.561, Il. 3.184, Il. 9.152 = 294.
With διά (cf. διαμπερές): διὰ δʼ ἀ. ἰὸς κατέπηκτο Il. 11.377. Cf. Il. 17.309: Od. 21.422.
To leap up, start up: ἐκ λόχου ἀμπήδησεν Il. 11.379.
A diadem of metal worn over the forehead Il. 22.469.
Together, all together, in or into a body or mass: θυνόντων ἀ. Il. 10.524. Cf. Il. 9.6, Il. 10.300, Il. 12.385, Il. 13.336, 343, Il. 20.114, 158, 374, Il. 23.217: Od. 4.659, Od. 12.413.
Together, at the same time: ἀ. βρόντησε καὶ ἔμβαλε κεραυνόν Od. 12.415 = Od. 14.305. Cf. Od. 5.467.

An epithet of persons of general commendation, noble, illustrious, goodly, or the like: μάντις Il. 1.92, Αἰθιοπῆας 423. Cf. Il. 2.674, Il. 5.247, Il. 6.155, Il. 11.835, Il. 20.236, etc.: Αἰγίσθοιο (app. as a merely conventional epithet) Od. 1.29, Ὀδυσῆος Od. 2.225. Cf. Od. 4.187, Od. 7.29, Od. 8.117, Od. 19.332, Od. 8.325, etc.
Of women: ἄκοιτιν Il. 6.374. Cf. Od. 4.4, Od. 7.303, Od. 13.42, Od. 15.15, etc.

Sim. of things or abstractions, indicating excellence or perfection: πομπῇ Il. 6.171, ἔργα Il. 9.128, τόξῳ Il. 15.463. Cf. Il. 9.270, Il. 10.19, Il. 13.637, Il. 16.119, Il. 19.245, Il. 23.263: οἶκος Od. 1.232, μῆτις Od. 9.414. Cf. Od. 10.50, Od. 12.261, Od. 14.508, Od. 16.237, Od. 22.442 = 459, Od. 23.145, Od. 24.80, 278.
Absol. in neut. pl.: δς ἂν ἀμύμονα εἰδῇ (is of noble heart) (see εἴδω III.12) Od. 19.332.
3 sing. impf. ἄμυνε Il. 13.678, Il. 14.71, Il. 15.731.
Aor. opt. mid. ἀμυναίμην Od. 2.62, Od. 12.114. (ἀπ-, ἐπ-, προσ-.)
To defend oneself against, fight with: δήϊον ἄνδρα Il. 22.84.

With dat. of person or thing protected: ἡμῖν λοιγόν Il. 1.67. Cf. Il. 1.341, 398, 456, Il. 4.129, Il. 9.435, 495, Il. 11.277, 588, Il. 12.334, Il. 13.426, Il. 15.736, Il. 16.32, 512, 835, Il. 17.511, Il. 18.129, Il. 20.124: ἄστεϊ νηλεὲς ἦμαρ Od. 8.525.
With genit. : κῆρας παιδός Il. 12.402. Cf. Il. 4.11, Il. 15.731, Il. 16.75, 80.
To defend, protect, succour, fight for, come to the rescue of.
With genit.: οὗ παιδός Il. 16.522. Cf. Il. 13.109.
Absol. to play the defender, fight, show fight: ἐξελθεῖν καὶ ἀμῦναι Il. 9.576. Cf. Il. 13.312, 678, 814, Il. 17.182: οὐ τοῖοι ἀμυνέμεν Od. 2.60.

div.head: a
div.p: To ward or keep off from oneself: ἀμύνετο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ Il. 11.484, Il. 13.514. Cf. Il. 17.510.
Sim. ἄνδρας θηρητῆρας ἀμύνονται πεπρὶ τέκνων Il. 12.170.
To defend oneself against, fight with: σκύλλην Od. 12.114.

div.head: b
div.p: With genit.: Καλυδῶνος Il. 9.531. Cf. Il. 12.155, 179, Il. 16.561.

div.head: c
div.p: Absol., to play the defender, fight: περὶ νηῶν Il. 12.142. Cf. Il. 12.227, 243, Il. 15.496, Il. 16.556, 622, Il. 18.173, Il. 24.500: ἧός μοι ἀμύνεσθαι πάρʼ ὀϊστοί Od. 22.106. Cf. Od. 2.62, Od. 22.116.
To tear, lacerate: χερσὶ στήθεα Il. 19.284.
To welcome (with suppressed notion of embracing) Od. 14.381.
To show love to, treat with affection.
In mid., to come together or gather round.
With acc.: θεαί μιν ἀμφαγέροντο Il. 18.37.
Openly, without concealment: μὴ ἀ. ἔργα γένοιτο (disclosure should take place) Od. 19.391.
Adv. of acc. fem. form ἀμφαδίην = ἀμφαδά. Il. 7.196, Il. 13.356: Od. 5.120.
Openly, without concealment or subterfuge: βαλέειν Il. 7.243, ἀγορευέμεν Il. 9.370: ἠὲ δόλῳ ἢ ἀ. Od. 1.296, Od. 11.120, ἢ ἀ. ἦε κρυφηδόν Od. 14.330 = Od. 19.299.
To rattle or ring about one: τεύχεʼ ἀμφαράβησεν Il. 21.408.
Speechlessness: ἀ. μιν λάβεν Il. 17.695: = Od. 4.704.
To put the hands round, handle.
In mid.: [ὅρμον] ἀμφαφόωντο Od. 15.462. Cf. Od. 19.475.
So μαλακώτερος ἀμφαφάασθαι (easier to deal with) Il. 22.373.
To handle and use: τόξον Od. 19.586.
To put the hands on in passing round: κοῖλον λόχον (the wooden horse) Od. 4.277.
Absol., to feel about with the hands Od. 8.196.
To come round, be diffused round.
With acc. : ἀϋτή με Od. 6.122, ἀϋτμή με Od. 12.369.
Covering on both sides: φαρέτρην (i.e. enclosing (the arrows)) Il. 1.45.
In neut. qualifying a vague notion the state of things; hence, a dead heat: ἀμφήριστόν κʼ ἔθηκεν Il. 23.382, 527.

div.head: a
div.p: On both sides: ἀ. ὀβελοῖσιν ἔπειραν (so that the spits appeared on both sides) Il. 1.465 = Il. 2.428. Cf. Il. 9.210: ξύλα τʼ ἀ. καὶ οἰσέμεν ὕδωρ (i.e. to be set on either side of the altar) Od. 3.429. Cf. Od. 3.462 = Od. 12.365 = Od. 14.430, Od. 14.75.

div.head: b
div.p: In reference to the two sides of the body: ἀ. ὄσσε νὺξ ἐκάλυψεν (both eyes) Il. 5.310 = Il. 11.356. Cf. Il. 6.117, Il. 10.535, etc.: δρεψαμένω ἀ. δειράς Od. 2.153. Cf. Od. 9.389.
Sim. in reference to the φρένες (see μέλας 1): μένεος φρένες ἀ. μελαιναι πίμπλαντο Il. 1.103: = Od. 4.661. Cf. Il. 17.83, 499, 573.
From side to side: ἀ. μοι χεὶρ ὀδύνῃσιν ἐλήλαται Il. 16.517.
Round, about, round about: ἔστασαν Il. 4.330. Cf. Il. 4.328, Il. 5.194, Il. 7.449, Il. 11.417, Il. 14.420, etc.: χλαίνας βάλον Od. 4.50. Cf. Od. 3.32, Od. 4.253, Od. 5.72, Od. 7.14, Od. 9.22, etc.
Fig.: ἀ. μάλα φράζεσθε (look at the matter all round, consider well) Il. 18.254.
About or concerning something: τάδʼ ἀ. πονησόμεθα Il. 23.159. Cf. Il. 7.316, Il. 11.776: τὸνδέρον ἀ. θʼ ἕπον Od. 8.61, Od. 19.421.

div.head: a
div.p: On each side of: ἀ. κῦμα στείρῃ ἴαχεν Il. 1.481, ἀ. ὤμοισιν βάλετο ξίθος (i.e. the belt rested on both shoulders) Il. 2.45, θώρηκας ῥήξειν ἀ. στήθεσσιν (i.e. the belt rested on both shoulders) Il. 2.45, θώρηκας ῥήξειν ἀ. στήθεσσιν (i.e. the two γύαλα) 544, ἀ. ὀχέεσσι βάλε κύκλα Il. 5.722, ἀ. σθοῖς ὀχέεσσιν (app., sprawling over them) Il. 18.231, ἀ. πυρίποδα (astraddle over it) 344, etc.: ἀ. ἑνὶ δούρατι βαῖνεν (bestriding it) Od. 5.371, ἀ. πυπὶ χαλκὸν ἰήνατε Od. 8.426, etc.
So with locative: ἱδρώσει τελαμὼν ἀ. στήθεσφιν Il. 2.388.
In reference to a shield protecting on both sides (cf. ἀμφίβροτος): δῄουν ἀ. στήθεσσι βοείας Il. 5.452. Cf. Il. 10.149 (across the shoulders), Il. 11.527, Il. 16.108, Il. 17.132, etc.
For βαίνειν ἀ. τινι see βαίνω I.6.a, and cf. ἀμφιβαίνω 4.

div.head: b
div.p: Round, about, round about: τυθωέϊ Il. 2.782, εἰδώλῳ Il. 5.451. Cf. Il. 9.654, Il. 13.496, Il. 14.447, Il. 15.608, etc.: πόλει Od. 6.9, γούνασιν Od. 7.142. Cf. Od. 4.245, Od. 10.262, Od. 11.423, Od. 14.23, etc.
So with locative: ἀ. κυνέην κεφαλῆφιν ἔθηκεν Il. 10.257. Cf. Il. 10.261: Od. 16.145.
In reference to something transfixing: ἀ. σιδήρῳ Il. 23.30. Cf. Od. 12.395.
With notion of protection: ἀ. βόεσσιν Il. 15.587. Cf. Il. 17.369.

div.head: c
div.p: About, concerning, for, touching, in the matter of: Ἑλένῃ Il. 3.70. Cf. Il. 3.254, Il. 7.408, Il. 11.672, Il. 13.382, Il. 16.647, etc.: τεύχεσιν ἀ. Ἀχιλῆος Od. 11.546. Cf. Od. 1.48, Od. 4.151, Od. 14.338, Od. 17.555, Od. 22.227, etc.

div.head: a
div.p: On each side of : ἀ. κῆρ Il. 16.481.

div.head: b
div.p:
Round, about, round about: ἀ. ἅλα(i.e. round the bay) Il. 1.409, ἀ. Αἴαντε (with them, under their leadership) Il. 6.436, τὴν ἑτέρην πόλιν ἀ. Il. 18.509. Cf. Il. 2.417, Il. 3.231, Il. 5.314, Il. 13.335, Il. 16.290, Il. 17.290, Il. 22.473, etc.:
Ἰαρδάνου ἀ. ῥέεθρα Od. 3.292. Cf. Od. 3.163, Od. 8.502, Od. 11.419, Od. 17.65, Od. 22.281, Od. 24.37, etc.
Joined with περί Il. 2.305, Il. 17.760.–οἱ ἀ. τινα, a person and those with him, a group of which the person named is the chief: οἱ δʼ ἀ. Ἀτρεΐωνα ἠγερέθοντο Il. 23.233.
Sim.: οὓς ἑτάρους στέλλοντʼ ἀ. Πελάγοντα Ἀλάστορά τε . . . Il. 4.295 (where P. etc. are included in ὲτάρους).

div.head: c
div.p: With genit., about, concerning: μάχεσθον πίδακος ἀ. Il. 16.825. Cf. Od. 8.267.
Epithet of Ithaca Od. 1.386, 395, 401, Od. 2.293, Od. 8.252.
Acc. fem. pf. pple. without redup. ἀμφιαχυῖαν (ἀμφι-ϝακυῖαν).
Of a bird, to cry (flying) about: τὴν λάβεν ἀμφιαχυῖαν Il. 2.316.
3 sing. plupf. ἀμφιβεβήκει Il. 8.68, Il. 16.777: Od. 9.198.
To be round, cover completely, a double (organ) (cf. ἀμφί I.1.b).
With acc.: πόνος (ἄχος) φρένας ἀμφιβέβηκεν Il. 7.355: Od. 8.541.
With dat.: Τρώων νέφος νηυσίν Il. 16.66.

p.gloss: To be round, envelop, cover up.

div.p: To have the feet on each side of, bestride (cf. βαίνω I.6.a).
With acc. Fig.: ἠέλιος μέσον οὐρανόν (thought of as standing with both feet in the midst of heaven) Il. 8.68, Il. 16.777: Od. 4.400.
Hence to protect (a place) as a tutelary power Il. 1.37 = 451: Od. 9.198.
Aor. pple. ἀμφιβαλών, -όντος Il. 17.742, Il. 23.97: Od. 17.344, Od. 23.192.
Fig., to throw or put (strength) on both sides of something, apply (strength) vigorously: μένοσἀμφιβαλόντες Il. 17.742.
In mid., to throw (a garment) round oneself Od. 6.178.
To put on a piece of armour Od. 22.103.
Defence of a fallen body (cf. ἀμφιβαίνω 4): Τρώων (by the . . .) Il. 5.623.

p.gloss: Protecting on both sides (as well as in front).

div.p: Epithet of shields Il. 2.389, Il. 11.32, Il. 12.402, Il. 20.281.
[prob. ἀμφι- 2 + γυ-, to bend, as in γύαλον, γυρός.]
Thus, having a crooked limb on each side.

Thus, of spears, (having a head) curved on each side, i.e. leafshaped; or perh., bending to either side, elastic Il. 13.147 = Il. 15.278 = Il. 17.731, Il. 14.26 = Il. 16.637, Il. 15.386, 712: Od. 16.474, Od. 24.527.
With acc. Fig.: ἀϋτὴ ἄστυ ἀμφιδέδηε Il. 6.329.

To set round in circles, i.e. in strips running round: ᾧ πέρι χεῦμα κασσιτέροιο ἀμφιδεδίνηται Il. 23.562 (the strips on the front plate being app. continued on the back plate and carried round to the front again): κολεὸν ἐλέθαντος ἀμφιδεδίνηται (is surrounded by (a succession of) ivory rings) Od. 8.405.
Having both cheeks torn in mourning: ἄλοχος Il. 2.700.
Both torn in mourning: παρειαί Il. 11.393.
To put (garments) on a person Od. 5.167, 264, Od. 15.369, Od. 18.361.
In mid., to put (garments) on oneself Od. 23.131, 142.
With elision of the ι (on the loss of the σ)
3 sing. impf. ἄμφεπε Il. 17.124, Il. 18.348: Od. 8.437.
To handle, attend to, do what is needful to: ἵππους Il. 19.392. Cf. Il. 5.667, Il. 18.559, Il. 23.167, Il. 24.622.
To marshal, draw up in order Il. 2.525.
In sinister sense, to employ oneself about for evil, work for the destruction of,
Of fire, to bring itself to bear upon, lap round: πρύμνην Il. 16.124. Cf. Il. 18.348: = Od. 8.437.

p.gloss: To settle about, be deposited upon.

div.p: Absol., one who has both parents alive Il. 22.496.
3 sing. subj. ἀμφικαλύψῃ Od. 8.511, Od. 13.183, Od. 20.86.
To cover both of one's . . . (cf. ἀμφί I.1

div.head: b
div.p: ). Of sleep: βλέθαρʼ ἀμφικαλύψας Od. 5.493. Cf. Od. 20.86, Od. 23.17.
To cover completely a double (organ) (cf. ἀμφί I 1.b): ἔρως φρένας ἀμφεκάλυψεν Il. 3.442, Il. 14.294.
To cover up all round, enfold, conceal, contain Il. 2.262, Il. 23.91.
Of a city, to receive within its walls Od. 8.511.

Of a house, to receive as a guest
Od. 4.618 = Od. 15.118.
Fig. of death or fate Il. 5.68, Il. 12.116, Il. 16.350, Il. 20.417: Od. 4.180.

p.gloss: To put round, cover or protect with.

div.p: With dat. of what is covered or protected: σἀκος οἱ Il. 8.331 = Il. 13.420. Cf. Il. 14.343: Od. 14.349.
Sim., to put round (something) so as to isolate (it): ὄρος πόλει Od. 8.569, Od. 13.152, 158, 177, 183.
With acc.: τὸ μέλαν δρυὸς ἀμφικεάσσας (splitting off (the outside wood) all round the dark heart) Od. 14.12.
With foliage all round, thick-leafed: θάμνῳ Il. 17.677.
[ἀμφι- 1 (giving the notion of hesitation between two sides, hence of doubtfulness) + *λύκη = L. lux.]
To carry the hands all round or over (the surface of), wipe all round or over: τραπέζας Od. 20.152.
With acc., in local sense, to fight round or about: Ἴλιον Il. 6.461. Cf. Il. 9.412, Il. 16.73, Il. 18.208.
With genit., to fight for the possession of: τείχεος Il. 15.391. Cf. Il. 16.496 = 533, Il. 18.20.
To resound or echo all round Od. 10.227.
In mid., to have one's lot, dwell, round or about.
To smooth all round: κορμόν Od. 23.196.
To busy oneself about, attend to Il. 13.656, Il. 19.278.
To treat surgically Il. 4.220, Il. 16.28: Od. 19.455.
In sinister sense: Ἀστεροπαῖον ἐγχέλυες ἀμφεπένοντο (made a meal of him) Il. 21.203. Cf. Il. 23.184.
With dat. Fig., in pass., to be put round as a crown, adorn: οὔ οἱ χάρις ἀμφιπεριστέθεται ἐπέεσσιν Od. 8.175.
To turn about in all directions: ἵππους Il. 8.348.
To fall (with the arms) round, embrace.
To busy oneself about, take care of, tend: ἐμὸν βίον Od. 18.254 = Od. 19.127, ὄρχατον Od. 24.244, 257.
In sinister sense: ἔδοσαν ἐρινύσιν ἀμφιπολεύειν (i.e. handed them over to their tender mercies) Od. 20.78.

A handmaid, a female attendant or servant, hardly to be distinguished from δμῳή. (The words are sometimes used indifferently; cf. Od. 6.52 with 307, and 84 with 99. But in Od. 22.483, 484 ἀμφίπολοι seem to be personal attendants and δμῳαί the other servants.) Il. 3.143, 422, Il. 6.286, 324, 372, 399, 491, 499, Il. 18.417 (i.e. representations), Il. 22.442, 461, Il. 24.304: Od. 1.136, Od. 6.18, Od. 7.232, Od. 18.198, Od. 19.90, Od. 23.227, etc.
With word indicating the servant's country of origin: σικελή Od. 24.366.
To busy oneself about, attend to: τάθον Od. 20.307.
To do the offices of a second to: εὐρύαλον Il. 23.681.
To fly round and round Il. 2.315.
Flowed round (by the sea), sea-girt Od. 1.50, 198, Od. 11.325, Od. 12.283.
On both sides: ᾧ ῥόπαλʼ ἀ. ἐάγῃ (i.e. across his back) Il. 11.559, δούρασιν ἀ. [βάλεν] (with spears from both hands, with both spears at once) Il. 21.162.

A part, asunder: ἀ. φράζονται (have different views) Il. 2.13 = 30 = 67, ἔχουσα ἀ. (one in each scale) Il. 12.434, τόξων ἀϊκὰς ἀ. μένον (at a safe distance) Il. 15.709, ἀ. ἀρωγοί (partisans, some of one, some of the other) Il. 18.502, ἀ. ἀριζήλω (standing out from the others) 519, ἀ. ἄλλʼ ἀποδάσσεσθαι (in addition) Il. 22.117, ἀ. ὁδοῦ Il. 23.393 (see ὁδός 1). Cf. Il. 13.345, 706: ζυγὸν ἀ. ἔχοντες (supporting it at either end) Od. 3.486 = Od. 15.184, τιμὴν ἀ. ἄγοντες (in addition) Od. 22.57. Cf. Od. 1.54.
Sim. of separation from a person Od. 19.221.
Between: ὀλίγη ἦν ἀ. ἄρουρα (between the heaps or rows) Il. 3.115.
Round, about: τάθρος ἀ. ἐοῦσα (surrounding) Il. 7.342, τάρταρος ἀ. [ἐστιν] Il. 8.481. Cf. Il. 9.464, Il. 14.123, Il. 23.330, Il. 24.488: Od. 8.340, 476.

div.head: a
div.p: Apart from, at a distance from: διός Il. 8.444. Cf. Od. 14.352, Od. 16.267.

div.head: b
div.p: About, concerning: ἅρματος ἀ. ἰδών (seeing to it) Il. 2.384.
With dat., round, about: ἄξονι Il. 5.723.

div.head: a
div.p: On each side of: δύο δʼ ἀ. ἕκαστον [δίθρον] (one on each side of each) Il. 11.748.

div.head: b
div.p: Round, about: ἕκαστον Il. 11.634. Cf. Il. 14.274, Il. 15.225: Od. 6.266, Od. 7.4, Od. 9.399.
In aor. and mid., to stand round or about Il. 18.233, Il. 23.695, Il. 24.712.
Thus, twisted about: κεφαλαὶ τρεῖς δράκοντος ἀμφιστρεφέες Il. 11.40 (i.e. two twisted about the third).
Aor. fem. pple. pass. ἀμφιτεθεῖσα Il. 10.271.
To put round or about something Il. 10.271.
In mid., to put on, arm oneself with: ξίφος Od. 8.431 (i.e. the belt rested on both shoulders).
With two θάλοι: κυνέην Il. 5.743 = Il. 11.41.
A two-handled jar Il. 23.92, 170: Od. 2.290, 349, 379, Od. 9.164, 204, Od. 13.105 (of natural formations in a cave), Od. 24.74.
With acc.: ἐμὲ κήρ (gaped for me) Il. 23.79.
3 sing. aor. pass. ἀμφέχυτο Il. 2.41. ἀμφθεχύθη Od. 4.716.
To pour or shed round or about. Of dust: πάρος κόνιν ἀμφιχυθῆναι (had settled down again) Il. 23.764.
Fig., in pass., of sound, to come round.
With acc.: ἀμφέχυτό μιν ὀμφή Il. 2.41.
Of sleep, to be shed round one, come upon one Il. 14.253 Il. 23.63.
With acc.: τὴν ἄχος ἀμφεχύθη Od. 4.716.
So of a bodily action, to embrace (a person): ἀμφιχυθεὶς πατέρα Od. 16.214. Cf. Od. 22.498.
Poured round or about; hence of heaped-up earth: τεῖχος Il. 20.145.

div.head: a
div.p: Of two persons, etc. In dual or (more freq.) in pl.

div.head: α
div.p: Absol.: ἐξαίνυτο θυμὸν ἀμφοτέρω Il. 5.156. Cf. Il. 3.208, Il. 4.38, Il. 5.261, Il. 7.3, etc.: ἀμφοτέρους ἱέρευσεν Od. 14.74. Cf. Od. 3.37, Od. 11.212, Od. 18.17, Od. 8.214, etc.

div.head: β
div.p: With sb. or pron.: ἀμφοτέρω σθῶϊ Il. 7.280, ἐπʼ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας (one after the other) Il. 13.281. Cf. Il. 4.521, Il. 5.163, Il. 8.115, Il. 12.382, etc.: ἀμφοτέρῃσιν χερσίν Od. 4.116. Cf. Od. 3.136, Od. 4.282, Od. 5.414, Od. 12.239, etc.
With sb. to be supplied: ἀμφοτέρῃσι
[χερσίν], with both hands Il. 5.416: Od. 10.264, Od. 11.594, Od. 17.356, Od. 18.28.

div.head: b
div.p: In pl. of two groups of persons.

div.head: α
div.p: Absol.: ἀμφοτέρων βέλεα Il. 8.67. Cf. Il. 3.416, Il. 4.16, Il. 6.120, Il. 13.303, etc.: φιλότητα μετʼ ἀμφοτέροισιν Od. 24.476. Cf. Od. 10.204, Od. 24.546.
In neut. ἀμφότερον as adv., both. Followed by . . . τε . . . τε Il. 3.179, Il. 4.145.
From both sides: ὦρτʼ ἀϋτὴ ἀ. Il. 15.313. Cf. Il. 12.431.
Of plainting strands of a rope, across and across Od. 10.167.
On both sides, on either side: πλῆμναί εἰσιν ἀ. Il. 5.726. Cf. Il. 12.55, Il. 16.563, Il. 17.440, Il. 20.170, Il. 23.628: Od. 22.404.
On both edges: ἀ. ἀκαχμένον Od. 5.235, Od. 22.80.
At both ends: ἅψας ἀ. Od. 8.408.
Of stating alternatives: ἐρέω ἀ. Od. 12.58.
In both directions: θόως γένετʼ ἀ. Il. 15.669.
With περί, app., in both directions so as to meet: περὶ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ἀ. Od. 7.113. Cf. Od. 10.88.
In both directions: γεγωνέμεν ἀ. Il. 8.223 = Il. 11.6, ἀ. λίθοι πωτῶντο Il. 12.287.
App., by the middle: ἀ. ἀείρας Od. 17.237.
Only in nom. and acc. of same form. Both. Constructed with dual or pl.
Of two groups of persons: ἀριθμηθήμεναι ἀ. Il. 2.124.
Having two ears (for handles) : ἄλεισον Od. 22.10.
Not to be blamed; hence, unerring (in counsel): πουλυδάμαντος Il. 12.109.

div.head: ἄν1.
div.p: Conditional or limiting particle. (Cf. κεν.) For the uses with subj., opt. and fut., aor. and impf. indic. in protasis and apodosis see 6.
With subj.: τάχʼ ἂν θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ Il. 1.205. Cf. Il. 18.192, Il. 22.505: ἐγὼ ἂν ξεῖνος ἔω Od. 9.17. Cf. Od. 4.240, Od. 11.328, 517, Od. 12.81.
In Il. 22.50 (ἀπολυσόμεθα) : Od. 4.240, Od. 11.328, 517 (μυθήσομαι), Od. 6.221 (λοέσσομαι) may be aor. subj. or fut. indic.

With opt. in potential or fut. sense: τῶν οὐκ ἄν τι θέροις Il. 1.301. Cf. Il. 2.250 (conveying an order), Il. 3.52 (will you not . . .?), 66, Il. 5.32, 362, Il. 6.141, Il. 9.77, Il. 10.204, Il. 13.741, Il. 14.58, Il. 22.108, Il. 24.437, etc.: πῶς ἂν Ὀδυσῆος λαθοίμην; Od. 1.65. Cf. Od. 3.232, Od. 4.78, Od. 6.57, 300, Od. 10.573, Od. 20.135 (do not . . .), Od. 22.325, etc.
In potential sense in reference to the past in suppositions contrary to fact.

div.head: a
div.p: With impf. or aor. indic.: ἦ τʼ ἂν κέρδιον ἦεν Il. 5.201 = Il. 22.103, οὐκ ἂν θυμὸν ὤρινεν Il. 19.271. Cf. Il. 8.455, Il. 13.676, Il. 16.638: οὐκ ἂν τόσσʼ ἀγόρευες (would not have . . .) Od. 2.184. Cf. Od. 9.211, 228, 334.

div.head: b
div.p: With pres. or aor. opt.: ἦ ἄν ὕστατα λωβήσαιο Il. 1.232 = Il. 2.242. Cf. Il. 1.271, Il. 4.223, Il. 5.85 Il. 13.127: οὐκ ἄν ὀχλίσσειαν Od. 9.241.
With infin. in indirect discourse: καὶ δʼ ἂν τοῖς ἄλλοισιν ἔθη παραμυθήσασθαι Il. 9.684.
For uses in protasis with εἰ and in the corresponding relative sentences see Table at end II.B.a 3
For uses in apodosis see II.C.a 3
For ὅτʼ ἄν (not in protasis) see ὅτε 1.a.γ, b.α b.δ b.ε, 4.
For ὄφρʼ ἅν (not in protasis) see ὄφρα 1.b, ὄφρα 1.c, 5.a

div.head: b
div.p: For ὡς ἄν (not in protasis) see ὡς 7.a, b.β, 8.α 8.γ, b.γ.
Also in form ἄν and in assimilated form ἄμ.

Up, upwards, in an upward direction, on to something: ἂν Χρυσηΐδα βήσομεν (put her on board) Il. 1.143, ἀνὰ δʼ ἔστη Il. 2.100, ἂν δʼ ἔβη (mounted) Il. 3.261, ἀνʼ ἔντεα λέγοντες (gathering them up) Il. 11.755. Cf. Il. 1.310, Il. 3.268, Il. 5.798, Il. 17.541, Il. 21.361, Il. 22.77, etc.: ἂν δʼ αὐτοὶ βάντες (going on board) Od. 2.419 = Od. 4.579. Cf. Od. 6.253, Od. 8.3, Od. 9.468 (see νεύω 3), Od. 13.56, Od. 17.262 (see βάλλω II.4), etc.

Back, reversal of action: ἀνά τʼ ἔδραμʼ ὀπίσσω
Il. 5.599, ἀνὰ δὲ σχέο Il. 7.110 (see ἔχω IV.1.b): ἀνὰ πρυμνήσια λῦσαι Od. 9.178 = 562 = Od. 11.637 = Od. 12.145 = Od. 15.548.
Indicating extension or diffusion: ἀνʼ ἱστία πέτασσαν Il. 1.480, μέλανες ἀνὰ βότρυες ἦσαν Il. 18.562: ἀνὰ κρητῆρα κέρασσεν Od. 3.390. Cf. Od. 4.41, 783 = Od. 8.54, Od. 10.506, Od. 24.343.
With dat., on, upon: ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ Il. 1.15 = 374. Cf. Il. 14.352, Il. 15.152: ἂμ πέτρῃσιν Od. 5.156. Cf. Od. 11.128 = Od. 23.128 = Od. 23.275, Od. 24.8.
In pregnant sense: ἅρματʼ ἂμ βωμοῖσι τίθει Il. 8.441. Cf. Il. 18.177.

div.head: a
div.p: On to, on, upon: θῆκεν ἀνὰ μυρίκην Il. 10.466. Cf. Il. 18.278: ἂν δὲ βήσετο δίφρον Od. 3.481. Cf. Od. 3.492 = Od. 15.145 = 190, Od. 22.176, 193, 239.

div.head: b
div.p: Through, throughout, along, over, among, in, on: ἀνὰ στρατόν Il. 1.10, ἂμ πεδίον Il. 5.87. Cf. Il. 1.53, Il. 4.251, Il. 5.74, Il. 9.383, Il. 10.339, Il. 13.308, Il. 16.349, Il. 22.452 (in . . .), etc.: ἂν στόμα Od. 5.456, ἀνʼ ὀρσοθύρην Od. 22.132. Cf. Od. 2.430, Od. 7.72, Od. 10.251, Od. 18.246, Od. 22.18, Od. 24.318, etc.
In reference to the mouth as the organ of speech: βασιλῆας ἀνὰ στόμʼ ἔχων (having them passing through the mouth, i.e. talking freely of them) Il. 2.250.
In reference to immaterial things: ἀνὰ θυμόν (in his mind) Il. 2.36, ἀνʼ ἰθύν Il. 21.303 (see ἰθύς2 2), etc. Cf. Od. 2.116, Od. 4.638, Od. 8.377 (see ἰθύς2 1), etc.
In reference to night as a space of darkness: ἀνὰ νύκτα Il. 14.80.
Indicating diffusion: ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα Od. 9.209.
In reference to position: ἀνὰ πρόθυρον τετραμμένος (i.e. with his feet pointing outwards through the doorway) Il. 19.212.
With genit., on to, upon: ἂν δὲ νηὸς βαῖνεν (went on board) Od. 2.416. Cf. Od. 9.177, Od. 15.284.
Up ! get up ! rouse yourself ! to work ! ἀλλʼ ἄνα Il. 6.331, Il. 9.247, Il. 18.178: Od. 18.13.

div.head: A
div.p: Contr. infin. ἀμβαίνειν Od. 9.178, Od. 11.637, etc.
Fem. ἀναβᾶσα Od. 1.362, Od. 17.49, Od. 22.428, etc.

div.head: B
div.p: Aor. pple. pl. mid. ἀναβησάμενοι Od. 15.475.
In reference to leaving a room: ἀνʼ ὀρσοθύρην Od. 22.132, ἀνέβαινεν ἐς θαλάμους (left the μέγαρον and took his way to . . .) Od. 22.142.
Of a voyage from Ithaca to Troy Od. 1.210.

p.gloss: To go up to, ascend to.

div.p: With acc.: οὐρανόν Il. 1.497. Cf. Od. 18.302, Od. 19.600, Od. 22.428.

To go on board a ship, embark: ἀναβάντες ἐπέπλεον ὑγρὰ κέλευθα Il. 1.312: ἀναβάντες ἐλαύνομεν Od. 3.157. Cf. Od. 4.473, 842, Od. 9.178 = 562 = Od. 11.637 = Od. 12.145 = Od. 15.548, Od. 12.293, 401, Od. 13.285, Od. 14.252, Od. 15.209, 219, 474.
Of reputation, to be spread abroad among.
With acc.: φάτις ἀνθρώπους ἀναβαίνει Od. 6.29.

div.head: II
div.p: Trans. in form (B), to cause to go on board a ship or embark: νὼ ἀναβησάμενοι Od. 15.475.
Contr. 1 pl. subj. mid. ἀμβαλλώμεθα Il. 2.436.
To put off, delay: ἄεθλον Od. 19.584.
In mid., to strike up, begin (to sing) (cf. βάλλω II.4 and ἀμβλήδην): ἀνεβάλλετʼ ἀείδειν Od. 1.155, Od. 8.266.
To clash or rattle loudly: τεύχεα Il. 19.13.
Of a door, to creak or grate loudly Od. 21.48.
To wet or moisten abundantly Il. 17.54.
Neut. aor. pple. pass. ἀναβροχέν Od. 11.586.
To swallow down, swallow Od. 11.586, Od. 12.240.
Genit. sing. masc. pple. ἀναγνόντος Od. 24.346.
Dat. sing. fem. ἀναγνούσῃ Od. 19.250, Od. 23.206.
To know again, recognize Od. 4.250, Od. 11.144, Od. 19.250 = Od. 23.206, Od. 24.346.
To know well, know certainly: [νόον ἐσθλόν] Il. 13.734 (i.e. best knows its value; cf. Od. 6.185). Cf. Od. 1.216, Od. 21.205.
Instrumental ἀναγκαίηφι Il. 20.143. = ἀνάγκη Il. 6.85: Od. 19.73.
In instrumental, by the application of force or strength: δαμέντας Il. 20.143.
Compelled, acting under compulsion: πολεμισταί Od. 24.499.
Imposing compulsion: ἦμαρ ἀναγκαῖον (see ἦμαρ 4.b) Il. 16.836, μύθῳ Od. 17.399 = Od. 20.344.–χρειοῖ ἀναγκαίῃ, by compelling necessity, under the compulsion of necessityIl. 8.57.
Necessity, compulsion: ἐπικείσετʼ ἀ. Il. 6.458. Cf. Il. 5.633, Il. 10.418, Il. 20.251, Il. 24.667: Od. 10.273.–ὑπʼ ἀνάγκης, under compulsionOd. 2.110 = Od. 24.146, Od. 19.156.

div.head: a
div.p: By or under compulsion or constraint: ἀ. οὔ μιν ἄξω Il. 9.429. Cf. Il. 9.692, Il. 15.199: ὃς ἤειδεν ἀ. Od. 1.154. Cf. Od. 4.557, Od. 5.154, Od. 7.217, Od. 9.98, Od. 14.27, etc.

div.head: b
div.p: Under compulsion of circumstances, of necessity, perforce: φεύγοντας Il. 11.150. Cf. Il. 12.178, Il. 14.128, Il. 15.133, etc.: ἄγρην ἐφέπεσκον Od. 12.330. Cf. Od. 13.307, Od. 15.311.
3 sing. aor. pass. ἀνεγνάμφθη Il. 3.348, Il. 7.259, Il. 17.44.
To bend back: ἀνεγνάμφθη αἰχμή Il. 3.348 = Il. 7.259 = Il. 17.44.
To cause to go or take inland Od. 14.272 = Od. 17.441.
Of bringing to Troy Il. 3.48, Il. 6.292, Il. 9.338, Il. 13.627.
Of taking from Ithaca to the mainland Od. 18.115.
Of bringing gifts to temples Il. 8.203.
Of conducting to a house: ὅνδε δόμονδε Od. 3.272.

To
bring up to the mark in a contest Od. 18.89.
In mid., to put to sea, sail Il. 1.478: Od. 19.202.
A woman's head-dress, app. in the form of a plaited band Il. 22.469.
To receive, catch: σάκος πολλὰ [δούρατα] Il. 5.619.
To receive as one's portion Od. 17.563.
To rise up or emerge from out of.
With genit.: ἁλός Il. 1.359. Cf. Od. 5.337.
Absol., to come to the surface Od. 5.322.
Absol., to draw back, flinch Od. 9.377.
[app. for ἀνέϝεδνος fr. ἀν- 1 + ἔϝεδνα. See ἕδνα, ἔεδνα.]
Of a wrestler hoisting his adversary Il. 23.724, 725, 729.
To take up, pick up Il. 23.614, 778.
An accompaniment or accessory: δαιτός Od. 1.152, Od. 21.430.
To leap or bound up. Of a stone: ἀναθρῴσκων πέτεται Il. 13.140.
Careless of the good opinion of others, lost to all sense of decency, shameless, reckless Od. 1.254, Od. 13.376, Od. 17.449, Od. 20.29, 39, 386, Od. 23.37.
Of a stone or rock, reckless, careless of what mischief or trouble may ensue Il. 4.521. Cf. Il. 13.139 (as if the rock lent itself to the discharge of the stone): Od. 11.598.
Of κυδοιμός figured as a symbol: ἀναιδέα δηϊοτῆτος (app., shamelessly insatiate of . . .) Il. 5.593.
Infin. ἀνήνασθαι Il. 7.93: Od. 4.651, Od. 14.239, Od. 18.287. (ἀπ-.)
To refuse: δόσιν (i.e. to give it) Od. 4.651, Od. 18.287.
With infin.: λοιγὸν ἀμῦναι Il. 18.450. Cf. Il. 18.500, Il. 23.204.
So in reference to a course proposed: ἔργον ἀεικές Od. 3.265.
To refuse to have to do with (a person) Od. 8.212.
To refuse to entertain an idea; hence, to deny: ἀασάμην, οὐδʼ ἀναίνομαι Il. 9.116.
To refuse to entertain expectation Od. 14.149.
Aor. pple. ἀνελών, -όντος Il. 1.301, Il. 23.551, 736: Od. 3.453, Od. 18.16.
Mid. Fut. infin. ἀναιρήσεσθαι Od. 21.261, Od. 22.9.
To take or pick up Il. 23.551: Od. 18.16.
To take up into the hands or arms.
In mid.: οὐλοχύτας ἀνέλοντο Il. 1.449, Il. 2.410. Cf. Il. 16.8, 10.
To take up and, or in order to, carry off or appropriate: τῶν οὐκ ἄν τι φέροις ἀνελών Il. 1.301.
To take up and carry off (prizes) Il. 23.736.
In mid.: ὅτε κούρας ἀνέλοντο Od. 20.66.
To lift up or raise: ἀπὸ χθονός (i.e. the victim's head) Od. 3.453.
In mid., to take for one's use: ἀνείλετʼ ἔγχος Il. 13.296.
To take upon oneself, undertake: πατρὸς ἀέθλια Od. 21.117.
To take into one's mind: ἐπιφροσύνας Od. 19.22.
Pple. ἀναΐξας, -αντος Il. 1.584, Il. 15.6, Il. 23.733, etc.: Od. 1.410, Od. 8.186, Od. 21.300, etc.

To start, spring or dart up, rise quickly or suddenly: πάντες ἀνήϊξαν Il. 15.86, Il. 23.203. Cf. Il. 1.584, Il. 4.114, Il. 7.106, Il. 15.6, Il. 23.733, Il. 24.621: ἀναΐξας οἴχεται Od. 1.410. Cf. Od. 8.186, 361, Od. 9.288, Od. 13.197, Od. 18.40, Od. 19.31, Od. 21.119, 300, Od. 22.240, Od. 24.50, 463.

p.gloss: To rush or spring on to.

div.p: Of springs, to gush forth Il. 22.148.
To rise to speak Il. 3.216 (the notion of quickness not here to be pressed).
Not blameworthy, blameless Il. 20.297: Od. 20.135, Od. 22.356.
To gush up, ooze forth: αἷμα Il. 7.262, ἱδρώς Il. 13.705, Il. 23.507.
To push back, open (a door) Od. 22.156.
To remove (something covering): νέφος Il. 5.751 = Il. 8.395.
App. (perh. in imitation of these lines), to suspend or delay the action of (an ambush): ἀνακλῖναι λόχον Od. 11.525.
To cause to lean (against something): ποτὶ ἑρκίον αὐλῆς Od. 18.103.
To place or rest in a specified position Il. 4.113.
In aor. pple. pass., leaning or bending back Od. 9.371.
Of rowers swinging back to their work Od. 13.78.
To lift up one's voice, speak Od. 14.467.
Of a king or chief Od. 15.397.
[app. ἀνα- 6 + *κυμβαλιάζω in sim. sense fr. κύμβαλον, cymbal.]
Thus, of chariots, to rattle (in upsetting) Il. 16.379.

Acc. masc. ἄναλκιν Od. 3.375. Incapable of offering defence or resistance, spiritless, cowardly Il. 2.201, Il. 5.331, 349, Il. 8.153, Il. 11.390, Il. 13.104, Il. 16.355, Il. 21.555, etc.: Od. 3.310, 375, Od. 4.334 = Od. 17.125, Od. 9.475.
[prob. for ἄναλδτος fr. ἀν- 1 + ἀλδ-, ἀλδαίνω, ἀλδήσκω.]
Thus, not to be filled out, insatiable, greedy: γαστέρα Od. 17.228, Od. 18.364.
To loose, set free: ἐκ δεσμῶν (from . . .) Od. 12.200.
To undo, take down (a web) Od. 2.105 = Od. 24.140, Od. 2.109 = Od. 24.145, Od. 19.150.
[ἀνα- 6 + μάσσω, to handle, conn. with μαίομαι.]
To wipe away the stain of (a crime) Od. 19.92.
To wait for, await: Ἠῶ Od. 19.342.
To measure one's way again, retrace one's course.
With acc. of terminus ad quem: χάρυβδιν Od. 12.428.
To remind (a person of a thing).
To wait for, await: ἀλλήλους Il. 11.171.
Absol., to stand one's ground Il. 16.363.
Contr. aor. pple. ἀμμείξας, ἀμμίξας Il. 24.529.
To mix up or mingle: σίτῳ φάρμακα (with . . .) Od. 10.235.
To seethe or boil up Od. 12.238.
To throw up the chin in token of refusal (cf. κατανεύω) Il. 6.311 (app. the statue is supposed to move its head).
With infin. of what is refused: σόον ἀπονέεσθαι Il. 16.252.
To make the motion in prohibition Il. 22.205: Od. 21.129.
[app. a nonce-word formed fr. ἀνά by adding a termination fr. ἔναντα, ἐσάντα.]
Voc. (besides ἄναξ) ἄνα Il. 3.351, Il. 16.233: Od. 17.354.
A king (the main notion being app. that of a protecting chief rather than that of a ruler; cf. the name Ἀστυάναξ Il. 6.403, and the reason for it there given. But βουληφόρος ἀ. occurs Il. 12.414).

div.head: a
div.p: ἀ. ἀνδρῶν (app. much like ποιμὴν λαῶν) applied to Agamemnon, gen. as a title, but sometimes as a descriptive term Il. 1.7, 172, 442, 506, Il. 2.402, 434, etc.: Od. 8.77, Od. 11.397 = Od. 24.121.
So ἀ. alone Il. 2.284, 360, Il. 9.33.–ἀ. ἀνδρῶν applied also to Anchises Il. 5.268.
Sim. πολέεσσʼ ἄνδρεσσιν ἄνακτα of Ortilochus Il. 5.546.
And applied by Idomeneus to himself Il. 13.452.

div.head: b
div.p: ἀ. applied to Priam Il. 2.373, Il. 4.18, Il. 6.451, etc.: Od. 3.107.
Applied to kings or chiefs generally: ἅρματα ἀνάκτων Il. 2.777: ἀνάκτων παῖδες Od. 13.223.
To the leader of a ship's company Od. 11.71.
With a local word: πύλοιο Il. 2.77. Cf. Il. 6.173.

div.head: c
div.p: ἀ. applied to gods. To Apollo Il. 1.36, 75, 390, etc.: Od. 8.323, 334, 339.

A lord, master, owner: οὐδʼ ἠγνοίησαν ἄνακτα Il. 13.28, τί δόμεν πηλῆϊ ἄνακτι (to P. as your master) Il. 17.443. Cf. Il. 10.559, Il. 13.38, Il. 15.453, Il. 16.371, 507, Il. 18.417, 421, Il. 23.417 = 446, 517, Il. 24.734: οἴκοιο ἀ. Od. 1.397, οὔτε ἀ. οὔτε ποιμήν Od. 4.87. Cf. Od. 9.440, Od. 10.216, Od. 14.8, 139, 170, Od. 17.186, 320, etc.
3 sing. impf. ἀνέῳγε Il. 16.221, Il. 24.228. Cont. ἀνῷγε Il. 14.168.
To draw back (a bar in order to open a door) κληῗδα Il. 14.168, Il. 24.455.
3 sing. aor. pass. ἀνέπαλτο Il. 8.85, Il. 23.694.
To poise and sway (a spear before throwing) Il. 3.355 = Il. 5.280 = Il. 7.244 = Il. 11.349 = Il. 17.516 = Il. 22.273 = 289, Il. 20.438: Od. 24.519 = 522.
In pass., to leap or spring up: ἀναπάλλεται ἰχθύς Il. 23.692. Cf. Il. 8.85, Il. 23.694.
To cause to cease: ἔργων ἀνθρώπους ἀνέπαυσεν (from . . .) Il. 17.550.
Acc. fem. pf. pple. pass. ἀναπεπταμένας.
To fulfil (one's destiny), have full measure of (misery etc.): πότμον Il. 4.170, Il. 11.263. Cf. Il. 8.34 = 354 = 465, Il. 15.132: κήδεα Od. 5.207. Cf. Od. 5.302.
Fut. infin. in mid. form ἀναπλεύσεσθαι Il. 11.22.
To sail upwards. Of a voyage from Greece to Troy Il. 11.22.

A breathing-space, a respite: ὀλίγη δέ τʼ ἀ. πολέμοιο (a little (space of time) serves as a respite from . . .) Il. 11.801 = Il. 16.43 = Il. 18.201 (ὀλίγη assimilated in gender to the predicate; cf. Il. 13.237 under ἀρετή 1).
To breathe again, recover breath, draw breath, find a breathing-space or respite Il. 11.327, 800 = Il. 16.42 = Il. 18.200, Il. 16.111, 302, Il. 21.534, Il. 22.222.
With genit.: κακότητος (from . . .) Il. 11.382. Cf. Il. 15.235, Il. 19.227.
In neut. ἀνάποινον as adv., without ransom Il. 1.99.
To cause (tears) to well up Il. 9.433: Od. 2.81.
To fasten up (as an offering in a temple) Od. 3.274.
To tie, make fast (a rope): πρυμνήσια Od. 9.137. Cf. Od. 12.51 = 162, 179.
To fasten (blame) upon a person Od. 2.86.
Absol. in neut. pl.: ἀνάπυστα θεοὶ θέσαν (caused discovery to be made) Od. 11.274.
To snatch up and carry off Il. 9.564, Il. 16.437.
To carry off as a slave Od. 15.427.
To split, cause to open: γαῖαν Il. 20.63.
To tear open, rend: βοείην Il. 18.582.
3 pl. aor. ἀνέρριψαν Od. 10.130. From ἀναρριπτέω
To throw up (the sea with the oar): ἅλα πηδῷ Od. 7.328, Od. 13.78.
[ἀν- 1 + ἀρ-, ἀραρίσκω. Not fitted, ill-fitted, ill-assorted.]
Unfriendly, hostile Il. 24.365: Od. 10.459, Od. 11.401, 408, Od. 24.111.
In mid., to spirt up: αἷμα Il. 11.458.
To draw forth again: ἔγχος Il. 13.574.
Queen, protectress. Applied to Demeter Il. 14.326.
In voc. addressed to Athene Od. 3.380.
Aor. infin. mid. -ασθαι Od. 3.245 (in mid. only here).
To be king, chief or ruler: μετὰ τριτάτοισιν Il. 1.252. Cf. Il. 4.61 = Il. 18.366, Il. 16.172, Il. 23.471: Od. 7.23, 62, Od. 19.110.
In mid.: τρὶς ἀνάξασθαι γένεʼ ἀνδρῶν (app., during three generations) Od. 3.245.
With local words: ἐν Βουδείῳ Il. 16.572. Cf. Od. 11.276, 284, Od. 24.26.
To be king or chief of or ruler over.

div.head: a
div.p: With genit.: Ἀργείων Il. 10.33. Cf. Od. 11.276.
With local words: Ἰλίου Il. 6.478. Cf. Od. 3.304, Od. 4.602, Od. 17.443.

div.head: b
div.p: With local words: πολλῇσιν νήσοισιν Il. 2.108.
In pass., to be ruled by, be under the sway of.
With dat.: ἀνάσσονται ἐμοὶ αὐτῷ Od. 4.177.
To be lord or master of, possess, enjoy.

div.head: b
div.p: With dat.: κτήμασιν οἶσιν Od. 1.117. Cf. Od. 1.402, Od. 4.93.
Standing up: δειδέχατʼ ἀ. Il. 9.671, ἴδεσθʼ ἀ. Il. 23.469.
To groan aloud over, lament, bewail Il. 23.211.
Contr. 3 pl. aor. opt. ἀνστρέψειαν Il. 23.436.
In mid., to go about over, find oneself in.
With acc.: ἄλλην τινὰ γαῖαν ἀναστρέφομαι Od. 13.326.
To keep turning about: τόξον ἐνώμα ἀναστρωφῶν Od. 21.394.
To cause to spring up or be produced: ἀμβροσίην Il. 5.777.
To withstand the operation of Od. 10.327.
In mid., to fall supine Il. 6.64, Il. 14.447.
To run up, shoot up (like a quickly growing plant) Il. 18.56 = 437.
Of welts, to start up Il. 23.717.
To run, stretch, extend up: πέτρη Od. 5.412, Od. 10.4.
To run back, retire Il. 11.354, Il. 16.813.
Absol.: ἷσος ἀναύδῳ (like a dumb man) Od. 10.378.
To make a display of: ἀρετήν Il. 20.411.
In pass., to appear, be seen: οἷος ἀναφαίνεται ἀστήρ Il. 11.62. Cf. Od. 10.29.
Of destruction, to be manifested, come upon one Il. 11.174, Il. 17.244.
Openly, without concealment: ἀ. φιλεῦντας Od. 3.221. Cf. Od. 3.222, Od. 11.455.
= ἀναφανδά.: ἀ. ὄπυιεν (as her avowed husband) Il. 16.178.
To bring or fetch up Od. 11.625.
In mid., to fetch a sigh Il. 19.314.
Aor. pple. ἀναχασσάμενος, -η Il. 7.264, Il. 13.740, Il. 21.403: Od. 7.280, Od. 11.97.
To go back, return Il. 10.210 = 411, Il. 13.457.
To draw back from danger Il. 3.35.
Of hounds retreating from a boar Il. 17.729.
To draw back or retire in fight Il. 4.305, Il. 5.107, Il. 11.189, 440, Il. 17.30, Il. 20.196, 335: Od. 22.270.
Fig.: ἐπεὶ ἀνέψυχθεν ἦτορ Il. 10.575. Cf. Il. 13.84.
To cool or soothe (a wound) Il. 5.795.
3 sing. aor. εὔαδε (ἔϝαδε) Il. 14.340, Il. 17.647: Od. 16.28. ἅδε (ϝάδε) Il. 12.80, Il. 13.748: Od. 24.465.
Acc. sing. masc. pf. pple. ἑαδότα (ϝεϝαδότα) Il. 9.173: Od. 18.422. (ἀφ-, ἐπι-.)
To please, be pleasing or acceptable, find favour or acceptance Od. 5.153, Od. 17.173.
With dat.: ἐπεί τοι εὔαδεν οὕτως Il. 17.647. Cf. Il. 1.24 = 378, Il. 24.25: Od. 3.143, Od. 10.373.
With dat. and infin.: Αἴαντι ἑστάμεν Il. 15.674. Cf. Od. 6.245.
So ὥς τοι εὔαδε, . . . ἐσορᾶν . . . Od. 16.28.
In pf. pple., pleasing, agreeable Il. 9.173: = Od. 18.422.
In two, asunder: κεάσθη Il. 16.412 = Il. 20.387, Il. 16.578.
In halves, equally: δάσασθαι Il. 18.511, Il. 22.120.
Spoils of a man, i.e. of a fallen foe Il. 14.509.
That is a load for a man, as heavy as a man can carry Od. 10.121.
[prob. rather ἆδριφόντης, fr. ἀδρ-, ἀνδρ-, ἀνήρ + φον-, *φένω. Cf. ἀνδροτής.]
Epithet of Enyalius Il. 2.651, Il. 7.166 = Il. 8.264 = Il. 17.259.
Made by the hands of man, the work of men's hands Il. 11.371.

p.gloss: Slaughter of men, slaughter in battle.

div.p: In pl.: παύσασαι ἀνδροκτασιάων Il. 5.909. Cf. Il. 7.237, Il. 24.548: Od. 11.612.
In concrete sense: ὕπαγʼ ἐξ ἀνδροκτασίης Il. 11.164.
Of man, human Il. 11.538 (the throng of men), Il. 17.571, Il. 20.100, Il. 21.70: Od. 9.297 (of man's flesh), Od. 9.347, Od. 9.374, Od. 22.19.
[prob. rather ἆδροτής, fr. ἀδρ-, ἀνδρ-, ἀνήρ. Cf. ἀνδρειφόντης.]
Manslaying, fatal: χεῖρας Il. 18.317 = Il. 23.18, Il. 24.479.
Of a poisonous application, deadly Od. 1.261.
To wake up, cause to rise, rouse Il. 10.138, 157: Od. 4.730, Od. 10.172, Od. 23.16, 22.
To keep back, restrain: φάλαγγας Il. 3.77 = Il. 7.55, μάχην Τρώων Il. 17.752.
Pl. pple. ἀνέσαντες Il. 13.657. In the forms cited
To set or place upon something: ἐς δίφρον Il. 13.657.
To restore to one's place Od. 18.265.
Of the sun, to rise: ἠελίου ἀνιόντος Il. 8.538. Cf. Il. 18.136, Il. 22.135: Αἰθίοπες ἀνιόντος Ὑπερίονος (dwelling in the east) Od. 1.24. Cf. Od. 12.429, Od. 23.362.
To go up (to a person) as a suppliant: ἐς πατρὸς ἑταίρους Il. 22.492.
To ask, inquire, make inquiry Il. 21.508: Od. 7.21, Od. 23.99.
To inquire, about: τήνδε γαῖαν Od. 13.238.
To question (a person): σε Od. 4.420. Cf. Od. 4.461, 631.
With double acc.: ὅ μʼ ἀνείρεαι Il. 3.177: = Od. 7.243 = Od. 15.402, Od. 19.171. Cf. Od. 1.231 = Od. 15.390.
Bearable, endurable, to be endured Il. 1.573, Il. 10.118, Il. 11.610: Od. 20.83.
Absol. in neut. pl.: οὐκέτʼ ἀνεκτὰ πέλονται (my case is now unendurable) Od. 20.223.
In such wise as may be endured: μαίνεται οὐκέτʼ ἀ. Il. 8.355. Cf. Od. 9.350.
To draw back (i.e. away from one): τόξου πῆχυν Il. 11.375, Il. 13.583.
To draw back (a spear in order to recover it).
With pl.: οἱ δʼ ἄνεμοι ἔβαν (they, the winds mentioned) Il. 23.229: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων Od. 5.383.
Joined with Βορέης Il. 15.26: Od. 9.67, Od. 14.253, 299, Od. 19.200.
Protecting from the wind: χλαινάων Il. 16.224.
Of a wave, fed (i. e. raised) by the wind Il. 15.625.
Of a spear, (made of wood) toughened by (the buffeting of) the wind Il. 11.256.
Like the idle blowing of the wind, idle, vain: ταῦτʼ ἀνεμώλια βάζεις (what you say is idle) Il. 4.355.–
Useless, idle: τόξα Il. 5.216. Cf. Il. 21.474.
To go up (to a city): ἄστυδε Od. 19.190. –Of a plant, to shoot up Od. 6.163, 167.
To come back, return Il. 4.392, Il. 6.187: Od. 1.317.
To question (a person): ἀνηρώτων μιν Od. 4.251.
Unworthy to have a home: ἀφρήτωρ ἀθέμιστος ἀ. Il. 9.63.
Away from, aloof from: δηΐων Il. 13.556.
Without the help of: ἕθεν Il. 17.407.
Without the good will or permission of: ἐμέθεν Il. 15.213. Cf. Od. 2.372, Od. 15.531.

div.head: b
div.p: Away, removed: πολλὸν ἀ. Il. 23.378. Cf. Od. 4.356, Od. 19.575.

div.head: c
div.p: Apart, aside, aloof: ἀ. ἔθηκεν Il. 22.368. Cf. Il. 23.241, Il. 24.208: Od. 9.26, Od. 11.82.

div.head: c
div.p: Apart or aloof from: ἄλλων Il. 22.39. Cf. Od. 10.554.

div.head: e
div.p: Without the help of: ἐμεῖο Il. 16.89. Cf. Il. 16.239.
Without the good will or permission of: θεοῦ Il. 5.185.

div.head: f
div.p: App., in the background as regards, ready to take the place of: τοῖο ἀ. λελείμμην Il. 22.333.
To spring up against a person Il. 20.424.
3 sing. aor. ἀνασχέμεν Il. 24.301. ἀνασχεῖν Il. 6.257.
To hold up, lift up: σκῆπτρον (to the gods in testimony) Il. 7.412, ὑψόσε (as an offering) Il. 10.461. Cf. Il. 14.499, Il. 20.278, Il. 22.80: χεῖρας Od. 18.89. Cf. Od. 4.115 = 154, Od. 22.297.
To project, appear: αἰχμὴ παρʼ ὦμον Il. 17.310.
To come to the surface, emerge Od. 5.320.
To hold up, lift up: σκῆπτρον ἀνάσχεο (in testimony) Il. 10.321. Cf. Il. 12.138: Od. 18.100.
To lift the hand Il. 3.362, Il. 22.34: Od. 14.425.
Of boxers, to square up Il. 23.660, 686: Od. 18.95.
To endure, have laid upon one, suffer: κήδεα Il. 18.430. Cf. Il. 24.518: Od. 13.307, Od. 23.302.
To endure, stand, withstand the action of: χαλκόν Il. 4.511. Cf. Il. 5.104, Il. 15.470.
To endure, submit to: δουλοσύνην Od. 22.423.
To suffer the presence or company of, bear with: ξείνους Od. 7.32. Cf. Od. 17.13.
With acc. in complementary ppl. clause: οὔ σʼ ἀνέξομαι ἄλγεʼ ἔχοντα Il. 5.895. Cf. Od. 19.27.
To endure, hold up, hold out: δηρόν Il. 5.285. Cf. Od. 11.375.
With complementary ppl. clause: καί κʼ εἰς ἐνιαυτὸν παρὰ σοί γʼ ἀνεχοίμην ἥμενος Od. 4.595.
To accept what happens, submit with patience: ἀνάσχεο Il. 1.586. Cf. Il. 5.382, Il. 24.549.
With complementary pple.: εἰσορόων ἀνέχεσθαι Od. 16.277.
To restrain oneself, be placated: ἄνσχεο Il. 23.587.
[the former app a nom. pl. masc. fr. an adj. ἄνεως. The latter (only in Od. 23.93 of a woman) app. to be taken as an adv. .]
Silent: ἐγένεσθε Il. 2.323. Cf. Il. 3.84, Il. 9.30 = 695: ἧσθε Od. 2.240. Cf. Od. 7.144, Od. 10.71, Od. 23.93.
Not to be cured or soothed Il. 5.394.
To fail to hearken to, disobey.
[3 sing., in the first passage of a plupf. (with secondary person-ending), in the second of a pf., fr. ἀνεθ- = ἀνθ-, ἄνθος. (Cf. ἐνήνοθε).]
To come to the surface, come forth: αἷμʼ ἀ. Il. 11.266.
To rise up, spread upwards: κνίση ἀ. Od. 17.270.
Not accomplished or brought to an end: ἔργῳ Od. 16.111.
Deprived of virility; or perh. merely, unmanly Od. 10.301, 341.
Genit. ἀνέρος Il. 3.61, Il. 5.649, etc.: Od. 1.161, 218, etc.
Dat. ἀνέρι Il. 16.516, 716, etc.: Od. 1.292, Od. 2.223, etc.
Nom. pl. ἀνέρες Il. 2.1, 604, etc. : Od. 1.176, Od. 3.471, etc.
Dat. ἄνδρεσσι Il. 5.546, 874, etc.: Od. 1.358, Od. 10.120, etc.
Acc. ἀνέρας Il. 1.262, Il. 2.554, etc.: Od. 11.630, Od. 13.261, etc.

div.head: a
div.p: A man in general: ἄναξ ἀνδρῶν Il. 1.7, περὶ ἀνδρῶν (beyond all men) Il. 21.215. Cf. Il. 2.198, Il. 3.429, Il. 5.37, Il. 9.197, etc.: ἄνδρα μοι ἔννεπε Od. 1.1, ἄνδρες ἂψ ἐγένοντο Od. 10.395. Cf. Od. 2.91, Od. 4.363, Od. 8.223, Od. 9.494, etc.

div.head: c
div.p: Quasi-pronominal = one, anyone: ὅσσον ἀ. ἴδεν Il. 5.770. Cf. Il. 4.539, Il. 19.183, Il. 20.97, etc.: νεμεσσήσαιτό κεν ἀ. Od. 1.228. Cf. Od. 3.231, Od. 8.139, Od. 15.400, etc.

div.head: d
div.p: With a qualifying sb.: ἀ. βουληφόρος (a councillor) Il. 1.144, αἰπόλοι ἄνδρες (goatherds) Il. 2.474. Cf. Il. 3.170, Il. 4.187, Il. 6.315, Il. 9.524, etc.: ἀοιδὸς ἀ. Il. 20.267. Cf. Od. 8.584, Od. 9.126, Od. 14.102, Od. 15.427, etc.

div.head: e
div.p: With a proper name (cf. φώς 2): ἀνέρος λαομέδοντος Il. 5.649. Cf. Il. 11.92: Od. 7.22.

div.head: f
div.p: With ethnic words: Σίντιες ἄνδρες (the Sintians) Il. 1.594. Cf. Il. 3.6, Il. 5.779, Il. 10.487, etc.: Φοῖνιξ ἀ. (a Phoenician) Od. 14.288. Cf. Od. 3.31, Od. 6.3, Od. 14.263, etc.

div.head: a
div.p: A man as distinguished from a woman: πόλεμος ἄνδρεσσι μελήσει Il. 6.492. Cf. Il. 7.139, Il. 9.134, Il. 24.707, etc.: Od. 1.358, Od. 4.142, Od. 7.74, etc.

div.head: c
div.p: A man as distigusihed from a god: Διὸς ἄγγελοι ἠδὲ καὶ ἀνδρῶν Il. 1.334. Cf. Il. 1.544, Il. 5.128, Il. 13.632, etc.: Ἀθήνη ἀνδρὶ ἐϊκυῖα Od. 8.194. Cf. Od. 1.28, Od. 13.112, Od. 16.265, etc.
With words indicative of mortality: βροτός Il. 5.361, Il. 18.85, etc.: Od. 4.397, Od. 5.129, etc.– θνητός Il. 10.403, Il. 16.441, etc.: Od. 10.306, Od. 16.196.– καταθνητός Il. 10.441.

div.head: d
div.p: A man as distinguished from a youth: ἤδη ἀ. [ἐστιν] Od. 19.160. Cf. Od. 11.449.

div.head: e
div.p: With words indicative of youthfulness, a youth: νέου ἀνδρός Il. 23.589. Cf. Il. 3.108: Od. 2.188, Od. 3.24, Od. 14.524, Od. 21.310, etc.

div.head: f
div.p: A man in the full sense of the term: ἀνέρες ἔστε (quit you like men) Il. 5.529, Il. 6.112, Od. 8.174, Il. 15.561, etc.
[No doubt for ἀνηρέψαντο, fr. ἀν-, ἀνα- 1 + ἁρεπ- = ἁρπ-, ἁρπάζω. Cf. ἅρπη, Ἅρπυια.]
Thus, to snatch up: Γανυμήδεα ἀ. θεοί Il. 20.234. Cf. Od. 1.241 = Od. 14.371, Od. 4.727, Od. 20.77.
Not growing as the result of tillage Od. 9.109.
Flowery: λειμῶνι Il. 2.467. Cf. Il. 2.695: Od. 12.159.
Adorned with flower-like ornaments Il. 23.885: Od. 3.440, Od. 24.275.
[ἀνθέω. The part on which the beard grows.]
App., the stalk of corn: ἐπʼ ἀνθερίκων καρπὸν θέον (the ears of the corn) Il. 20.227.
Of hair on the face, to sprout, grow: πρὶν ἰούλους ἀνθῆσαι Od. 11.320.
The product of flowers, consisting of fruit: εἶδαρ Od. 9.84.

3 pl. impf. mid. ἀνθίσταντο Il. 16.305. In
aor. and mid., to face in fight.
Absol., to make a stand Il. 16.305.
The characteristic flower of a plant: φάρμακον γάλακτι εἴκελον ἀ. (having a milk-white flower) Od. 10.304.
In collective sense, flowers, blossom: βρύει ἄνθεϊ λευκῷ Il. 17.56. Cf. Od. 7.126.
Fig.: ἔχει ἥβης ἀ. (is in the flower of his youth) Il. 13.484.

div.head: a
div.p: A human being, a man (seldom in sing. and never of a particular man): ἐσσομένοισι μετʼ ἀνθρώποισιν Il. 3.287, μυὼν ἀνθρώπου Il. 16.315. Cf. Il. 6.14, Il. 9.134, Il. 10.213, Il. 13.733, etc.: πολλῶν ἀνθρώπων ἄστεα Od. 1.3, ὃς ἀνθρώπους ἐκέκαστο (all men) Od. 19.395. Cf. Od. 19.395. Cf. Od. 1.183, Od. 3.48, Od. 6.259, Od. 7.23, etc.

div.head: b
div.p: Mankind, man: οὐδὲν ἀκιδνότερον ἀνθρώπου Od. 18.130.

div.head: c
div.p: Quasi-pronominal = one, anyone: ὅ κε στυγέῃσιν ἰδὼν ἀ. ἔχοντά [σε] Od. 13.400.

div.head: d
div.p: With a qualifying sb.: ἀ. ὁδίτης Il. 16.263. Cf. Il. 24.202: Od. 7.32, Od. 13.123.

Specifically, a man as distinguished from a god: οὔτε θεῶν οὔτʼ ἀνθρώπων Il. 1.548. Cf. Il. 2.669, Il. 5.442, Il. 6.180, Il. 8.27, etc.: νέμεσις ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἔσσεται Od. 2.136. Cf. Od. 13.110, Od. 14.179, Od. 20.112, Od. 22.346, etc.
With words indicative of mortality: θνητός Il. 1.339, Il. 14.199, etc.: Od. 1.219, Od. 5.32, etc.– καταθνητός Il. 6.123: Od. 3.114, Od. 9.502, etc.
To be overcome by distress or pain Il. 21.270: Od. 22.87.
To be oppressed, feel hampered (by the possession of something): κτεάτεσσιν Il. 18.300.
To make oneself a nuisance Od. 19.66, Od. 20.178.
In pass., to become disgusted or disheartened: ἀνιηθέντα νέεσθαι Il. 2.291.
To become disgusted or wearied: ὀρυμαγδῷ Od. 1.133.
To become wearied or impatient Od. 3.117.
To be wearied or annoyed: οὔτις ἀνιᾶται παρεόντι (by your being here) Od. 15.335.
Without sweat, i.e. without conflict: οὔ κεν ἀ. γε τελέσθη Il. 15.228.
A bad thing for one Od. 15.394, Od. 20.52.
Pl. pple. ἀνέντες Il. 5.761. From ἀνιέω
3 sing. impf. ἀνίει Il. 15.24. ἀνί̄ει Od. 8.359.
Fem. pres. pple. mid. ἀνιεμένη Il. 22.80.
To send up, cause to ascend: καπνόν Il. 21.523.
To cause to flow up: [ὕδωρ] Od. 12.105.
To stir up, set on, urge, incite, impel: σοὶ ἔπι τοῦτον Il. 5.405. Cf. Il. 5.761, Il. 7.25, Il. 10.389, Il. 16.691, Il. 17.705, Il. 21.395, 545: Od. 2.185.
To cause (a wind) to blow Od. 4.568.
To loose (a bond) Od. 8.359.– To loose the fastenings of: πύλας Il. 21.537.
To relax hold upon, leave in peace: θυμὸν ὀδύνη Il. 15.24.– Of sleep, to leave, depart from Il. 2.34, 71: Od. 7.289, Od. 18.199, Od. 19.551, Od. 24.440.
In mid., to loose, allow to fall away (a part of one's dress): κόλπον Il. 22.80.
App. by development of this sense, to take off the skin of, flay: αἶγας Od. 2.300.
Troublesome, tiresome: πτωχόν Od. 17.220. Cf. Od. 17.377.
In comp. in impers. construction: αὐτῷ οἱ ἀνιηρέστερον ἔσται (the worse for him) Od. 2.190.

div.head: B
div.p: Pple. ἀνιστάμενος, -ου Il. 1.58, Il. 9.52, Il. 19.55: Od. 3.341.

div.head: I
div.p: In impf. act. and the other forms (A)
To cause to rise or stand up: γέροντʼ ἀνίστη Il. 24.515. Cf. Od. 7.163, 170, Od. 14.319.
To cause (a people) to migrate Od. 6.7.
To rouse from sleep Il. 10.32, 176, 179, Il. 24.689.
To raise from the dead Il. 24.551, 756.
To cause to take action, rouse to action Il. 15.64, Il. 18.358.

div.head: II
div.p: In mid. and the other forms (B)
To rise or stand up: πάτροκλος ἀνέστη Il. 9.195. Cf. Il. 18.410, Il. 24.597: Od. 5.195, Od. 18.157 = Od. 21.139 = 166 = Od. 23.164, Od. 21.243 = 392.
To rise up in token of respect Il. 1.533.
Of a beast, to stand on its hind legs Od. 10.215.
To rise up with a view to action: ἀνστάντες ἔφερον Il. 23.848. Cf. Od. 3.341, Od. 4.674 = Od. 16.407, Od. 4.776, Od. 8.258, Od. 12.170, 195, Od. 16.358, Od. 17.177, Od. 18.47, Od. 19.357.
To rise at the close of an assembly Il. 1.305, Il. 2.398.
At the close of judicial business Od. 12.439.

To rise from bed or from sleep Il. 10.55, Il. 14.336,
Il. 24.11: Od. 15.58, 96, Od. 20.124.
To rise from the dead Il. 21.56.
As if from the dead Il. 15.287.
To rouse oneself to action Il. 2.694, Il. 18.305.
To stand up to take part in a contest Il. 23.709, 886: Od. 4.343 = Od. 17.134, Od. 21.144.
To stand up as a volunteer champion Il. 7.161.
To stand up (to another) in a fight, etc. Il. 23.635, 677: Od. 18.334.
To lift up (the hands) in prayer: χεῖρας ἀνίσχοντες Od. 8.347 = Il. 15.369.
[ἀν-, ἀνα- 6 + ἰχνεύω, to trace, fr. ἴχνος.]
To trace or hunt out Il. 22.192.
Of the sun, to rise Od. 10.192.
[app. neut. pl. as adv. of an adj. ἀνοπαῖος fr. ἄνω2; or poss. of such an adj. fr. ἀ-1 + ὀπ-. See ὁράω.]
Thus, upwards, or unseen Od. 1.320. (Others write ἀνόπαια, explained as a kind of eagle.)
Of the sun, to rise Od. 3.1.
Cut off from return home: κεῖνον ἀνόστιμον ἔθηκεν Od. 4.182.
Afflicted by no disease: ἀσκηθέες καὶ ἄνουσοι Od. 14.255.
Not wounded (by thrust): ἄβλητος καὶ ἀνούτατος Il. 4.540.
Without inflicting a wound: οὐδέ οἵ τις ἀνουτητὶ παρέστη Il. 22.371.
contr. 2 sing. and imp. aor. mid. ἀνέχω.
To be endured, sufferable: ἀνσχετὰ ἔργα Od. 2.63.
Face to face: μάχεσθαι Il. 19.163, ἀνασχομένω Il. 23.686, θεοῖσιν ἀ. ἐῴκει (when set face to face, when brought into comparison) Il. 24.630. –Facing a person: στῆ Od. 6.141.

div.head: II
div.p: Prep. with genit. (freq. following the case).
Over against, opposite: Ἥλιδος ἀ. Il. 2.626.
In the presence of: ἀ. σέθεν Od. 4.160.
In front of, before: ἀ. παρειάων Od. 1.334 = Od. 16.416 = Od. 18.210 = Od. 21.65. Cf. Od. 4.115 = 154.

p.gloss: Worth, the equal or equivalent of.

div.p: With genit.: πολλῶν ἀ. ἄλλων Il. 11.514.
Absol. in neut. ἀντάξιον, an equivalentIl. 9.401.
With dat.: οἱ Il. 6.399. Cf. Il. 7.423.
To meet a person so as to have knowledge of him Il. 4.375: = Od. 4.201.
With genit., to encounter, come upon: ἔνδον ἐόντων Od. 16.254.
To light or come upon: δαίτης Od. 3.44, ὀπωπῆς 97 = Od. 4.327, Od. 17.44.
To get one's will in the matter of: μάχης Il. 7.158.
With genit., to encounter in fight: τοῦδʼ ἀνέρος Il. 16.423.
[adv. fr. acc. of *ἄντη, conn. with ἀντίος.]
Face to face: ἐσέδρακον ἀ. Il. 24.223. Cf. Il. 15.247, Il. 24.464: Od. 5.77, Od. 8.213.
When set face to face, when brought into comparison: θεῷ ἐναλίγκιος ἀ. Od. 2.5 = Od. 4.310. Cf. Od. 22.240, Od. 24.371.
To one's face: ὁμοιωθήμεναι ἀ. Il. 1.187. Cf. Il. 10.158: Od. 3.120, Od. 8.158.
Facing the foe, man to man: ἀ. ἵστασθε Il. 11.590. Cf. Il. 12.152, Il. 18.307, Il. 22.109.
Straight in front of one: ἀ. εἰσιδέειν Il. 19.15.
Before the eyes of a company: ἀ. οὐκ ἂν λοέσσομαι Od. 6.221.
Into one's view or presence Il. 8.399.
Thus κατʼ ἄντηστιν, opposite: θεμένη δίφρον (i. e. opposite the door of the μέγαρον) Od. 20.387.
Prep. with genit. (sometimes (without anastrophe) following the case).
Instead of, in the place of: Ἕκτορος ἀντί Il. 24.254. Cf. Od. 20.307.
For, in exchange for: τρεῖς ἑνὸς ἀντί Il. 13.447. Cf. Il. 14.471.
As good as, the equivalent of: πολλῶν λαῶν Il. 9.116.
Entitled to the rights of: ἱκέταο Il. 21.75. Cf. Od. 8.546.
In return for: τῶνδʼ ἀντί Il. 23.650. Cf. Od. 22.290.
Epithet of the Amazons Il. 3.189, Il. 6.186.
Acc. sing. fem. pple. ἀντιόωσαν Il. 1.31.
To meet or encounter someone: θεὸν ἀντιάσαντα Il. 10.551: ἱκέτην ἀντιάσαντα (who has met one who can help him) Od. 6.193 = Od. 14.511. Cf. Od. 7.293, Od. 12.88, Od. 13.292, 312, Od. 17.442.
With dat.: ἐμῷ μένει Il. 6.127 = Il. 21.151, Il. 21.431: ἐκείνῳ Od. 18.147.
Of a missile, to reach, strike.
With genit., to take part in: πόνοιο Il. 12.356. Cf. Il. 12.368 = Il. 13.752, Il. 13.215, Il. 20.125, Il. 23.643: ἀέθλων Od. 22.28.

In mid.: ἀντιάασθε γάμου Il. 24.62.–
Of a god, to take part in (a sacrifice): ἑκατόμβης Od. 1.25, ἱρῶν Od. 3.436.
With acc., to come to share: ἐμὸν λέχος Il. 1.31.
Of words, wrangling, jangling Il. 1.304, Il. 2.378: Od. 18.415 = Od. 20.323.
In neut. ἀντίβιον as adv., face to face, man to man: ἀ. μαχέσασθαι Il. 3.20 = Il. 7.40 = 51. Cf. Il. 3.435, Il. 11.386.
Adv. of acc. fem. form ἀντιβίην.

div.head: a
div.p: Face to face, man to man Il. 5.220.

div.head: b
div.p: To one's face: ἐριζέμεναι βασιλῆϊ ἀ. Il. 1.278.
To meet or encounter someone: θεὸς ἀντιβολήσας Il. 10.546. Cf. Il. 24.375: Od. 6.275, Od. 7.16.
With dat.: τούτῳ Il. 7.114. Cf. Il. 16.847: Od. 22.360.
To come to, fall to the lot of.
With genit.: μάχης Il. 4.342 = Il. 12.316: τάφου Od. 4.547.

Like the gods. A vague general epithet of commendation Il. 4.88, Il. 5.663, Il. 9.623, Il. 11.140, Il. 14.322, Il. 23.360, etc.: Od. 1.21, Od. 4.571, Od. 6.241, Od. 11.117, Od. 14.18 (here merely conventional), Od. 15.90, etc.
A space opposit a door: στῆ κατʼ ἀντίθυρον κλισίης Od. 16.159 (app., from 165, in a spot opposite the door of the κλισίη and outside the gate of the αὐλή).
With genit., straight against: Ἕκτορος ἀ. Il. 8.301 = 310.
Utterly, completely: ἀπάραξε Il. 16.116. Cf. Il. 23.673, 867.
Straight towards an object: ἀίξας Il. 15.694: Od. 22.90.
To meet persons approaching: ἐξέθορεν Il. 21.539.
In order to meet, join, encounter or intercept a person: ἦλθεν Il. 6.54, Il. 17.257.
With genit.: Ἀγαμέμνονος ἀ. ἐλθών Il. 2.185. Cf. Il. 11.594, Il. 22.113: ἀ. ἦλθεν ἄνακτος Od. 16.14.
With dat.: τῇ δʼ ἀ. ὄρνυτο Il. 7.20.
In hostile sense: ἀ. ἐλθών Il. 20.352.
With genit.: ὅς τις τοῦ γʼ ἀ. ἔλθοι Il. 5.301 = Il. 17.8. Cf. Il. 7.98, Il. 20.371, Il. 21.150.
With dat.: ἀ. οἱ ἦλθεν Il. 15.584. Cf. Il. 20.422.
In order to clasp or seize.
With genit.: ἀ. ἤλυθε γούνων Il. 20.463.
In neut. sing. ἀντίον as adv.

div.head: a
div.p: Opposite, facing: ἷζεν Od. 14.79, Od. 17.96, κατέθηκεν 334.
With genit.: Ὀδυσσῆος Il. 9.218: Od. 5.198, Od. 16.53. Cf. Od. 17.257, Od. 23.165.
Face to face: ἵνʼ ἐνίσπῃ Od. 17.529.

div.head: b
div.p: With genit.: ὅς τις σέθεν ἀ. εἴπῃ Il. 1.230.

div.head: c
div.p: With straight aim Il. 11.553 = Il. 17.662.– Straight before one: ἴδεν Od. 16.160.

div.head: d
div.p: In hostile sense, in order to meet or encounter someone: ἐλθέμεναι Il. 17.67, ἐλθών Il. 19.70.
With genit.: ἀ. εἶμʼ αὐτῶν Il. 5.256. Cf. Il. 7.160, Il. 11.219, 231, Il. 17.69, Il. 20.175.

div.head: e
div.p: In reply: ἀ. ηὔδα Il. 3.203, Il. 4.265, Il. 5.217, etc.: Od. 1.213, 399, Od. 2.242, etc.– Simply in reference to addressing a person: ἔπος μιν ἀ. ηὔδα Il. 5.170. Cf. Il. 8.200, Il. 24.333: Od. 5.28.
In neut. pl. ἀντία as adv.

div.head: a
div.p: Opposite to, facing: Ἀλεξάνδροιο Il. 3.425.– In hostile sense: Πηλεΐωνος Il. 20.88 = Il. 20.333, ἐμεῖο Il. 21.481, σεῖο Il. 22.253.
In the presence of: δεσποίνης Od. 15.377.

div.head: b
div.p: In hostile sense, in order to meet or encounter: ἀ. Πηλεΐωνος Il. 20.80. Cf. Il. 20.113, 118.

div.head: c
div.p: Against the will of. Joined with ἀέκητι. See ἀέκητι 1.
Absol.: τὰ ἀντιπέραια (the opposite coast) Il. 2.635.

p.gloss: To hold up as protection against.

div.p: With genit.: ἀντίσχεσθε τραπέζας ἰῶν Od. 22.74.
To pierce: χρός Il. 5.337 (the genit. app. partitive).
To break into (a house): δόμον Il. 10.267.
Consisting in paying back or requital: ἄντιτα ἔργα (works of vengeance, revenge) Il. 24.213 (for u.l. see τιτός): Od. 17.51 = 60.
With dat.: σοί Il. 21.357, ὅτι μοι μένος ἀντιφερίζεις (in the matter of might) 488.
