To (die and) forget, cease to think of (in death): γάμοιο Od. 3.224. Cf. Od. 22.444.
2 sing. impf. pass. κλέω. See κλείω.
A forgetting: παίδων φόνοιο Od. 24.485 (an amnesty in regard to . . .).

p.gloss: To set free or rescue from.

div.p: With genit.: κακῶν σʼ ἐκλύσομαι Od. 10.286.
αἰχμὴ ἐξελύθη Il. 5.293, app., was disengaged from the flesh.
[ἐκ- 1 + μυζάω, in late Greek, to suck.]
To suck, or perh. rather, to press or squeeze out: αἷμʼ ἐκμυζήσας Il. 4.218.
[perh. for ἔκ-πλαγ-λος, fr. ἐκ- 9 + πλαγ-, πλήσσω.]

p.gloss: In some way striking or remarkable.

div.p: Of persons Il. 21.452 (extraordinarily violent or unreasonable), 589 (wonderful, great).
In superl. Il. 1.146 and Il. 20.389 (most wonderful (derisively)), Il. 18.170 (app., incredibly remiss).
Of words, etc., violent, vehement: ἐπέεσσιν Il. 15.198: Od. 8.77, ἐνιπήν Od. 10.448.
Of a storm, unusually violent Od. 14.522.
In neut. sing. ἔκπαγλον as adv., in striking wise, vehemently, loudly, excessively: ἐπεύξατο Il. 13.413, 445, Il. 14.453, 478, ἀεικιῶ Il. 22.256. Cf. Od. 17.216.
So in pl. ἔκπαγλα, exceedingly, strongly, deeply: φίλησα Il. 3.415. Cf. Il. 5.423.
In striking wise, vehemently, exceedingly, strongly, deeply Il. 1.268, Il. 2.223, 357, Il. 9.238: Od. 5.340, Od. 11.437, 560, Od. 15.355.
To make oneself prominent, attract attention to oneself Il. 5.803.
In pass., app., to throb forth from.
With genit.: μυελὸς σφονδυλίων ἔκπαλτο Il. 20.483.
App., to afflict (in mind): φρένας ἐκπεπαταγμένος ἐσσί (out of your wits, stirred to madness) Od. 18.327.
Aor. imp. pl. mid. ἐκπέμψασθε Od. 20.361.
To send forth or away Il. 24.381: Od. 16.3.
With genit., to send forth from, cause to depart from: πολέμου Il. 21.598.
To turn out of: δώματος Od. 18.336.
3 sing. aor. ἐξεπέρησε Il. 13.652, Il. 16.346: Od. 10.162.
To pass over, traverse: λαῖτμα Od. 7.35, Od. 8.561, Od. 9.323.
Of an arrow or a spear, to make its way, pass Il. 13.652, Il. 16.346: Od. 10.162.

p.gloss: To plunder or carry off from.

div.p: nom. pl. fem. pf. pple. ἐκφύω.
To take a draught, quaff a cup Od. 9.353, 361, Od. 10.237, 318.
In pass., to be drunk up, be consumed: ὅσσα τοι ἐκπέποται Od. 22.56.
To fall out of one's hand: χαμαί οἱ ἔκπεσε κερκίς Il. 22.448.
Of tears, to fall, be shed Il. 2.266: Od. 16.16.
With genit., to fall out of or from: δίφρου Il. 5.585, Il. 13.399, ἵππων Il. 11.179.
To fall out of (one's hand or arms): χειρός Il. 3.363, Il. 4.493, Il. 8.329, Il. 15.421, 465: Od. 14.31, 34, Od. 22.17.
In pass., to be driven out of one's wits, become panic-struck (cf. πλήσσω 2) Il. 18.225.
Of snow-flakes, to fly forth, be shed abroad: νιφάδες ἐκποτέονται Il. 19.357.

p.gloss: To summon and cause to come forward

div.p: Nom. pl. masc. aor. pple. ἐκπρολιπόντες.
To quit...and go forward, to issue from: λόχον Od. 8.515.
To break, cause to snap asunder Il. 15.469.
To carry away, cause to give way: ὁδοῖο (partitive genit., a part of the ...) Il. 23.421.
To save or preserve from impending danger Il. 4.12.

p.gloss: To save or preserve from the power of.

div.p: With genit., to speed forth from: πυλέων Il. 7.1.
Of sleep, to flee away from, forsake: βλεφάρων μοι ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος Od. 12.366.
To issue or gush forth from: φάρυγος οἶνος Od. 9.373.
Nom. dual masc. aor. pple. mid. ἐκσπασσαμένω Il. 7.255.
To draw out, recover (a spear) Il. 6.65.
So in mid.: ἔγχεα (i.e. from the shields in which they were stuck) Il. 7.255.
Thus, capable of being spread out, ample, flowing: χλαῖναν Il. 10.134.
3 sing. aor. ἐξέταμε Il. 4.486. ἔκταμε Od. 9.320.
To cut out (a sacrificial limb), sever (it) by the joint: μηρούς Il. 1.460 = Il. 2.423: = Od. 12.360.
Of a surgeon, to cut out, extract: ἰούς Il. 11.515.

p.gloss: To cut out or extract from.

div.p: To cut from a tree for one's use: ῥόπαλον Od. 9.320.
To cut pieces out of, make incision in: ὕλην Il. 12.149.
To fell (trees) (cf. ἐκβάλλω 2) Il. 4.486, Il. 13.391 = Il. 16.484.
To cut out, shape: νήϊον Il. 3.62.
To stretch out, cause to lie stretched out Il. 11.844, Il. 24.18.
To stretch out, lay low Il. 17.58.
In pass., to be laid low: ὕπτιος ἐξετανύσθη Il. 7.271.
3 pl. impf. pass. ἐξετελεῦντο Od. 11.294, Od. 14.293.

To bring to completion, carry through, carry out, bring about, accomplish, perform: ἔργον Od. 3.99 = Od. 4.329. Cf. Il. 7.353, Il. 18.79, Il. 23.96: Od. 3.275, Od. 4.7, Od. 8.22, Od. 10.41, Od. 11.280, Od. 21.135, 180 = 268, Od. 22.5.
Absol. Od. 10.27 (his aid was vain), Od. 11.317 (would have succeeded).
In pass., to come to pass, happen. Impers.: ὧδʼ ἐκτελέεσθαι ὀΐομαι (thus it will be) Il. 12.217.
To accomplish, fulfil, carry out, bring to fruition or consummation (a promise, purpose, wish, boasts): ὑπόσχεσιν Il. 2.286. Cf. Il. 9.245, Il. 10.105: Od. 3.99 = Od. 4.329, Od. 23.54.
To finish the making of, complete: φᾶρος Od. 2.98 = Od. 19.143 = Od. 24.133, Od. 2.110 = Od. 24.146, Od. 19.156.
To bring into being, cause to be born: γόνον Il. 9.493.
In pass., of periods of time, to be accomplished or completed: ὅτε μῆνές τε καὶ ἡμέραι ἐξετελεῦντο Od. 11.294 = Od. 14.293.
Nom. pl. fem. aor. pple. ἐκθεῖσαι.
To place outside on a spot indicated: λέχος Od. 23.179.
Outside, without: ἐ. αὐλῆς (outside in the αὐλή, taking αὐλῆς as local genit.) Od. 9.239, 338. Cf. Od. 13.100.
With genit.: ἐ. ἄλλων μνηστήρων Od. 1.132.
Outside of, beyond the line or shelter of.
With genit.: νηῶν Il. 15.391, πυλάων Il. 22.439.
Outside: ὡς ἴδε νεῦρόν τε καὶ ὄγκους ἐ. ἐόντας Il. 4.151 (i.e. they had not entered the wound), ἐ. λέξο Il. 24.650 (i.e. in the αἴθουσα). Cf. Il. 10.151: Od. 6.72, Od. 14.11, 16, Od. 23.135.

div.head: a
div.p: Outside of: κλισίης Il. 14.13. Cf. Il. 9.67, Il. 20.49, Il. 21.608, Il. 23.451: αὐλῆς ἐ. ἐών Od. 4.678 (i.e. he overheard from outside the conference which was taking place in the αὐλή). Cf. Od. 21.191, Od. 23.178.

div.head: b
div.p: To outside of: καλέσσατο δώματος ἐ. Il. 15.143.

div.head: c
div.p: Out of the region of danger from: καπνοῦ καὶ κύματος ἐ. Od. 12.219.

div.head: d
div.p: Apart from, at a distance from the line of: ὁδοῦ Od. 13.123.
Aside or away from the line of: ὁδοῦ Il. 23.424. Cf. Od. 17.234.

div.head: a
div.p: Outside, without: ὀρύξομεν τάφρον Il. 7.341, ἕσσατο ῥινὸν λύκοιο (as an outer covering) Il. 10.334. Cf. Il. 7.440, Il. 10.263: ἐ. πάγοι ὀξέες

[εἰσίν] Od. 5.411 (i.e.,
app., forming an outlying range). Cf. Od. 17.278.

div.head: b
div.p: With genit.: τείχεος ἐ. Il. 9.552. Cf. Od. 7.112, Od. 23.148.
3 sing. aor. pass. ἐξεφαάνθη Il. 4.468, Il. 13.278: Od. 12.441.
3 sing. aor. ἐξεφάνη Il. 18.248, Il. 19.46, Il. 20.43: Od. 10.260.
To bring to light Il. 19.104 (to the birth).

div.head: a
div.p: To come forth from retirement Il. 18.248 = Il. 19.46 = Il. 20.43.

p.gloss: To appear, come into view from.

div.p: With genit.: δοῦρα Χαρύβδιος ἐξεφαάνθη Od. 12.441.

div.head: b
div.p: To be exposed to view, be visible Il. 4.468.
To be seen in one's true colours, be known for what one is Il. 13.278.

div.head: c
div.p: To shine, gleam: ὡς εἰ σέλας Il. 19.17.
To bear or carry forth or away Il. 10.505: Od. 15.470.

p.gloss: To bear, carry, bring, forth or away from.

div.p: With genit.: πολέμοιο Il. 5.234, 664, 669. Cf. Il. 23.259: Od. 8.439.
To carry forth (a corpse) for funeral rites Il. 23.675, Il. 24.786.
To bear from the field, carry out of danger Il. 16.368, 383 = 866.
To bring round or on (a point of time): ὅτε μισθοῖο τέλος ὧραι ἐξέφερον Il. 21.451.
Intrans. for reflexive, to draw away from competitors in a race, shoot ahead (cf. ὑπεκφέρω 3) Il. 23.376, 377, 759.
To escape, evade, avoid (impending danger or trouble): θάνατον Il. 21.66. Cf. Il. 9.355: Od. 4.502, 512, Od. 15.235, Od. 19.157.
To escape from, get clear or free of (danger, etc., in which one is involved): μέγα πεῖραρ ὀϊζύος Od. 5.289. Cf. Od. 5.414.
Absol.: ἔνθεν ἐκφύγομεν Od. 12.212. Cf. Od. 19.231.

p.gloss: To escape from or out of.

div.p: Of a missile weapon, to fly from (the hand).
With genit.: βέλος ἔκφυγε χειρός Il. 5.18, Il. 11.376, Il. 14.407 = Il. 22.292, Il. 16.480.
Absol.: οὐδʼ ἅλιον βέλος ἔκφυγεν Il. 11.380.
Of something stored in a place, to be consumed or perish from or out of (the place).
With genit. : οὔ πω νηῶν ἐξέφθιτο οἶνος Od. 9.163. Cf. Od. 12.329.
To bear or carry out Od. 22.451.
In pass., to be borne or advance from.
With genit.: κόρυθες νηῶν ἐκφορέοντο Il. 19.360.
Nom. pl. fem. pf. pple. ἐκπεφυυῖαι.
With genit.: κεφαλαὶ τρεῖς ἑνὸς αὐχένος Il. 11.40.
3 sing. aor. mid. ἐκχεύατο Od. 22.3, Od. 24.178.
3 sing. aor. pass. ἐξέχυτο Od. 19.470. ἔκχυτο Od. 19.504.
In pass., of a liquid, to pour out, be spread: ὕδατος ἐκχυμένοιο Il. 21.300.
To be spilt: ἐξέχυθʼ ὕδωρ Od. 19.470. Cf. Od. 19.504.
Of persons, to pour out, stream forth Il. 16.259: Od. 8.515.
Willingly, of free will, not under compulsion: ἑ. δῶκα Od. 4.649. Cf. Od. 4.647, Od. 5.100-1 Od. 22.351.
Yielding too readily to one's feelings or fears or to circumstances, giving in too easily: ἑ. μεθιεῖς Il. 6.523. Cf. Il. 13.234: Od. 3.214 = Od. 16.95, Od. 4.372, 377.
On purpose, of set purpose, intentionally, advisedly: ἑ. ἡμάρτανεν Il. 10.372. Cf. Il. 8.81, Il. 23.434, 585.
As a matter of choice, by one's own will: ἑ. οὐκ ἄν τις ἕλοιτο
Preceding ἀέκων and serving to emphasize it by contrast: ἑ. ἀέκοντί γε θυμῷ Il. 4.43. Cf. Il. 7.197.
Sim. in Od. 2.133 ἑ. is used rather with reference to ἀέκουσαν in 130 than as in itself giving any distinct sense.
In neut. ἔλασσον as adv., less: δουρηνεκὲς ἤ καὶ ἐ. Il. 10.357.
One who drives, a charioteer Il. 4.145, Il. 11.702, Il. 23.369.

3 sing.
subj. ἐλάσσῃ Il. 5.236. ἐλάσῃ Od. 3.422, Od. 10.293, Od. 17.279.
3 sing. opt. ἐλάσειε Od. 11.290, Od. 17.237, Od. 22.97, etc.
Infin. ἐλάσαι Il. 5.264, Il. 19.423: Od. 18.94. ἐλάσσαι Il. 13.607, 647.
Pass. 3 sing. pf. ἐλήλαται Il. 16.518: Od. 7.113.
3 sing. plupf. ἐλήλατο Il. 4.135, Il. 10.153, Il. 13.595. ἠλήλατο Il. 5.400.
3 pl. ἐληλέατο Od. 7.86 (vv.ll. ἐληλάδατο, ἐληλέδατο). (δι-, εἰσ-, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, παρ-, παρεξ-, συν-.)
To drive in or fetch (them) for some purpose Od. 12.343, 353, 398.
Absol.: ὄφρʼ ἐλάσῃ ἐπιβουκόλος ἀνήρ Od. 3.422.
In reference to persons, to drive: κακοὺς ἐς μέσσον Il. 4.299. Cf. Il. 24.532.
To drive or chase, to drive or chase away: ἐκ Τροίης Ἀχαιούς Il. 6.529. Cf. Il. 16.87, 293, Il. 21.217, Il. 24.392.
For ἅδην ἐλάαν see ἅδην: Fig. οἴ ἐκ δίκην ἐλάσωσιν Il. 16.388.
To drive off (cattle, etc., as spoil) Il. 1.154: Od. 9.405, 465, Od. 11.290, Od. 15.235.
In mid.: ῥύσιʼ ἐλαυνόμενος Il. 11.674. Cf. Il. 11.682: Od. 20.51.
To drive off (captured horses) Il. 5.165, 236, 264, 327, 589, Il. 17.496.
To drive (horses, a chariot, a team of oxen, etc.): ἅρματα καὶ ἵππω Il. 5.237. Cf. Il. 2.764, Il. 11.289, Il. 23.334, Il. 24.325, etc.: Od. 15.215.
Absol.: μάστιξεν ἐλάαν (to start the horses) Il. 5.366. Cf. Il. 11.274, Il. 13.27, Il. 16.713, Il. 23.356, etc.: εἰ βόες εἶεν ἐλαυνέμεν Od. 18.371. Cf. Od. 3.484, 493, Od. 4.2, etc.
To drive up to the rescue: ἵππους Il. 17.614.
Fig., to carry on, keep going: κολῳόν Il. 1.575.
To propel (a ship) with oars, row (her) Od. 7.109, Od. 12.109, 276, Od. 13.155, 169, Od. 15.503.
Absol.: ἀναβάντες ἐλαύνομεν Od. 3.157, ἐλόωσι γαλήνην (through...) Od. 7.319. Cf. Od. 12.47, 55, 124, Od. 13.22.

Of operations conducted in line, to drive or form (a ditch, a wall, etc.): τάφρον Il. 7.450 = Il. 12.6, Il. 9.349, ὄγμον Il. 11.68. Cf. Il. 18.564: τεῖχος Od. 6.9, σταυρούς (a line of ...) Od. 14.11. Cf. Od. 7.86, 113.
To drive or thrust (a weapon): διαπρὸ χαλκὸν ἔλασσεν Il. 15.342. Cf. Il. 5.41, 539, Il. 20.259, Il. 24.421, etc.: Od. 22.93, 295.
To drive (a weapon) into the ground Il. 10.153.
To drive or thrust (something into a specified position): μοχλὸν ὑπὸ σποδοῦ Od. 9.375.
In pass. of an arrow or a spear, to pass, take its way: διὰ ζωστῆρος ἐλήλατʼ [ὀϊστός] Il. 4.135. Cf. Il. 5.400, Il. 13.

To strike or wound (never with a missile): Ὑψήνορα ὦμον (in the . . .) Il. 5.80, κόρυθος φάλον Il. 13.614. Cf. Il. 2.199, Il. 5.584, Il. 10.455, Il. 11.109, Il. 13.576, Il. 14.497, Il. 15.352, Il. 16.338, Il. 20.475, Il. 22.326: πέτρην Od. 4.507, δεξιὸν ὦμον Od. 18.95. Cf. Od. 10.293, Od. 17.279, Od. 18.92, 96, Od. 22.94, 97, 296, 328.
To dash (against the ground): πρὸς γῆν κάρη Od. 17.237.
Of a boar wounding with its tusk Od. 19.449, 465.
With cognate acc. of the wound inflicted by it Od. 19.393 = Od. 23.74, Od. 21.219, Od. 24.332.
With σύν, to dash(one's teeth) together Od. 18.98.
To beat (the sea with oars) (cf. τύπτω 3) Il. 7.6.
Fig., of pain, to pierce: χεὶρ ὀδύνῃσιν ἐλήλαται Il. 16.518.
To beat or hammer out (metal) Il. 7.223.
To form by beating or hammering out Il. 12.296, Il. 20.270.
One who smites deer, a hunter Il. 18.319.
Light, of small weight: λᾶαν Il. 12.450.
Moving easily, nimble: γυῖα Il. 5.122 = Il. 13.61 = Il. 23.772, χεῖρες Il. 23.628.
Active in movement, nimble: ἀνήρ Il. 16.745.
In comp. ἐλαφρότερος Od. 1.164 (see ἀφνειός)–In superl. ἐλαφρότατος Il. 23.749: Od. 3.370.
In comp.: ἐλαφρότερός κε πόλεμος γένοιτο Il. 22.287.
With infin.: ἰδέσθαι σε Od. 4.162. Cf. Il. 13.638: Od. 5.219, Od. 15.66, Od. 18.164, Od. 20.35.
To wish for, desire, covet: κτήματα Il. 5.481.
To long for, look eagerly forward to Od. 23.6.
To seek the accomplishment of, prosecute (business) Od. 1.409.
With genit., to long for, sigh after: πασιθέης Il. 14.276: σῆς ἀλόχου Od. 5.210.
To be eager for: ἐλδόμεναι πεδίοιο (eager to reach the...) Il. 23.122.
Absol. in pple., longing, desiring, eagerly expectant Il. 7.4, 7: Od. 12.438, Od. 21.209, Od. 24.400.
As pass.: ἐελδέσθω τοι πόλεμος (let it be thy desire) Il. 16.494.
To pity, take pity upon, feel pity for, feel for Il. 2.27 = 64 Il. 24.174, Il. 6.407, Il. 10.176, Il. 11.665, Il. 24.19, 23: Od. 3.96 = Od. 4.326, Od. 14.389, Od. 23.313.
With pple. expressing the plight of the pitied: Τρῶας ἀπολλυμένους Il. 7.27. Cf. Il. 9.302, Il. 13.15: Od. 4.828, Od. 19.210.
With infin.: μισγέμεναι κακότητι (in regard to..., so as not to ...) Od. 20.202.
Disgrace, reproach, blame, shame Il. 22.100, Il. 23.408: Od. 14.38.
An occasion or cause thereof: ἐ. σοὶ αὐτῷ ἔσσεται Il. 23.342. Cf. Od. 21.255.
Deserving of reproach: Ἀργεῖοι; ἐλεγχέες Il. 4.242. Cf. Il. 24.239.
The most open of all men to reproach, the most deserving of blame or contempt Il. 2.285, Il. 4.171, Il. 17.26: Od. 10.72.
An occasion or cause of disgrace, reproach, blame, shame: ἐ. ἔσσεται εἴ κεν ... Il. 11.314.

In pl. ἡμῖν ἂν ἐλέγχεα ταῦτα
γένοιτο Od. 21.329. Cf. Od. 21.333.
So of persons regarded as disgraces to their kind, things of shame: κάκʼ ἐλέγχεα Il. 2.235, Il. 5.787 = Il. 8.228. Cf. τὰ δʼ ἐλέγχεα πάντα λέλειπται Il. 24.260.
To dishonour, bring to nought, make futile: μῦθον Il. 9.522.
To bring shame on, do no credit to: σε Od. 21.424.
That is a fitting object of pity, pitiable, piteous: νέκυν Il. 23.110. Cf. Il. 21.273: δάκρυον (caused by feelings worthy of pity) Od. 8.531, Od. 16.219. Cf. Od. 19.253.
Moving or finding pity: φίλον ἐλθεῖν ἠδʼ ἐλεεινόν Il. 24.309: Od. 6.327.
In neut. pl. ἐλεεινά as adv., in piteous wise Il. 2.314, Il. 22.37, 408.
With pple. expressing the plight of the pitied: τὼ πεσόντε Il. 5.561, 610. Cf. Il. 15.44, Il. 17.346, 352, 441, Il. 19.340: Od. 5.336.
Compunction in using, sparing: οὔ τις ἐ. ἀλλοτρίων χαρίσασθαι Od. 17.451. Cf. Od. 14.82.
To shake, cause to tremble Il. 1.530, Il. 8.199.
In pass., to shake, quiver, tremble: ἔγχος ἐλέλικτο Il. 13.558. Cf. Il. 22.448.
For ἐλέλιξε Il. 17.278: Od. 5.314; ἐλελιξάμενος Il. 2.316; ἐλελίχθη Od. 12.416, Od. 14.306; ἐλελίχθησαν Il. 5.497, Il. 6.106, Il. 11.214, Il. 17.343; ἐλέλικτο Il. 11.39, see ἑλίσσω.
Marshbred, growing in marshy ground Il. 2.776.
That can be seized or grasped: ἀνδρὸς ψυχή Il. 9.409.
Free, not in bondage: ἐλεύθερον ἦμαρ (see ἦμαρ 4.d), κρητῆρα ἐλεύθερον (a bowl to celebrate deliverance) Il. 6.528.
To play a trick upon Il. 23.388.
Absol., to deceive. Of dreams Od. 19.565.
App., of Helike in Achaea, a seat of the worship of Poseidon Il. 20.404.
[prob. (.) ελικ-, ἑλίσσω + ὦπα. Throwing the eyes round.]
Thus, quick-glancing (as indicating liveliness or vivacity of disposition).
Epithet of the Achaeans Il. 1.389, Il. 3.190, 234, Il. 16.569 = Il. 17.274, Il. 24.402.
An ornament of some kind in spiral form Il. 18.401.
[prob. as ἕλιξ., with twisted or crumpled horns. Or poss. fr. (σ)ελ- as in σέλας, shining, sleek.]
3 sing. aor. subj. mid. ἑλίξεται Il. 17.728.
Genit. pl. masc. aor. pple. pass. ἑλιχθέντων Il. 12.74.

To these should no doubt be added (cf. under ἐλελίζω) 3 sing. aor. ἐ(ϝ)έλιξε (appearing in the MSS. as ἐλέλιξε) Il. 17.278: Od. 5.314; aor. pple. mid. (ϝ)ελιξάμενος (ἐλελιξάμενος) Il. 2.316; 3 sing. aor. pass. ἐ(ϝ)ελίχθη (ἐλελίχθη) Od. 12.416, Od. 14.306; 3 pl. ἐ(ϝ)ελίχθησαν (ἐλελίχθησαν) Il. 5.497, Il. 6.106, Il. 11.214, Il. 17.343, ἐ(ϝ)έλιχθεν (ἐλέλιχθεν) Il. 6.109; pple. pl. (ϝ)ελιχθέντες (ἐλελιχθέντες) Il. 11.588.
To form in a spiral shape, twine: ἐλέλικτο δράκων Il. 11.39.
To impart a circular motion to, cause to whirl Od. 5.314, Od. 12.416 = Od. 14.306.
To bring (troops) to face the foe, rally (them) Il. 17.278.
In pass., of troops, to rally: οἱ δʼ ἐλελίχθησαν Il. 5.497 = Il. 6.106 = Il. 11.214 = Il. 17.343. Cf. Il. 6.109, Il. 11.588, Il. 12.74.
Absol., to turn one's horses (round a mark): περὶ τέρμαθʼ ἑλισσέμεν Il. 23.309. Cf. Il. 23.466.
In mid., to take the turn round a mark: ἐπὶ πολλὸν ἑλίσσεται (wheels wide) Il. 23.320.
In mid., to turn oneself, turn to bay Il. 17.283, 728.
In mid., to turn this way and that, go or betake oneself hither and thither: ἀνʼ ὅμιλον ἰὼν εἱλίσσετο Il. 12.49 (v.l. ἐλίσσετο (λίσσομαι)). Cf. Il. 12.408, 467, Il. 21.11.
In mid. in various senses. To busy oneself Il. 18.372.
Of a recumbent person, to turn (from side to side) Od. 20.24, 28.
To swing one's body in preparation for a throw: ἧκε ἑλιξάμενος Il. 13.204 (or perh., whirling the thrown object in a circle).
To twist oneself about in an effort to free oneself Il. 8.340.
Of a snake, to coil itself Il. 22.95.

To do this for a spring
Il. 2.316.
Of the steam of sacrifice, to curl Il. 1.317.
Of a thrown object, to spin Il. 23.846.

p.gloss: Trailing the πέπλος, with long flowing πέπλος.

div.p: Epithet of Trojan women Il. 6.442 = Il. 22.105, Il. 7.297.
Trailing the χιτών, with long flowing χιτών: Ἰάονες Il. 13.685.
To drag away by force, carry off: ἑλκηθείσας θύγατρας Il. 22.62 (with at least a suggestion of ravishment).
To pull at: νέκυν εἵλκεον Il. 17.395.
To pull about, tear (a corpse) Il. 17.558, Il. 22.336.
To lay violent hands upon: λητὼ ἕλκησε Od. 11.580 (cf. (1)).
A being dragged or carried away by force (cf. ἑλκέω 1) Il. 6.465.
Of the effect of a snake's bite Il. 2.723.
To expose to dragging or pulling about Il. 23.187, Il. 24.21.

To drag, haul or pull along or away: ἑλκομένας νυούς Il. 22.65 (with at least a suggestion of ravishment), ὥς θʼ ἡμίονοι ἕλκωσι δοκόν Il. 17.743. Cf. Il. 3.370, Il. 18.581, Il. 20.404, 405, Il. 22.465, Il. 24.52, 417: Od. 16.276, Od. 18.10, 12, 101, Od. 21.300.
Of dragging the body of a foe from the fight Il. 4.465, Il. 13.383, Il. 17.126, 289, Il. 18.156, 176.
Of so dragging the body of a friend Il. 11.258, 259.
Of κήρ dragging off a body Il. 18.537.
In pass., to drag or trail along: κάρη ἕλκεσθαι ἔασεν Il. 22.398. Cf. Il. 5.665, Il. 22.401, 464, Il. 24.15.
To draw, pull, pluck, in a specified direction: ἐκζωστῆρος ὀϊστόν Il. 4.213. Cf. Il. 11.239, 398, 457, Il. 16.406, 409, 504.
To draw down (a ship) in order to launch her Il. 2.152, 165 = 181, Il. 9.683, Il. 14.76, 97, 100, 106: Od. 3.153.
Of mules, to draw (a waggon) Il. 24.324.
Of horses, to draw (a charioteer) Il. 23.518.
Of a charioteer, to draw (his chariot) Il. 23.533.
To draw (a plough): νειοῖο ἄροτρον Il. 10.353 (genit. of space within which). Cf. Od. 13.32.
To draw (a bow): ἕλκεν νευρὴν γλυφίδας τε Od. 21.419. Cf. Il. 4.122.
To draw up and poise (a balance) Il. 8.72, Il. 22.212.
To apply force to: νῶτα ἑλκόμενα Il. 23.715.
Fig., to bring on (a period of time): φάος ἠελίοιο ἕλκον νύκτα Il. 8.486.
In mid., to draw (one's sword) Il. 1.194, 210.
To pull out (one's hair) Il. 10.15, Il. 22.77.
To draw (down the skin of the brows),
A band for binding a corn-sheaf Il. 18.553.
The young of the deer, a fawn Od. 19.228.
3 sing. plupf. ἐὠλπει Il. 19.328: Od. 20.328, Od. 21.96, Od. 24.313.
3 sing. impf. mid. ἐέλπετο Il. 12.407, Il. 13.609: Od. 23.345.
3 sing. pres. mid. ἐέλπεται Il. 10.105, Il. 13.813.

div.head: I
div.p: In pres. act., to rouse hopes in, cause to hope: πάντας ἔλπει Od. 2.91 = Od. 13.380.
In pf. and plupf. and in mid.
In reference to the past or present, to suppose, think, fancy.
With infin.: οὐδʼ ἐμὲ νήϊδά γʼ οὕτως ἔλπομαι γενέσθαι Il. 7.199. Cf. Il. 9.40, Il. 13.309, Il. 15.110, Il. 16.281, Il. 17.404: ἐπὴν ἡμέας ἔλπῃ ἀφῖχθαι Od. 6.297. Cf. Od. 9.419, Od. 23.345.
Absol.: αὐτὸς ὅ, ἔλπομʼ, ἐνὶ πρώτοισιν ὁμιλεῖ Il. 18.194.
In reference to the fut., to expect, think it likely or probable.

With fut. infin.: χαλεπῶς σʼ ἔολπα τὸ ῥέξειν Il. 20.186. Cf. Il. 7.353, Il. 13.8, Il. 15.504, Il. 17.239, 404, 406, 603: ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἐλποιο νεώτερον ἐρξέμεν Od. 7.293. Cf. Od. 2.275, Od. 3.375, Od. 5.379, Od. 8.315, Od. 8.315, Od. 21.314.
Absol.: οὐκ ἂν ἐμοί γε ἐλπομένῳ τὰ γένοιτο Od. 3.228.
With the infin. to be supplied: οὐ νοήματα ἐκτελέει ὅσʼ ἐέλπεται Il. 10.105. Cf. Od. 3.275.
With aor. infin.: ἐλπόμενοι παύσασθαι πολέμοιο Il. 3.112 (or this might come under (4)). Cf. Il. 12.407: ὅθεν οὐκ ἔλποιτο ἐλθέμεν Od. 3.319. Cf. Od. 21.157.
In reference to the past of something which it is hoped has taken place.
In reference to the present of something which it is hoped is taking place.
With pres. infin.: ἑταίρους ἰέναι Il. 10.355.
To hope for: νίκην Il. 13.609, Il. 15.539. Cf. Od. 21.317.
With fut. infin.: ὑπάλυξιν ἔσεσθαι Od. 23.287.
With aor. infin.: φίλους ἰδέειν Od. 6.314 = Od. 7.76. Cf. Od. 2.280.
An object of prey or of spoiling: ἀνδράσι δυσμενέεσσιν ἑ. καὶ κύρμα Il. 5.488. Cf. Il. 5.684, Il. 17.151, 667: οἰωνοῖσιν Od. 3.271. Cf. Od. 5.473, Od. 13.208, Od. 24.292.
In pl.: Πατρόκλοιο ἕλωρα ἀποτείσῃ Il. 18.93 (pay the penalty for the spoiling of ...).
By stepping, i.e. by land: ἐ. ἵξεσθαι πατρίδα γαῖαν Il. 15.505.
Acc. sing. masc. pf. pple. ἐμβεβαῶτα Il. 5.199.

With dat., to
step upon, put one's foot upon: ἐλάφῳ Od. 10.164.
To step upon, put the feet upon in passing over: νεκροῖς Il. 10.493.
To go on board of, embark upon (a ship): νηΐ πύλονδε (embarked for . . .) Od. 4.656.
Absol.: πολέες ἔμβαινον (app., sailed therein) Il. 2.619.
To enter the fray, intervene Il. 16.94.
App., to push on, make a spurt Il. 23.403.

In pf. and plupf. of the state or condition of having gone upon something: ἐρέται πεντήκοντα ἐμβέβασαν (were on board, formed the complement) Il. 2.720, ἵπποισιν καὶ ἅρμασιν ἐμβεβαῶτα (mounted upon, driving) Il. 5.199.
So μολυβδαίνη κατὰ βοὸς κέρας ἐμβεβαυῖα (mounted upon it) Il. 24.81.
To throw upon something or someone: ῥήγεα ἐμβαλέειν Il. 24.645: = Od. 4.298 = Od. 7.337. Cf. Il. 12.383: Od. 23.179.
With dat.: ἵππους πυρῇ Il. 23.172. Cf. Il. 23.174.
With dat., to put or place in: ἱμάντα χερσίν Il. 14.218. Cf. Od. 1.438, Od. 2.37, Od. 18.103.
To cause to be in or to fall into: βροτοῦ σʼ ἀνέρος εὐνῇ Il. 18.85, χερσίν μιν Ἀχιλλῆος Il. 21.47.

p.gloss: In reference to mental or physical states, to inspire, induce, bring about, suggest in.
App., to throw oneself upon, ply.

div.p: With dat.: ἐμβαλέειν κώπῃς Od. 9.489 = Od. 10.129.
In mid., with dat., to take into (one's mind), flatter oneself with the idea of: μὴ φύξιν ἐμβάλλεο θυμῷ Il. 10.447.
To lay to (one's heart), bear in mind the need for: μῆτιν ἐμβάλλεο θυμῷ Il. 23.313.
To rule or hold sway in a place Il. 2.572.

p.gloss: To rule or hold sway in.

div.p: acc. sing. masc. pf. pple. ἐμβαίνω.
In mid., of the wind, to roar in.
The young of an animal Od. 9.245 = 309 = 342.
Pron. of the 1st person sing., me: ἐμοὶ γέρας ἑτοιμάσατε Il. 1.118, νεωτέρω ἐμεῖο 259, ἐμεῦ ἀπονόσφιν 541, καμέτην μοι ἵπποι Il. 4.27, μή με κάθιζε Il. 6.360, ἔμʼ ἄμμορον 408, etc.
Strengthened by γε: ἐμέ γε, ἔμεγε Il. 9.315, etc.: Od. 5.99, etc.– ἐμοί γε, ἔμοιγε Il. 1.174, 295, etc.: Od. 3.227, Od. 4.538, etc.
With eager haste, speed, alacrity, zeal: ἐμμεμαὼς ἐπόρουσεν Il. 20.284, 442. Cf. Il. 5.142, 240, 330, 838, Il. 13.785, Il. 17.735, 746, Il. 22.143: Od. 23.127.
Adjectivally, of fiery disposition, fierce Il. 20.468.
Only in neut. ἐμμενές as adv., without intermission, continuously, strengthening αἰεί: Il. 10.361, 364, Il. 13.517: Od. 9.386, Od. 21.69.
Having a share of, endued with: τιμῆς Od. 8.480.
With the article: τὸν ἐμὸν χόλον Il. 4.42. Cf. Il. 6.523, etc.: Od. 2.97, Od. 11.452, etc.
Absol.: οὐκ ἐμὸν παλινάγρετον (nothing of mine) Il. 1.526.
As predicative adj., mine: ἵππον δώσω ἐμήν περ ἐοῦσαν Il. 23.610: εἰ ἐμός ἐσσι Od. 16.300. Cf. Il. 7.191.
To care about, regard, concern oneself with, pay attention to.
To hold in due honour, respect: ἱκέτας Od. 16.422.
App., expert in, possessed of: οὐδʼ ἔργων ἔμπαιον (–⏑⏑) οὐδὲ βίης Od. 20.379, κακῶν Od. 21.400.
In weaving, to insert representations of in a web: ἐνέπασσεν ἀέθλους (sc. ἱστῷ) Il. 3.126.
[ἐμ-, ἐν- 3 + πεδ-, ποδ-, πούς. Firm on the feet. Cf. ἠπεδανός.]
Standing firmly in place, not overthrown, intact: τεῖχος Il. 12.9, 12.
Maintained in place, steady: ἔμπεδον ἔχων σάκος Il. 16.107. Cf. Il. 16.520.
In place, not displaced Il. 10.94: Od. 23.203.
Maintained with ceaseless vigilance: φυλακή Il. 8.521.
Secured, not liable to confiscation: γέρα Il. 9.335.
Assured, certain, never failing: κομιδή Od. 8.453.
Assured, to be looked forward to with certainty: πομπήν Od. 8.30.
Affording sure testimony, unmistakable: σήματα Od. 19.250 = Od. 23.206, Od. 24.346.

div.head: a
div.p: Stead fastly, unshrinkingly Il. 5.527 = Il. 15.622, Il. 15.406.

div.head: b
div.p: Without intermission or break, continuously Il. 12.281: Od. 7.259.
With steady course, without break or stop Il. 22.192.
With steady or undeviating course Il. 13.141, Il. 23.641, 642: Od. 13.86.

div.head: c
div.p: App., without hesitation or uncertainty: ἄλλοτʼ ἐπʼ ἄλλον ἀμείβεται Il. 15.683.
In any case: νῦν δʼ ἐ. γὰρ κῆρες ἐφεστᾶσιν (but as it is, since in any case . . .) Il. 12.326, τλήσομαι ἐ. (on that I am resolved) Il. 19.308. Cf. Il. 24.522 (in spite of our hearts).
For certain, for sure: οὔ τινα δείδιμεν ἐ. Il. 7.196: Od. 2.199. Cf. Od. 15.214, Od. 24.324.
Introducing a statement of something remarkable, of a surety Od. 19.37.
Nay even: ἐ. δέ τοι ὅρκια δώσω (I will not hesitate to . . .) Od. 19.302.

Adversatively, nevertheless, notwithstanding, all the same, still: πρῆξαι δʼ ἐ. οὔ τι δυνήσεαι Il. 1.562. Cf. Il. 5.191, Il. 8.33 = 464, Il. 14.174 (though it was in the palace of Zeus that it was stirred), Il. 17.632: Od. 2.191, Od. 3.209, Od. 4.100, Od. 6.190, Od. 11.351, Od. 14.214, 481 (even without the χλαῖνα), Od. 16.147, Od. 18.12, Od. 20.311, Od. 23.83.
Strengthened by καί Il. 2.297, Il. 19.422: Od. 5.205.

In ppl. construction with περ, though, even though: χατέουσί περ ἐ. (in need though they be) Il. 9.518, ἐπικρατέουσί περ ἐ. (though as it is they are the victors) Il. 14.98. Cf. Il. 14.1, Il. 15.399, Il. 17.229: Od. 15.361, Od. 18.165, Od. 19.356.
3 sing. aor. mid. ἐμπλήσατο Il. 22.312: Od. 9.296.
To fill (a receptacle or the like) by pouring or putting something into it: ἓν δέπας Od. 9.209. Cf. Od. 2.353, Od. 17.503, Od. 23.358.
With a liquid as subject: αἷμα κόλπον ἐνέπλησεν Il. 20.471.
With genit. of material: ἐμπίπληθι ῥέεθρα ὕδατος Il. 21.311. Cf. Od. 8.495, Od. 9.212, Od. 18.45.
Sim.: πυρὴν ἐμπλησέμεν ἐσθλῶν (to heap it with . . .) Od. 10.523 = Od. 11.31.
Fig.: μή μοι θυμὸν ἐνιπλήσῃς ὀδυνάων Od. 19.117.
In mid., to fill one's . . .: ἐπεὶ ἐμπλήσατο νηδύν Od. 9.296.
Fig., with genit.: μένεος ἐμπλήσατο θυμόν Il. 22.312. Cf. Il. 22.504.
In pass., to be filled, be full, be stuffed: γαστὴρ ἐνιπλησθῆναι ἀνώγει Od. 7.221.
With genit.: ἐνέπλησθεν αἵματος ὀφθαλμοί Il. 16.348, πόλις ἔμπλητο ἀλέντων Il. 21.607. Cf. Od. 8.16.
Fig.: υἶος ἐνιπλησθῆναι (to have my fill of looking upon him) Od. 11.452.
With dat.: πέτρῃ (i.e. into a cleft) Il. 4.108: πόντῳ Od. 4.508, Od. 5.318.
Of an arrow, to fall into, enter, strike.
Of fire, to be flung into.
Of a feeling, to enter into, come upon.
With dat.: χόλος θυμῷ Il. 9.436, Il. 14.207 = 306, Il. 16.206. Cf. Il. 17.625.

p.gloss: To come into (the mind), recur to one.

div.p: With dat.: πόντῳ (lighted on it) Od. 5.50.
To attack, make an attack Il. 16.81.
With dat.: ὅτε πῦρ ἐμπέσῃ ὕλῃ Il. 11.155–Sim.: κακὸν οἴκῳ Od. 2.45, Od. 15.375.
Also ἐνίπλειος Od. 14.113, Od. 17.300, Od. 19.580, Od. 21.78.
With genit., filled with, full of: οἴνου Od. 14.113. Cf. Od. 18.119, Od. 19.580 = Od. 21.78, Od. 20.26, Od. 22.3.
In striking wise, mightily: ἐ. ἕτερόν γε τίει Od. 20.132.
Dual pple. in form ἐμπνείοντε Il. 17.502.
To breathe into one, inspire him with: μένος Il. 15.60. Cf. Od. 9.381, Od. 24.520.
With dat.: τῷ μένος Il. 10.482. Cf. Il. 15.262 = Il. 20.110, Il. 17.456.
With dat. and infin.: φᾶρός μοι ἐνέπνευσε φρεσὶν ὑφαίνειν Od. 19.138.
3 sing. sing. aor. pass. Il. 5.697, Il. 14.436. Also ἔμπνυτο Il. 11.359, Il. 22.475: Od. 5.458, Od. 24.349.
[Prob. ἐμ-, ἐν- 6 + πνυ-. See πέπνυμαι. In the MSS. ἀμπνύ(ν)θη, ἄμπνυτο (ἀμ-, ἀνα- 4).]
To come to after a faint: ἐμπνύνθη καὶ ἀνέδρακεν ὀφθαλμοῖσιν Il. 14.436. Cf. Il. 5.697, Il. 11.359, Il. 22.475: Od. 5.458, Od. 24.349.
To make or construct (in something): ἐν πύργοισι πύλας ἐνεποίεον Il. 7.438.
To get by trafficking: βίοτον πολύν Od. 15.456.
One who travels in a ship belonging to another, a passenger Od. 2.319, Od. 24.300.
Infin. ἐμπρήσειν Il. 9.242. ἐνιπρήσειν Il. 12.198, Il. 15.702.

To destroy by fire, burn: πυρὶ νῆας Il. 8.182, νῆας πυρός (genit. of material) Il. 9.242. Cf. Il. 8.217, 235, Il. 9.589, Il. 12.198, Il. 13.319, Il. 14.47, Il. 15.417, 507, 702, Il. 16.82, Il. 22.374.
Made to go or stand upon the fire: τρίποδα Il. 23.702.
In pass., to be borne or carried about in.
With dat.: κύμασιν ἐμφορέοντο Od. 12.419 = Od. 14.309.
Of one's own tribe: ἄνδρα Od. 15.273.
In aor., to implant or inspire knowledge of Od. 22.348.
In pf., to grow or be upon.
With dat.: ὅθι τρίχες κρανίῳ ἐμπεφύασιν Il. 8.84.

In something, therein, within, there: ἐν σκόλοπας κατέπηξαν Il. 7.441, ἐν ἄνδρες ναίουσιν Il. 9.154. Cf. Il. 1.311, Il. 19.16 (in him), Il. 21.569, Il. 24.472, etc.: ἐν πίθοι ἕστασαν Od. 2.340. Cf. Od. 1.51, Od. 5.254, Od. 6.292, Od. 12.85, etc.

Into something, and, in pregnant use, in something, therein: ἐν ἐρέτας ἀγείρομεν Il. 1.142, ἐν δʼ ἔπεσον Il. 21.9. Cf. Il. 1.309, Il. 8.70, Il. 18.347, Il. 19.366, Il. 23.177, etc.: Od. 3.479, Od. 24.498, etc.
In hostile sense: ἐν πρῶτος ὄρουσεν (upon the foe) Il. 11.91. Cf. Il. 15.624, etc.
On; also in pregnant use: ἐν λέπαδνʼ ἔβαλεν Il. 5.730. Cf. Il. 9.207, Il. 23.170, etc.: ἐν στρόφος ἦεν ἀορτήρ (attached to it) Od. 13.438. Cf. Od. 7.96, Od. 14.519, etc.
Among others, in a company or assembly: ἐν αὐτὸς ἐδύσετο χαλκόν Il. 2.578. Cf. Il. 16.551, Il. 18.535, etc.: Od. 7.291.

div.head: II
div.p: Prep. with dat. (ἐνί with anastrophe when immediately following the case-form).
In: ἐν χερσίν Il. 1.14, ἐνὶ οἴκῳ, ἐν Ἄργεϊ 30, νέεσσʼ ἔνι Il. 3.240. Cf. Il. 1.83, 358, 396, Il. 2.194, Il. 3.69, Il. 5.160, etc.: Od. 1.15, 110, 162, 186, 255, 386, etc.

In reference to immaterial things: ἐνὶ φρεσίν Il. 1.333, ἐν φιλότητι Il. 2.232. Cf. Il. 2.223, Il. 3.20, Il. 5.117, Il. 8.476, Il. 17.647, etc.: Od. 4.497, Od. 6.313, Od. 10.465, Od. 11.603, Od. 15.357, etc.
In (i.e. by means of) (the hands of): ὄφρʼ ἀνδρῶν ἐν παλάμῃσι κατέκταθεν Il. 5.558, etc. Cf. Od. 1.238, etc.
Sim.: ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖσιν Il. 1.587, Il. 18.135, etc.: Od. 8.459, Od. 10.385, etc.– ἐν ῥυτῆρσι τάνυσθεν (in the governance of . . .) Il. 16.475.
In reference to mixing: ἐν τυρὸν οἴνῳ ἐκύκα Od. 10.234.
To that in which a characteristic is displayed: γυρὸς ἐν ὤμοισιν Od. 19.246.
To measure or degree: ἐν καρὸς αἴσῃ Il. 9.378.
To that in reference to which one ends speech: ἐν σοὶ λήξω Il. 9.97.
In the matter of, in: τοῖσίν κεν ἐν ἄλγεσιν ἰσωσαίμην Od. 7.212. Cf. Od. 13.292.
With ellipse of δώματι: εἰν Ἀΐδαο Il. 22.389. Cf. Il. 6.47, etc.: Od. 7.132, Od. 10.282, Od. 11.211, etc.

Into, and, in pregnant use, in: ὅτε νηυσὶν ἐν ὠκυπόροισιν ἔβαινον Il. 2.351, θῆκε περγάμῳ εἰν ἱερῇ Il. 5.446. Cf. Il. 1.433, Il. 4.134, 482, Il. 5.317, 574, etc.: Od. 1.381, Od. 2.349, Od. 3.40, 341, Od. 10.290, etc.
In reference to the mind: ἐνὶ φρεσὶ βάλλεο σῇσιν Il. 1.297. Cf. Il. 9.459, Il. 15.566, Il. 21.547, etc.: Od. 4.729, Od. 12.217, etc.
To closeness of approach or position: ἐν νύσσῃ ἐγχριμφθήτω Il. 23.338. Cf. Il. 23.344.
In among: ἐν νήεσσι πεσόντες Il. 2.175. Cf. Il. 11.311, Il. 12.126, etc.: Od. 14.268, etc.
In hostile sense: ἐν Τρώεσσι θόρεν (upon them) Il. 20.381. Cf. Il. 11.325, Il. 13.742, Il. 15.635, etc.: Od. 24.526.
On, upon: ἐν Ὀλύμπῳ Il. 1.566, θεῶν ἐν γούνασιν Il. 17.514. Cf. Il. 4.2, 455, Il. 7.66, Il. 24.527, etc.: Od. 1.108, Od. 4.627, Od. 12.237, Od. 20.141, Od. 24.332, etc.
On to, and, in pregnant use, on: ἐν στήθεσι βάς Il. 6.65, τρίποδʼ ἵστασαν ἐν πυρί Il. 18.346. Cf. Il. 8.51, Il. 15.150, Il. 23.132, etc.: Od. 3.38, Od. 4.136, Od. 8.274, etc.
In reference to inclusion in a number: ἐν τοῖσιν Il. 5.395. Cf. Od. 4.452, Od. 19.178, Od. 22.217.
In reference to time, in: ὥρῃ ἐν εἰαρινῇ Il. 2.471. Cf. Il. 11.173, Il. 18.251, etc.: Od. 12.76, Od. 17.176, Od. 18.367, etc.
3 sing. aor. mid. ἐνήρατο Il. 5.43, 59, Il. 6.32, Il. 14.515: Od. 24.424. (κατ-.)
To kill in the chase: θῆρας Il. 21.485.
In weakened sense, to mar, impair.
In mid.: μηκέτι χρόα ἐναίρεο Od. 19.263.

div.head: a
div.p: Of persons, right-thinking, just Il. 6.521: Od. 10.383, Od. 17.363.
Of the mind, intent on the right, just Il. 24.40: Od. 5.190, Od. 18.220.
Of the result of mental effort, right, in accordance with justice: τοῦτό γʼ ἐναίσιμον οὐκ ἐνόησεν Od. 2.122 (this contrivance was not . . .), Od. 7.299 (in this her judgment was at fault).

div.head: b
div.p: Absol. in neut. pl. ἐναίσιμα, what is right: ἐ. ἐργάζεσθαι Od. 17.321.

div.head: c
div.p: In neut. sing. ἐναίσιμον as adv., in due season, at the appointed time: ἦλθον Il. 6.519.
Bringing omens, charged with fate: ὄρνιθες Od. 2.182.
Absol. in neut. pl., omens Od. 2.159.
Like, resembling, in the likeness of.

With dat.: ὄρνιθι Il. 14.290, θεῷ αὐδήν (in . . .) Il. 19.250. Cf. Il. 5.5, Il. 13.242, Il. 17.583: ἀθανάτοις Od. 7.5, θεοῖς ἐναλίγκια μήδεα (like those of the gods) Od. 13.89. Cf. Od. 1.371 = Od. 9.4, Od. 2.5 = Od. 4.310, Od. 16.209, 273 = Od. 17.202 = Od. 24.157, Od. 17.337, Od. 19.267, Od. 24.148, 371.
In neut. in impers. construction: τῷ ἔην ἐναλίγκιον, ὡς εἰ . . ., it was like the case or state of things as
[it would be] if . . ., it was as if . . . Il. 22.410.
With dat.: γαυλοί, τοῖς ἐνάμελγεν Od. 9.223.

In neut. sing. ἐναντίβιον as adv., face to face, man to man: ἐ. μαχέσασθαι Il. 8.168, 255, Il. 22.223, ὅτε κέν τις ἐ. θεὸς ἔλθῃ (in open hostility) Il. 20.130, στῆναι ἐ. (to face the danger) Il. 21.266. Cf. Il. 10.451, Il. 15.179, Il. 17.490, Il. 21.477: Od. 14.270, Od. 17.439.
Opposite, facing: ἔστησαν Od. 10.391. Cf. Il. 6.247.
With genit.: ἕζετʼ Ὀδυσῆος ἐναντίη Od. 23.89.
With dat.: οἱ Il. 9.190, ἀλλήλοισιν (i.e. beginning at either end of the line and meeting in the middle) Il. 11.67. Cf. Od. 10.89.
With genit.: Ἀχαιῶν Il. 5.497 = Il. 6.106 = Il. 11.214 = Il. 17.343.
Meeting, in order to meet, join, encounter or intercept a person, etc.: ἐναντίη ἦλθε Il. 6.394, Il. 15.88. Cf. Od. 13.226.
With genit.: ἐ. ἤλυθεν ἵππων Il. 15.454.
With dat.: ἐναντίη οἱ ἤλυθεν Il. 6.251.
Sim.: πόριες σκαίρουσιν ἐναντίαι (come frisking to meet their mothers) Od. 10.412.
With dat.: ἐναντίω οἱ ὁρμηθήτην Il. 5.12.
In neut. sing. ἐναντίον as adv.

div.head: a
div.p: With dat.: ὑμῖν παράκειται ἐ. ἠὲ . . . ἢ . . . (the choice is before you) Od. 22.65.
Face to face: εἰς ὦπα ἰδέσθαι ἐ. Od. 23.107.
In hostile sense, face to face, man to man: μαχέσασθαι Il. 3.433, Il. 20.257. Cf. Il. 12.377, Il. 13.106, Il. 20.252.
Face to face, close at hand: ὦρτο Il. 11.129, Il. 20.164.
With genit., facing, opposing, against: ἄνακτος Il. 9.559. Cf. Il. 13.448, Il. 20.97.

div.head: b
div.p: In order to meet or join.
With genit.: ἐ. ἤλυθον ἵππων Od. 14.278.
Sim.: τὸν ξεῖνον ἐ. κάλεσσον Od. 17.544.
The armour and trappings of a fallen foe Il. 6.68, 480, Il. 8.534, Il. 10.528, 570, Il. 13.268, Il. 15.347, Il. 17.13, 231, 540, Il. 22.245.
Booty or spoil in general: φόρμιγγα ἄρετʼ ἐξ ἐνάρων Il. 9.188.
Nom. sing. neut. pf. pple. ἐναρηρός.
To be fitted into its place Od. 5.236.
In visible presence: χαλεποὶ θεοὶ φαίνεσθαι ἐναργεῖς (in respect of their appearing . . ., when they appear . . .) Il. 20.131: Ἀθήνην, ἥ μοι ἐ. ἦλθεν Od. 3.420. Cf. Od. 7.201, Od. 16.161.
Clear or plain to the mind's eye: ὄνειρον Od. 4.841.
nom. sing. neut. pf. pple. ἐναραρίσκω.
To strip (a slain foe) of his armour and trappings Il. 5.844.
With double acc. of the spoil and of the person despoiled: τοὺς ἐνάριζον ἀπʼ ἔντεα Il. 12.195, Il. 15.343. Cf. Il. 17.187, Il. 22.323.
To kill or slay in gen. Il. 1.191.
Reckoned in the number, counted Il. 2.202.
Making up the number, completing the tale Od. 12.65.
The ninth: μήτηρ ἐνάτη ἦν Il. 2.313 = 327.
[app. ἐν- 1 + αὐλός. Cf. sense (3) thereof. A hollow in . . ..]
In mid., to open one's mind, declare oneself Il. 19.83.
Eleven cubits long: ἔγχος Il. 6.319 = Il. 8.494.
ἑνδεκάτη (sc. ἡμέρη), the eleventh day: ἑνδεκάτῃ (on the eleventh day) Il. 24.666: ἑνδεκάτη τε δυωδεκάτη τε Od. 2.374, Od. 4.588.
App., on the right hand of a spectator (i.e. in the lucky quarter): ἐνδέξια σήματα φαίνων Il. 9.236.
In neut. pl. ἐνδέξια as adv., (passing round) from left to right (i.e. in the sun's, or the lucky, direction): ἐ. οἰνοχόει Il. 1.597. Cf. Il. 7.184: Od. 17.365.
To bend or tie on to something: νευρήν, ἣν ἐνέδησα Il. 15.469.
To secure or tie in something: ὑπέρας ἐν αὐτῇ (sc. ἐν νηί) Od. 5.260.
Fig., to entangle or involve in.
With dat.: ἄτῃ με Il. 2.111 = Il. 9.18.
To tar on, set on (dogs) Il. 18.584.
App., the inward parts of the body Il. 23.806.
At mid-day: ἐ. ἦλθεν Od. 4.450. Cf. Il. 11.726.
From within: ὑπακοῦσαι Od. 4.283. Cf. Od. 20.101.
Within: Ζηνὸς τοιήδε ἐ. αὐλή Od. 4.74.
Within one, in one's breast: εἴ οἱ κραδίη σιδηρέη ἐ. ἦεν Od. 4.293. Cf. Od. 4.467.
Within, in the house, in one's house, at home: τὴν ἐ. τέτμεν ἐοῦσαν Od. 5.58. Cf. Il. 6.498: Od. 22.220.
Within one, in one's breast: ἐ. θυμὸν ἀμύξεις Il. 1.243. Cf. Il. 22.242: Od. 2.315, Od. 8.577, Od. 19.377, Od. 24.474.
Within: ἐγκέφαλος ἐ. πεπάλακτο Il. 11.98 = Il. 12.186 = Il. 20.400. Cf. Il. 12.142, Il. 21.362: ἐ. τις ἀοιδιάει Od. 10.226. Cf. Od. 21.237 = 383 (in the μέγαρον), Od. 22.179 (in the θάλαμος).
With genit.: Διὸς [δώματος] ἐ. Il. 20.13. Cf. Il. 23.200.
Sim., app.: Καβησόθεν ἐ. ἐόντα (who had come to the city from . . .) Il. 13.363. Cf. Il. 15.438.
Returned from a journey or from travels: ἄλλοθεν ἐ. ἐόντα Od. 16.26. Cf. Od. 16.202, 301, 355, 462, Od. 19.477, Od. 21.207, Od. 23.2, 29, 71.
Within one, in one's breast: κραδίη ἐ. ὑλάκτει Od. 20.13, 16. Cf. Od. 11.337 = Od. 18.249, Od. 14.178, Od. 24.382.
In the usual place, where one would expect to find a thing: ἐ., ὀΐομαι, [τεύχεά ἐστιν] Od. 22.140.

p.gloss: To make a splash or thud in falling into.

div.p: With dat.: μέσσῳ ἐνδούπησα Od. 12.443, ἄντλῳ ἐνδούπησε πεσοῦσα Od. 15.479.

Kindly, in gentle wise, with care for one's well-being: ἔτραφέ με Il. 23.90, ἱκέτεω πεφιδήσεται Il. 24.158 = 187. Cf. Il. 24.438: Od. 7.256, Od. 10.65, 450, Od. 14.62, 337, Od. 15.305, 491, 543 = Od. 17.56, Od. 17.111, 113, Od. 19.195 = Od. 24.272,
Od. 24.212, 390.
App., with kindly or grateful feelings: κρέʼ ἤσθιεν Od. 14.109.
Fem. aor. pple. ἐνδῦσα Il. 5.736, Il. 8.387.
To get into, put on (clothes): χιτῶνα Il. 2.42, Il. 5.736 = Il. 8.387, Il. 10.21, 131.
3 sing. impf. ἐνῆεν Il. 1.593. ἐνέην Od. 9.164, Od. 19.443.

To be or exist in a specified or indicated place, to be or exist in some person or thing: ὀλίγος ἔτι θυμὸς ἐνῆεν Il. 1.593, οὐκ οἴκοι ἔνεστι γόος; Il. 24.240. Cf. Il. 5.477, Il. 6.244: Od. 19.443, Od. 21.12, 60.
With dat.: εἰ Τρώεσσι μένος ἐνείη Il. 17.156. Cf. Il. 2.490: Od. 10.45.
To be available in an indicated place: ἐνέην [οἶνος] Od. 9.164.

p.gloss: On account of, because of, for.

div.head: a
div.p: Of causes: ἕνεκʼ ἀρητῆρος Il. 1.94, τοῦδʼ ἕνεκα 110, εἵνεκα κούρης 298, εἵνεκα ποινῆς (on the subject of . . .) Il. 18.498. Cf. Il. 1.214, Il. 3.100 (twice), Il. 6.525, Il. 16.18, Il. 20.21, 298, etc.: εἵνεκα σεῖο Od. 6.156, βάτων ἕνεκα (for protection from . . .) Od. 24.230. Cf. Od. 2.191, Od. 11.521, Od. 15.233, Od. 16.31, Od. 24.251, etc.

div.head: b
div.p: Of objects: εἵνεκα κούρης (to fetch . . .) Il. 1.336, σεῦ ἕνεκα Il. 3.206, ἕνεχʼ ἵππων Il. 5.640. Cf. Il. 2.138, Il. 3.290, Il. 9.327, 560, Il. 17.92, Il. 18.171, etc.: σῆς μητέρος εἵνεκα (in the course of their suit) Od. 3.212, εἵνεκα πατρός (in quest of . . .) Od. 4.672, εἵνεκα πομπῆς (seeking . . .) Od. 8.33, εἵνεκα κούρης (as her bride-price) 319. Cf. Od. 13.263, Od. 14.70, Od. 16.334, Od. 19.413, Od. 21.155, etc.

For the sake of, to do pleasure or service to: ἕνεκα θνητῶν Il. 1.574. Cf. Il. 1.174, Il. 8.428, Il. 10.27, Il. 16.539, Il. 21.380, 463, Il. 22.236, Il. 23.608, Il. 24.501: ὑῶν ἕνεκα (in care of them) Od. 14.416, ἕνεκα γαστρός (to satisfy it) Od. 15.344. Cf. Od. 4.170, Od. 8.544, Od. 17.288, Od. 19.377.
App. on the analogy of ὕπερθε.]

Beneath, below: νέρθε ποσσὶν ἤϊεν Il. 7.212 (the feet being contrasted with the face), θώρηκος ἔνερθε (app., below on the . . . , taking the genit. as partitive) Il. 11.234. Cf. Il. 11.282, 535 = Il. 20.500, Il. 13.75, 78, Il. 16.347, Il. 20.57, Il. 22.452: Od. 9.385, Od. 13.163, Od. 20.352.
With genit.: ἀγκῶνος ἔνερθε Il. 11.252. Cf. Il. 8.16, Il. 14.204: Od. 11.302.
Those beneath the earth, the dwellers below Il. 15.188, Il. 20.61.
App. on the analogy of ὑπέρ-τερος.]
That is beneath or below: θεοί Il. 15.225.
[ἐνετός, verbal adj. of ἐνίημι. What is sent or thrust in.]
To sleep in or upon something Od. 3.350.
With dat.: χλαῖναν καὶ κώεα τοῖσιν ἐνεῦδεν Od. 20.95.
In or on the bed: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον (sc. δέρμα) (his own bedcovering) Od. 14.51.
Absol., app., a sleeper: χήτει ἐνευναίων Od. 16.35.
The quality of being ἐνηής: ἐνηείης τις Πατροκλῆος μνησάσθω Il. 17.670.
App., gentle, amiable, kindly disposed or the like: ἑταῖρον Il. 17.204, Il. 21.96, μέμνησαί μευ ἐνηέος (as being kindly disposed to you) Il. 23.648. Cf. Il. 23.252: Od. 8.200.
To be seated in a specified place: ἵνʼ ἐνήμεθα Od. 4.272.
A form difficult to explain. Most MSS. read ἀνήνοθε (q.v.).

Thither, there: ἢν ἐ. ἀφίκηαι Il. 8.482. Cf. Il. 6.318, Il. 13.23, Il. 14.169, etc.: Od. 1.427, Od. 3.297, Od. 4.8, 407, etc.–ἐ. . . . ἐ., hither . . . thither, in this direction . . . in that Il. 2.90, 397, 462, Il. 5.223, Il. 10.264 (in rows), Il. 18.543 (up and down the field), Il. 23.164 (a hundred feet square), 320 ( to right and left), etc.: Od. 2.213 (thither and back again), Od. 5.327, Od. 7.86 (lengthwise and breadth-wise), Od. 10.517 (a cubit square), Od. 14.11, Od. 19.524, Od. 20.24, etc.
Whither: ἐς Τροίην, ἐ. περ ἔβαν Od. 1.210.
To where: βὰν δʼ ἴμεν ἐ. . . . Il. 13.789. Cf. Il. 4.247, Il. 24.733.

div.head: a
div.p: Then, at that time: ἐ. ἄλλοι οἴκοι ἔσαν Od. 1.11. Cf. Il. 4.223, 345, etc.: Od. 1.18, etc.

div.head: b
div.p: Then, after that, thereupon: ἐ. ἄλλοι ἐπευφήμησαν Il. 1.22. Cf. Il. 2.155, Il. 8.268, etc.: Od. 2.382, Od. 4.259, Od. 5.388, Od. 10.538, etc.
In reference to seeing: ἐ. ἐφαίνετʼ Ἴδη Il. 13.13. Cf. Od. 12.230.
To birth: γένος μοι ἐ. ὅθεν σοί Il. 4.58.
To taking up a lay from a specified point: ἐ. ἑλὼν ὡς . . . (from the point where . . .) Od. 8.500.
ἐ . . . ἑτέρωθι . . ., on one side . . . on the other . . . Od. 12.235.
Whence: ἐ. ἀπῆλθεν Il. 17.703. Cf. Il. 24.597: Od. 4.220, Od. 5.195, Od. 18.157, etc.
Then, thereupon: ἐ. ἂν ἐπιφρασσαίμεθα βουλήν Il. 13.741.
Sim.: ἐ. πέτραι ἐπηρεφέες (then come . . .) Od. 12.59.
From here, hence: ἐ. χρυσὸν ἄξομαι Il. 9.365. Cf. Il. 8.527: Od. 11.69.
To leap into: μέσσῳ Il. 21.233, πόντῳ Il. 24.79.
To leap in among: ὁμίλῳ Il. 15.623.
To leap against: λὰξ ἔνθορεν ἰσχίῳ (i.e. kicked it) Od. 17.233.
Taken to heart Od. 13.421 (a subject of anxiety).
With or without dat.: φρένες οὐκ ἔνι Il. 23.104. Cf. Il. 14.141, 216, Il. 18.53, Il. 20.248: ᾧ ἔνι λωτός Od. 4.603, οὔ οἱ ἔνι τρίχες Od. 18.355. Cf. Od. 4.846, Od. 9.126, Od. 11.367, Od. 21.288.
[prob. the time when the heavens are again ἐνὶ αὐτῷ, in the same position, and thus properly rather an epoch than a period.]

Considered as a point or unit of time or as one of a series: ἐννέα βεβάασιν Il. 2.134, δεκάτῳ Il. 12.15 (at the tenth turn of the year, at the end of the tenth year). Cf. Il. 2.295, 551: ὅτʼ ἐ. ἔην (when the turn of the year had come) Od. 10.469. Cf. Od. 1.16, Od. 2.175, Od. 3.391, Od. 11.248, Od. 16.18, Od. 17.327.

Considered as a space of time: ἐς δεκάτους ἐνιαυτούς Il. 8.404 = 418 ( see δέκατος 1), πέντε ἐνιαυτούς Il. 23.833. Cf. Il. 19.32, Il. 21.444: τλαίης (τλαίην) ἂν ἐνιαυτόν (for a year) Od. 1.288, Od. 2.219. Cf. Od. 4.86, 526, 595, Od. 10.467, Od. 11.356, Od. 14.196, 292, Od. 15.230, 455.
To pass the night in a specified place: ἔνθʼ ἀνὴρ ἐνίαυεν Od. 9.187.
To put or throw into a vessel: [φάρμακον] Od. 4.233.
To send forward into the fight Il. 14.131.
To send (in order to make up a number): ἄλλην ἐνίησιν ἐναρίθμιον εἶναι Od. 12.65.
To launch one's ship into (the sea) put to (sea).
With dat.: ἐνήσομεν πόντῳ Od. 2.295. Cf. Od. 12.293, 401.
With dat., to set (a person) upon, incline (him) to: ἀγηνορίῃσιν Il. 9.700.
To involve in, bring within the compass of: πόνοισιν Il. 10.89: ὁμοφροσύνῃσιν (will incline us to . . .) Od. 15.198.
To inspire: μένος Il. 19.37. Cf. Il. 17.570: Od. 13.387.
With dat.: τοῖσιν κότον Il. 16.449. Cf. Il. 16.656, Il. 20.80, Il. 23.390.
Rebuke or reproach as felt by the person rebuked or reproached: ἀποθέσθαι ἐνιπήν Il. 5.492.
An instance of this, a rebuke or reproach so considered: αἰδεσθεὶς βασιλῆος ἐνιπήν Il. 4.402. Cf. Il. 14.104: Od. 10.448.
App., a threat: φεύγων Ποσειδάωνος ἐνιπάς Od. 5.446.
Nom. pl. masc. pple. ἐνιπλήξαντες Il. 15.344.

p.gloss: To fall into, get into, get caught or entangled in.

div.p: With dat.: τάφρῳ Il. 12.72, Il. 15.344: ἕρκει Od. 22.469.
[ἐνι-, ἐν- 1, ἐν- 3 + σκίμπτω = σκήπτω. See σκήπτομαι.]
3 sing. aor. pass. ἐνισκίμφθη Il. 16.612, Il. 17.528.
With dat.: δόρυ οὔδει ἐνισκίμφθη Il. 16.612 = Il. 17.528.

p.gloss: To cause or allow to rest upon.

div.p: With dat.: οὔδει ἐνισκίμψαντε καρήατε Il. 17.437.
θυγατέρεσσίν τε καὶ υἱάσι βέλτερον εἴη ἐνισσέμεν [αὐτούς] (it is better for them that he should scold them, i.e. it is better that he should scold them) Il. 15.198.
Of the value of nine oxen.
Nine cubits long or in extent: ζυγόδεσμον Il. 24.270: ἐννεαπήχεες εὖρος (in . . .) Od. 11.311.
Nine fathoms in extent: μῆκος ἐννεόργυιοι (in . . .) Od. 11.312.
Fut. ἐνισπήσω (ἐνι-, ἐν-) Od. 5.98. ἐνίψω Od. 2.137.
Imp. pl. ἔσπετε (prob. for ἔνσπετε) Il. 2.484, Il. 11.218, Il. 14.508, Il. 16.112.

To say, tell, tell of or about, communicate, make known: τὸν ὄνειρον Il. 2.80. Cf. Il. 7.447, Il. 8.412, Il. 11.186, 839, Il. 14.107, Il. 24.388: κείνου ὄλεθρον Od. 3.93 = Od. 4.323. Cf. Od. 2.137, Od. 4.314, 317, Od. 5.98, Od. 9.37, Od. 11.492, Od. 12.112, Od. 14.185, Od. 17.549, 556, 561, Od. 24.414.
To tell about, tell the tale of (a person) Od. 1.1.
With dependent clause, to say, tell: οἵ τινες . . . Il. 2.484, ὅππως . . . Il. 16.112. Cf. Il. 2.761, Il. 11.218, Il. 14.508: Od. 8.101, 251, Od. 22.166, Od. 23.35.

div.head: a
div.p: To say, tell, speak: νημερτὲς ἐνίσπες Il. 14.470. Cf. Il. 6.438: Od. 3.101 = Od. 4.331, Od. 3.247, 327, Od. 4.642, Od. 11.148, Od. 17.529.

div.head: b
div.p: To talk, hold converse: πρὸς ἀλλήλους Il. 11.643: Od. 23.301 (exchanging tales).
[ἐνίημι. For ἐνεσίη, which could not stand in the hexameter.]
Nine years old, at nine years old Od. 11.311.
App. (the number being taken as a round one) conveying the notion of full maturity, well matured, full-grown: ἀλείφατος Il. 18.351: βοός Od. 10.19, σιάλοισιν 390.
In Od. 19.179 (μίνως ἐ. βασίλευε Διὸς ὀαριστής) the reference seems to be to an eightyearly tenure of kingship. See Frazer, Golden Bough, 3 rd ed., Part iii. Od. 17.58 foll., esp. Od. 17.70.

On the analogy of διὰ τρίτης ἡμέρας, every second day, and similar expressions, ἐ. is to be translated by terms of eight years, fresh kingly power being supposed to be imparted in converse with Zeus at the end of each term.
Also ἐνενήκοντα Il. 2.602 (a form difficult to explain).
[ἐνϝοσι- (ἐν- 1 or (3) + ϝοθ-, ὠθέω) + γαῖα. Cf. εἰνοσίφυλλος, ἐνοσίχθων.]

Epithet or a name of Poseidon. Lord of earthquakes; or perh., who is ever beating the earth with his waves Il. 7.455, Il. 8.201, 440, Il. 9.362, Il. 12.27, Il. 14.135, 510, Il. 15.173, 184, 218, Il. 20.20, 310, Il. 21.462: Od. 5.423, Od. 6.326, Od. 9.518, Od. 11.102, Od. 13.140.
Mid. Pres. infin. ἕννυσθαι Od. 6.28, Od. 14.514, 522.
3 sing. aor. ἑέσσατο (ἐϝεσσατο) Il. 10.23, 177: Od. 14.529. ἕσατο Il. 14.178. ἕσσατο Il. 7.207, Il. 10.334: Od. 6.228.
To put (clothes) on a person, clothe him with (them): εἵματα ἕσσε Il. 5.905. Cf. Il. 16.670, 680: Od. 4.253, Od. 7.265, Od. 8.366, Od. 13.400, Od. 16.457, Od. 24.59.
To put (clothes) on (a person), clothe (him) with (them).
So of induing with armour: Πάτροκλον περὶ τὰ ἃ τεύχεα ἕσσεν Il. 18.451.

div.head: a
div.p: To put (clothes) on oneself, put (them) on: ἀμφʼ ἑανὸν ἕσατο Il. 14.178. Cf. Il. 10.23, 177, 334: χλαῖναν ἕννυτο Od. 5.229. Cf. Od. 2.3 = Od. 4.308 = Od. 20.125, Od. 5.230 = Od. 10.543, Od. 6.28, 228, Od. 14.529.
In reference to a covering other than clothes: ἠέρα ἑσσαμένω Il. 14.282. Cf. Il. 14.350, Il. 20.150.
The infin. in complementary sense: οὐ πολλαὶ χλαῖναί [εἰσι] ἕννυσθαι (to cover oneself withal) Od. 14.514. Cf. Il. 24.646: = Od. 4.299 = Od. 7.338, Od. 14.522.

div.head: b
div.p: To put on (one's armour): περὶ χροῒ ἕσσατο τεύχεα Il. 7.207. Cf. Il. 14.383, Il. 19.233, Il. 23.803: Od. 24.467 = 500.
So of assuming a shield: [ἀσπίδας] ἑσσάμενοι Il. 14.372.
In pf. and plupf., to be in the state of having put on (clothes, etc.); hence

div.head: a
div.p: To have on (clothes), be clad in (them), wear (them): χιτῶνας εἵατο Il. 18.596. Cf.Il. 18.517, Il. 23.67: κακὰ εἵματα εἷται Od. 11.191. Cf. Od. 15.331, Od. 16.199, Od. 17.203 = Od. 24.158, Od. 17.338, Od. 19.72, 218, 237, 327, Od. 22.363, Od. 23.115, Od. 24.227, 250.
In reference to a covering other than clothes: εἱμένος νεφέλην Il. 15.308.
Fig.: λάϊνόν χʼ ἕσσο χιτῶνα (would have been stoned) Il. 3.57, εἱμένος ἀλκήν Il. 20.381.

div.head: b
div.p: To have on, wear (armour): χαλκῷ, τὸν ἕεστο Il. 12.464. Cf. Il. 4.432.
Of a weapon, to be armed or pointed (with something): ξυστὰ κατὰ στόμα εἱμένα χαλκῷ Il. 15.389.
Doing somthing by night, by night, in the night-time: ἐ. προμολών Il. 21.37. Cf. Il. 11.683: Od. 3.178.
The shouting of fighters, the din of battle: μάχη ἐ. τε Il. 12.35, Τρώων ἐξ ἐνοπῆς (from the shouting throng) Il. 16.782, Il. 17.714. Cf. Il. 16.246.
The sound of mourning, weeping, wailing: ἐνοπήν τε γόον τε Il. 24.160.
The sound of musical instruments: αὐλῶν συρίγγων τʼ ἐνοπήν Il. 10.13.
3 sing. aor. mid. ἐνῶρτο Il. 1.599: Od. 8.326.
To awaken or induce in a person an inclination for (something), to turn him to (something): φύζαν Il. 15.62.

p.gloss: To awaken or induce an inclination for (something) in a person, to turn him to (something).

div.p: With dat.: τῇσι γόον ἐνῶρσεν Il. 6.499. Cf. Il. 15.366.
In mid., to be caused or brought about among, to break out among.
With dat.: ἐνῶρτο γέλως θεοῖσιν Il. 1.599: = Od. 8.326.
To leap or spring upon the foe: τῇ ἐνόρουσεν Il. 11.149. Cf. Il. 11.747.
With dat.: Τρωσίν Il. 16.783. Cf. Il. 10.486.
[for ἐνϝοσίχθων, fr. ἐνϝοσι- as in ἐννοσίγαιος + χθών.]
To drop into; hence, to instil in.
With dat.: εἴ τοι σοῦ πατρὸς ἐνέστακται μένος ἠΰ Od. 2.271.
In mid., to turn or have movement in (a socket).
With dat.: ἔνθα μηρὸς ἰσχίῳ ἐνστρέφεται Il. 5.306.
To bend (a bow) into the position required for stringing it, to string (it) (cf. τανύω 2): οὐδὲ τόξον ἐντάνυσεν Od. 21.150. Cf. Od. 19.577 = Od. 21.75, Od. 21.92, 247, 286, 306, 315, 326, 338, 403.
To stretch (the string) so as to string a bow: νευρήν Od. 19.587, Od. 21.97 = 127, Od. 24.171.
Thither, in that direction, to an indicated course of action: μή σε δαίμων ἐ. τρέψειεν Il. 9.601.
Armour, harness, warlike trappings or array (not of arms) (cf. τεὐχεα): ἕντεʼ ἔδυνεν Il. 3.339. Cf. Il. 6.418, Il. 10.34, Il. 12.195, Il. 13.640, Il. 17.162, etc.: Od. 19.17, Od. 23.368.
To strain tight (with interplaited straps): δίφρος ἱμᾶσιν ἐντέταται Il. 5.728. Cf. Il. 10.263.
An intestine; a piece of gut made therefrom Od. 21.408.
In pl. ἔντερα, the bowels or intestinesIl. 13.507 = Il. 17.314. Il. 14.517, Il. 20.418, 420.
[ἔντεσι dat. of ἔντεα in sense a draught-beast's harness + ἔργω2.]
Working in harness, draught- . . .: ἡμιόνους Il. 24.277.
Aor. infin. ἐνθέμεναι Il. 24.646: Od. 4.299, Od. 7.338.
To put or place upon something: χλαῖνας Il. 24.646: = Od. 4.299 = Od. 7.338.
In mid.: ἐνθεμένη σε λεχέεσσιν Il. 21.124, Il. 22.353.
To put on board a ship: σῖτον ἐνθήσω Od. 5.166.

div.head: a

p.gloss: To lay or store up in (one's heart).

div.p: With dat.: χόλον ἔνθεο θυμῷ Il. 6.326. Cf. Od. 11.102, Od. 13.342, Od. 24.248.

div.head: b
div.p: With dat.: μῦθον ἔνθετο θυμῷ Od. 1.361 = Od. 21.355.

div.head: c
div.p: To bring (one's heart) into a specified state: ἵλαον ἔνθεο θυμόν Il. 9.639.

div.head: d

p.gloss: To put or reckon in (a rank or category).

div.p: With dat.: μὴ πατέρας ὁμοίῃ ἔνθεο τιμῇ Il. 4.410.

Within, inside: τρομέοντό οἱ φρένες ἐ. (in his breast) Il. 10.10, ἐ. ἔχον (enclosing, guarding) Il. 12.8, πλῆσθέν οἱ μέλεʼ ἐ. ἀλκῆς Il. 17.211: ἐ. ἔχοντες (containing) Od. 2.341, μὴ ἐ. πυκάζοιεν σφέας αὐτούς (in the bottom of the ship) Od. 12.225.–ἐ. ἐέργειν, to bound(so that what is bounded is) within the boundary (what is bounded being regarded from the outside) Il. 2.617, 845, Il. 9.404 (shuts in, holds), Il. 18.512 (contained), Il. 22.121 (contains), Il. 24.544: Od. 7.88 (shut in, closed).
Within, inside: μένουσιν Il. 22.237. Cf. Il. 10.262, Il. 12.296, 455: Od. 12.241, Od. 13.100.
In mid., to turn oneself towards something; hence, to heed, have regard, care: οὐ σοὶ ἐντρέπεται ἦτορ Od. 1.60.
To pay heed to, have regard or care for.
To move freely, have free play, in something Il. 19.385.

To keep turning round towards
or to face a person or persons Il. 6.496, Il. 11.547, Il. 17.109.
App., to keep turning or twisting in another's grasp Il. 21.492.
Acc. sing. fem. pple. ἐντύνασαν Il. 14.162.
2 sing. aor. subj. mid. ἐντύνεαι Od. 6.33.
To make ready, prepare: δέπας Il. 9.203.
In mid., to make ready (a meal) for oneself, prepare (a meal): ἐντύνοντʼ ἄριστον Il. 24.124. Cf. Od. 3.33, Od. 15.500, Od. 16.2, Od. 17.175, 182.
To array or deck (oneself): εὖ ἐντύνασαν ἓ αὐτήν Il. 14.162.
In mid., to array or deck oneself, make oneself ready: ὄφρʼ ἐντύνεαι Od. 6.33. Cf. Od. 12.18.
[prob. ἐν 2 + τυπ-, τύπτω. Beating oneself into.]
Thus, closely, tightly: ἐ. ἐν χλαίνῃ κεκαλυμμένος Il. 24.163.
To make ready, prepare: εὐνήν Od. 23.289.
To get (horses) ready for yoking Il. 5.720 = Il. 8.382.
In neut. sing. ἐνύπνιον as adv., in one's sleep Il. 2.56: = Od. 14.495.
The face in generalized sense: κατʼ ἐνῶπα ἰδὼν Δαναῶν (in the face of the . . .) Il. 15.320 (see κατά II.2.e).
In dat. sing. ἐνωπῇ, openly, in the sight of allIl. 5.374 = Il. 21.510.
The inner face of walls, inner walls. Of the inner walls of a κλισίη Il. 13.261.
App. of one of the wall-spaces on each side of the entrance of the μέγαρον, facing theαὐλή Od. 4.42.
Of a similar space in front of the palace of Zeus Il. 8.435.
App. of one of the wall-spaces on each side of the entrance of the μέγαρον within Od. 22.121.
Absol.: ἓξ ἐγένοντο Il. 5.270. Cf. Il. 24.604: Od. 10.6, Od. 22.252.
To bring forth word: Ἑρμέᾳ Il. 5.390.
3 sing. aor. ἐξήγαγε Il. 5.35. ἐξάγαγε Il. 16.188: Od. 20.21.
Nom. pl. masc. aor. pple. ἐξαγαγόντες Il. 7.336, 435, Il. 13.379: Od. 22.441, 458.
To lead, bring or conduct forth Il. 1.337, Il. 21.29: Od. 8.106.
Of an immaterial agency: ὄφρα σε μῆτις ἐξάγαγʼ ἐξ ἄντροιο Od. 20.21.
Of bringing to the birth Il. 16.188.
To bring or fetch: σκυρόθεν Il. 19.332.

p.gloss: To lead, bring or conduct out of or from.

div.p: To bring or fetch (inanimate objects): τύμβον ἐξαγαγόντες ἄκριτον ἐκ πεδίου Il. 7.336, 435 (app., bringing (the materials for) it without selection from . . .).
With genit., in reference to spoil: Τροίης Od. 5.39 = Od. 13.137.
[ἕξ + -α- (on the analogy of numerals in -α) + ἔτος.]
To take out (and deposit): νηῒ ἐνὶ πρύμνῃ δῶρα Od. 15.206.
To take away, deprive of: θυμόν Il. 5.848.
With double acc. of what is taken and of the person deprived: θυμὸν ἀμφοτέρω Il. 5.155. Cf. Il. 20.459.
Picked out, chosen, choice: γυναῖκες Il. 2.227.
Picked out or selected from among (a community).
To take out: ἔνθεν πέπλους Il. 24.229. Cf. Od. 22.110, 144.
To pick out from the spoil as guerdon to a chief: Ἑκαμήδην Il. 11.627. Cf. Il. 16.56, Il. 18.444: Od. 7.10.
Sim. of a special share of beasts slain in hunting Od. 9.160.

div.head: a
div.p: To take away, effect deprivation of: τέκνα ἐξείλοντο Od. 16.218.
With immaterial object: φρένας Il. 6.234, Il. 17.470.
With genit.: φρένας μευ ἐξέλετο Il. 19.137. Cf. Il. 24.754: Od. 11.201, Od. 22.388.

p.gloss: To take out of for use.

div.head: c
div.p: To pick out or select for oneself from the spoil: κειμήλια ἐξελόμην Il. 9.331 (or perh. rather, took from the cities): ἄσπετα πολλά Il. 11.704. Cf. Il. 2.690, Il. 9.130, 272.

p.gloss: To pick out or select for oneself from (the spoil).

div.p: With genit.: τῶν ἐξαιρεύμην μενοεικέα Od. 14.232.
Going beyond measure, unreasonable: ἀρήν Il. 15.598.
Absol. in neut. ἐξαίσιον, something contrary to right, something unfair or arbitraryOd. 4.690.
[perh. ἐξ- 1 + αἰτέω. Asked for out of.]
On a sudden, suddenly: πῦρ ὄρμενον ἐ. Il. 17.738, Il. 21.14.
To bring remedy or cure Il. 9.507.
To moderate or depart from (one's wrath) Il. 4.36.
To take the power of sight from (an eye) Od. 9.453, 504.

Infin. ἐξαλαπάξαι
Il. 1.129, Il. 4.33, 40, Il. 8.241, 288: Od. 3.85.
To deport the population from (a city) Od. 4.176.
To destroy: νῆας Il. 13.813, τεῖχος Il. 20.30.
Aor. pple. ἐξάλμενος Il. 15.571, Il. 17.342, Il. 23.399.
To spring forth from the throng Il. 15.571.
With genit.: αὐλῆς Il. 5.142. Cf. Il. 17.342.

p.gloss: To get oneself clear of (competitors in a race).

div.p: Fem. pl. aor. pple. ἐξαναβᾶσαι (v.l. εἰσαναβᾶσαι).

p.gloss: To rise up or emerge from out of.

div.p: With genit.: ἁλός Od. 4.405, κύματος Od. 5.438.

p.gloss: To set free from or from the power of.

div.p: Openly, plainly, clearly: ἐρέω τοι Od. 20.48.
To send up and forth, emit in an upward direction: φῦσαι ἀϋτμήν Il. 18.471.
To give accomplishment to, bring to pass: Θέτιδος βουλάς Il. 8.370.
To make and end of, slay Il. 11.365 = Il. 20.452.
To trick, cheat, beguile, deal unfairly with Il. 9.371, Il. 22.299.
Absol., to work deceit, induce a false belief Od. 9.414.
3 sing. aor. opt. mid. ἐξαπάφοιτο Il. 9.376, Il. 14.160.
To trick, cheat, beguile, deceive Od. 14.379, Od. 23.79.
On a sudden, suddenly, unexpectedly: ἐλθόντʼ ἐ. Il. 5.91. Cf. Il. 9.6, Il. 15.325, Il. 16.598, Il. 17.57: Od. 10.557, Od. 12.288, Od. 14.29, 38, Od. 21.196, Od. 24.160.
To land or disembark from (a ship).
3 pl. aor. opt. mid. ἐξαπολοίατο Il. 6.60.

p.gloss: To perish out of, disappear from.

div.p: With genit.: πάντες Ἰλίου Il. 6.60. Cf. Il. 18.290: Od. 20.357.

p.gloss: To wash with water from (a vessel).

div.p: With genit.: λέβητα, τοῦ πόδας ἐξαπένιζεν Od. 19.387.
To pay the full price in respect of, suffer the consequences of Il. 21.412.
To fasten from (i.e. to) something indicated Il. 22.397.
With genit.: Ἕκτορα ἵππων Il. 24.51. Cf. Od. 22.466.
In mid., to fasten oneself to something; hence, to lay hold Il. 8.20.
3 sing. aor. ἐξήρπαξε Il. 3.380, Il. 20.443, Il. 21.597.
To snatch away Il. 3.380, Il. 20.443, Il. 21.597.
To take the lead in, give a lead in, begin.
To take the lead in giving (counsel): βουλὰς ἐξάρχων Il. 2.273.
To speak out: ἐξαύδα, μὴ κεῦθε Il. 1.363 = Il. 16.19, Il. 18.74.
In the reverse direction, back, back again: ἰών Il. 5.134, Il. 13.642.
In a direction contrary to one's proper direction, back: ἀναρπάξασα θύελλα Od. 5.419. Cf. Il. 16.654.

p.gloss: Back to a former state or condition, again.

div.p: With αὖτε: αὖτʼ ἐ. ἀνέστη Il. 15.287.
Of repetition of action in a similar form: ἐ. μείζονα λᾶαν ἀείρας Od. 9.537.
To draw off (wine): οἷνον ἐξαφύοντες Od. 14.95.
In an indicated order, in a row or rows: ἵσταντο Il. 23.839: ἀρηρότες Od. 2.342. Cf. Od. 1.145, Od. 4.408, 580, Od. 6.94, Od. 9.8, Od. 19.574, Od. 22.471, etc.
In regular turns or convolutions: ἑξείης κατέδησαν [ζυγόδεσμον] Il. 24.274.
In sequence, one after another: εὔχεσθαι πάσας ἑξείης Il. 6.241. Cf. Il. 15.137, Il. 22.240: Od. 11.134, Od. 12.177, Od. 17.450, Od. 21.141, Od. 23.281.
Infin. ἐξιέναι Il. 18.448: Od. 1.374. ἐξίμεναι Od. 11.531 (v.l. ἐξέμεναι).
In pres. with fut. sense, to go forth Od. 20.179, 367.
To speak out, say one's say Il. 9.61.
To make a disclosure, tell a thing Il. 24.654: Od. 15.443.
Mid. form 3 sing. subj. ἐξερέηται Od. 1.416.
3 sing. opt. ἐξερέοιτο Od. 4.119, Od. 7.17, Od. 24.238.
With indirect question: ὅτις εἴη Od. 7.17.
To ask or inquire about: Διὸς βουλήν Il. 20.15. Cf. Od. 3.116, Od. 13.127, 411, Od. 14.375, Od. 19.166.
To question (a person): Ζῆνα Il. 5.756. Cf. Il. 24.361: Od. 3.24, Od. 4.119 = Od. 24.238, Od. 10.249, Od. 19.99.
With double acc. of person questioned and of what is inquired about: θεοπροπίης ἥν τινα θεοπρόπον ἐξερέηται Od. 1.416.
To go through in questing, traverse: κνημούς Od. 4.337 = Od. 17.128.
To give information asked for, tell Od. 9.365.
In pres. only in pple. in form ἐξελάων Od. 10.83.
3 sing. aor. ἐξήλασε Od. 9.312. ἐξέλασε Il. 5.324, Il. 11.360, Il. 13.401.
To drive a flock or herd out to pasture Od. 10.83.
To drive or scare (a domestic animal) off or away: [ὄνον] Il. 11.562.
To drive or conduct (such animals) out of.
In reference to persons, to drive or chase away, expel Il. 8.527.

p.gloss: To drive out of, expel from.

div.p: With genit.: ἄστεος Il. 21.360. Cf. Od. 2.248.

p.gloss: To drive out or banish from.

div.p: To drive or force from a position taken up Il. 15.417.
To drive off (cattle) as spoil Od. 11.292.
With genit.: Τρώων Il. 5.324 = Il. 13.401. Cf. Il. 10.499.
Absol., to drive one's chariot off Il. 11.360.

p.gloss: To drive one's chariot beyond the line of.

div.p: With genit.: ὀδόντας κε γναθμῶν ἐξελάσαιμι Od. 18.29.

p.gloss: To draw or drag out of.

div.p: With genit.: πουλύποδος θαλάμης ἐξελκομένοιο Od. 5.432.
To pull in a specified direction: πηνίον ἐξέλκουσα παρὲκ μίτον Il. 23.762.
To disgorge, throw up. Of charybdis: ἱστόν Od. 12.437.
To vomit forth or throw up waters. Of the same Od. 12.237.
To strip (a slain foe) of his armour and trappings: περίφαντα Il. 5.842. Cf. Il. 6.417, Il. 11.246, 368, Il. 22.376.
To strip off (the armour and trappings): τεύχεα Il. 7.146, Il. 13.619 = Il. 17.537 = Il. 21.183.
To kill or slay in fight Il. 4.488, Il. 5.151, Il. 6.20, Il. 11.101, Il. 12.187, etc.: Od. 22.264.
To kill or slay in gen. Il. 16.573: Od. 11.273.
To ask, inquire, make inquiry Il. 9.672, Il. 10.543.
To inquire about Od. 10.14, Od. 12.34, Od. 17.70, Od. 19.116, 463.
To go through, traverse: πόρους ἁλός Od. 12.259.
To fall: ὅτʼ ἐξερίπῃ δρῦς Il. 14.414.
With genit.: χαίτη ζεύγλης ἐξεριποῦσα Il. 17.440, Il. 19.406.
3 sing. aor. ἐξείρυσε Il. 23.870. ἐξέρυσε Il. 5.112, Il. 13.532, Il. 16.505, Il. 20.323: Od. 9.397.
To draw or pull out Il. 16.505.
To pull out or away in way of mutilation: μήδεα Od. 18.87, Od. 22.476.
With genit., to draw or pull out of: βέλος ὤμου Il. 5.112. Cf. Il. 5.666, Il. 13.532, Il. 20.323: Od. 9.397.
To snatch out of: χειρὸς τόξον Il. 23.870.
To drag, haul or pull out or away: δίφρον ῥυμοῦ (by the pole) Il. 10.505: ἰχθύας δικτύῳ Od. 22.386. Cf. Il. 10.490.
To drag or haul out of the power of the enemy: νεκρούς Il. 13.194.
Infin. ἐξελθέμεναι Od. 4.283. ἐξελθεῖν Il. 9.576, Il. 22.237, 413.
To go or issue forth or out: νῦν ἐξέλθωμεν Od. 8.100. Cf. Od. 4.283, Od. 15.396, Od. 19.68, Od. 21.90, Od. 24.491.

p.gloss: To go or issue forth from.

div.p: With genit.: πυλάων Il. 22.413. Cf. Il. 22.417: Od. 20.371, Od. 22.375.
To come or issue forth or out: θύρας ῥήξας ἐξῆλθον Il. 9.476. Cf. Il. 9.576: Od. 4.740 (quitting his retirement), Od. 10.230 = 256 = 312.

p.gloss: To come or issue forth from.

div.p: With genit.: τείχεος Il. 22.237: μεγάροιο Od. 21.229.
To swerve from the course: αἱ δʼ ἐξηρώησαν Il. 23.468.
An embassy or mission: ἐξεσίην ἐλθόντι (ἦλθεν) (on an . . .) Il. 24.235: Od. 21.20.
To find, discover: εἴ ποθεν ἐξεύροι [ἄνδρα] Il. 18.322.
With another numeral: τριηκόσιοί τε καὶ ἑ. Od. 14.20.
Formed by hammering out: ἀσπίδα Il. 12.295.
For or during six days: πλέομεν Od. 10.80 = Od. 15.476, δαίνυντο Od. 12.397 = Od. 14.249.
Serving for a change: εἵματʼ ἐξημοιβά (changes of raiment) Od. 8.249.
Aor. infin. ἐξέμεναι Od. 11.531 (v.l. ἐξίμεναι). ἐξέμεν Il. 11.141.
To send forth, allow to go forth: ἂψ ἐς Ἀχαιούς Il. 11.141: ἱππόθεν Od. 11.531.
To serve as a means of making straight: στάθμη δόρυ νήϊον ἐξιθύνει Il. 15.410.

To arrive at, reach: φθίην Il. 9.479, ἄλλων δῆμον (i.e. flies to . . ., takes refuge in . . .) Il. 24.481. Cf. Il. 8.439: νῆσον Od. 12.166, ἄλλον βασιλήων (i.e. betaken myself to . . .) Od. 13.206, Od. 20.223.
To hold or keep outside: ἔξω ἐξίσχει κεφαλὰς βερέθρου Od. 12.94.
To go forth: σὺν ἵπποισιν καὶ ὄχεσφιν Il. 9.384.
To have gone forth: ἐς Ἀθηναίης Il. 6.379, 384.
To destroy: τοὺς Ζεὺς ἐξολέσειεν Od. 17.597.
To tell the name of: τόνδʼ ἄνδρα Il. 3.166.
To speak of, mention: γάμον Od. 6.66.
Behind, in rear: πεζοὺς στῆσεν Il. 4.298.
With genit., behind: κεράων βοός Il. 17.521.
Falling or sinking down backwards: ἤριπε Il. 22.467. Cf. Il. 14.438, Il. 23.727.
In after time, in time to come Od. 4.35, Od. 13.144.
Of a ship, to sheer off from her course: κεῖσʼ ἐξορμήσασα Od. 12.221.
To increase or add to (something offered): ἐξώφελλεν ἔεδνα Od. 15.18.
[ἐξ- 5 + ὀχ-, ἔχω in intrans. sense. See ἔχω (II). Standing out.]
Distinguished beyond others in respect of some quality, pre-eminent Il. 2.188, Il. 12.269.
With genit.: ἐ. Ἀργείων κεφαλήν (standing above them by . . .) Il. 3.227, ἐ. αὐτῶν (among, beyond them) Il. 14.118. Cf. Il. 18.56 = 437: Od. 18.205.
Of superior excellence, preeminently fine, good or splendid: δώματα Od. 15.227.
With genit. as above: βοῦς ἐ. πάντων Il. 2.480. Cf. Il. 6.194, Il. 20.184.
So with dat.: αἶγας αἳ πᾶσιν ἔξοχοι αἰπολίοισιν Od. 21.266.
In neut. ἔξοχον as adv., beyond.
With genit.: ἐτίομεν ἐ. ἄλλων Il. 9.631, προμάχεσθαι ἐ. ἄλλων (advancing beyond . . .) Il. 17.358. Cf. Il. 9.641, Il. 13.499: Od. 4.171, Od. 5.118, Od. 6.158, Od. 19.247.
In neut. pl. ἔξοχα, especially, in a high degree, greatly, by far: ἐ. μιν ἐφίλατο Il. 5.61, ἐ. ἀρίστας Il. 9.638. Cf. Il. 20.158: Od. 4.629 = Od. 21.187, Od. 11.432, Od. 15.70, 71, Od. 22.244.
Sim.: δόσαν ἐ. (as a special meed of honour) Od. 9.551.
With genit.: ἔμʼ ἐ. πάντων ζήτει Il. 14.257. Cf. Il. 24.113, 134: Od. 8.487, Od. 24.78.
In an outward direction, out: ἴσαν Il. 24.247. Cf. Od. 14.526, Od. 23.138.
With genit., out of, from: μεγάροιο Od. 22.378. Cf. Il. 10.94, Il. 11.457.
Outside: σχέθον νῆα Od. 10.95. Cf. Il. 17.265.
With genit., outside of: βερέθρου Od. 12.94.
A high-day or feast: ἑ. τοῖο θεοῖο (i.e. Apollo) Od. 21.258. Cf. Od. 20.156.

div.head: a
div.p:
With the article: τοὺς
ἑοὺς ἵππους Il. 5.321.
Absol. with the article Il. 10.256, Il. 23.295.–

div.head: b
div.p: With the article: τὰ ἃ κῆλα Il. 12.280. Cf. Il. 15.58, etc.: Od. 9.250, Od. 11.515, etc.
Absol. with the article Il. 8.430, Il. 17.193.
App. of the first person: οὔ τοι ἐγώ γε ἧς γαίης δύναμαι γλυκερώτερον ἄλλο ἰδέσθαι Od. 9.28. Cf. Od. 13.320.

p.gloss: To exult in, take delight in.

div.p: To tell about something, give information: εἴσω Od. 4.775.
To go about collecting: λαοὺς οὐκ ἐπέοικε ταῦτʼ ἐπαγείρειν Il. 1.126 (prob. with double acc. like ἀφαιρέω 2.c).
Of hunters and their dogs, to drive on the game: ὡς ἐπάγοντες ἐπῇσαν Od. 19.445.
To bring into an indicated state of mind, induce to believe something Od. 14.392.
With genit.: [νεκροὺς] ἀμαξάων Il. 7.426. Cf. Il. 9.214.
Of a wind, to rush onwards Il. 2.148: Od. 15.293.

p.gloss: To express approval to, to agree or concur with (a person).

div.p: With dat.: οὔ τοι ἐπαινέομεν Il. 4.29 = Il. 16.443 = Il. 22.181. Cf. Il. 18.312.
To express approval of: μῦθον ἐπαινήσαντες Ὀδυσσῆος Il. 2.335.
Epithet of Persephoneia Il. 9.457, 569: Od. 10.491 = 564, Od. 10.534 = Od. 11.47.
3 sing. pa. iterative ἐπαΐξασκε Il. 17.462, Il. 18.159.
With genit.: Αἰνείαο ἵππων Il. 5.263, νεῶν Il. 13.687.
With dat.: Ἕκτορι προτὶ Ἴλιον (till he drove him even to . . .) Il. 23.64: Κίρκῃ Od. 10.295, 322, μοι Od. 14.281.
With acc., to rush at (in hostile sense): νῶϊ Il. 5.235, τεῖχος Il. 12.308.
To rush through, charge: μόθον ἵππων Il. 7.240.
To make a rush for: Αἰνείαο ἵππους Il. 5.323.
So ἐπαΐξαι μεθʼ ἑὸν βέλος Il. 13.513.
Of a hawk swooping on its prey Il. 22.142.
Absol., of limbs, to have their movements, dart forth.
In mid.: χεῖρες ὤμων ἐπαΐσσονται (from the . . .) Il. 23.628 (v.l. ἀπαΐσσονται).
To ask for besides or in addition: εἴ κʼ ἄλλο ἐπαιτήσειας Il. 23.593.
Blameworthy, to blame: οὔ τί μοι ὔμμες ἐπαίτιοι Il. 1.335.
To hear about, learn: Διὸς βουλήν Od. 14.328 = Od. 19.297.
With dependent clause: ὅττι μιν ἵκετο πένθος Il. 18.63.
To listen to, hearken to, give ear to: ἔπος Il. 9.100. Cf. Od. 17.584, Od. 24.262.
With genit. of the person to whose words one hearkens: ὄφρʼ ἔπος ἐπακούσῃ ἐμέθεν Od. 19.98.
A hunter: ἄνδρες ἐπακτῆρες Il. 17.135. Cf. Od. 19.435.

p.gloss: To wander or rove over or among.

div.p: With acc.: Κύπρον καὶ Αἰγυπτίους Od. 4.83. Cf. Od. 4.81, Od. 15.176, 401.
To find things intolerable: τὸν ἐπαλαστήσασα προσηύδα (breaking out) Od. 1.252.
Acc. sing. fem. pple. ἐπαλεξήσουσαν Il. 8.365.
Nom. pl. masc. aor. pple. ἐπαλλάξαντες. Fig., to pass and repass (a rope) over the two parties in a strife so as to knit them inseparably together Il. 13.359.
In mid., to pass or shift over.
With acc.: νίκη ἐπαμείβεται ἄνδρας (goes now to one now to another) Il. 6.339.
A protector or helper: τῷ ἦλθʼ ἐ. Il. 13.384. Cf. Od. 16.263.
To defend, protect, succour, fight for, come to the rescue of.

p.term: 3 sing. pf. Elsewhere 3 sing. plupf. (with secondary person-ending).

div.p: To be on the surface of something, show itself or be on something Il. 2.219, Il. 10.134.

p.gloss: To be on the surface of, cover.

div.p: With acc.: οἷα θεοὺς ἐπανήνοθεν Od. 8.365.
To stand or rise up at one's bidding Il. 2.85.
An incantation or charm: ἐπαοιδῂ αἷμʼ ἔσχεθον Od. 19.457.
With dat.: ἐπαπειλήσας Ἑλένῳ (with a threatening word or gesture directed to . . .) Il. 13.582.
With infin.: ὡς ἐπηπείλησεν, μὴ πρὶν ἀπονέεσθαι, πρὶν . . . Il. 14.45.
With acc. of what is threatened and dat. of the person: ἔριδος, τὴν ἐπηπείλησʼ Ἀχιλῇϊ Il. 1.319.
So with cognate acc.: ἀπειλάων, τὰς Ὀδυσῆϊ ἐπηπείλησεν Od. 13.127.

p.gloss: To fit to, to (construct and) attach to.

div.p: Intrans. in plupf., to be fitted on, be upon, something: μία κληΐς ἐπαρήρει Il. 12.456.
An imprecation: θεοὶ ἐτέλειον ἐπαράς Il. 9.456.
With dat.: Ὀδυσῆϊ Il. 23.783. Cf. Il. 24.39: Od. 13.391.
To ward off, afford protection against Od. 17.568.
With dat. of person protected: ὄλεθρόν οἱ Il. 2.873.
Of a hired labourer, app. attached in some way to a particular piece of land or estate Od. 11.489.
To fit or fix on Od. 8.447.
3 sing. aor. imp. mid. ἐπαρξάσθω Od. 18.418, Od. 21.263.
Pple. ἐπαρξάμενος, -ου Il. 1.471, Il. 9.176: Od. 3.340, Od. 7.183, Od. 21.272.

In mid., as a word of ritual, to go round a company and pour a few drops taken from the κρητήρ (into the drinking-cups) to be poured out as a libation before the cups were filled for drinking: ἐπαρξάμενοι δεπάεσσιν (locatival dat.) Il. 1.471 = Il. 9.176: = Od. 3.340 = Od. 21.272. Cf. Od. 7.183, Od. 18.418, Od. 21.263.
To finish off or complete (with something): ἐπήσκηται τοίχῳ Od. 17.266.
[in form a comp. Prob. fr. *ἐπασσύ(ς) (for *ἐπανσσύς, fr. ἐπ-, ἐπι- 7 + ἀν-, ἀνα- 6 + συ-, σεύω). Pressing on after. Cf. πανσυδίῃ.]
Thus, following one another in quick succession: θνῇσκον ἐπασσύτεροι Il. 1.383. Cf. Il. 4.423, 427, Il. 8.277 = Il. 12.194 = Il. 16.418: Od. 16.366 (relieving each other at short intervals).
A fold for sheep, etc. Od. 23.358.
2 sing. aor. subj. ἐπαύρῃς Od. 18.107 (v.l. ἐπαύρῃ; see below).
Infin. ἐπαυρέμεν Il. 18.302: Od. 17.81. ἐπαυρεῖν Il. 11.573, Il. 15.316, Il. 23.340.
2 sing. aor. subj. ἐπαύρηαι Il. 15.17. ἐπαύρῃ Od. 18.107 (v.l. ἐπαύρῃς; see above).
To touch or graze: χρόα Il. 11.573 = Il. 15.316, Il. 13.649.
With notion of deriving from contact, to bring on oneself, incur: μή τι κακὸν ἐπαύρῃς Od. 18.107 (v.l. ἐπαύρῃ,
To have benefit or profit from.
Absol.: αὐτόν σε βούλουʼ ἐπαυρέμεν ἤ τινα τῶνδε Od. 17.81.
Ironically: ἵνα πάντες ἐπαύρωνται βασιλῆος (have cause to bless him) Il. 1.410.
In mid., to reap the fruits of.
To draw (water) from a vessel and add it to the contents of another vessel: θερμὸν [ὕδωρ] Od. 19.388.
3 sing. aor. mid. ἐπέγρετο Il. 10.124: Od. 20.57.
To rouse from sleep, waken Od. 22.431.
In mid., to rouse oneself from sleep, waken: ἄλοχος ἐπέγρετο Od. 20.57. Cf. Il. 10.124, Il. 14.256.

div.head: a
div.p: With indic.: οἱ δʼ ἐπεὶ οὖν ἤγερθεν Il. 1.57. Cf. Il. 1.458, 467, 469, 484, Il. 2.16, etc.: Od. 1.2, 238, Od. 2.155, 297, 407, etc.
From the time when: ἐπεὶ ἤγαγον Il. 24.547. Cf. Od. 4.13, Od. 8.452.

div.head: α
div.p: With subj. in relative sentences corresponding to sentences with εἰ 4. See Table at end II.B.a 2.

div.head: β
div.p: With subj. or opt. in conditional relative sentences. For the examples and constructions see Table III.B.a 1 2 (5), b.1, (D) (20) (23) (26) (27) (34) (56).
Since, seeing that: ἐπεὶ πολὺ βούλομαι αὐτὴν οἴκοι ἔχειν Il. 1.112. Cf. Il. 1.114, 119, 132, Il. 4.307, Il. 9.304, etc.: Od. 1.37, 160, 176, 205, 223, etc.
Introducing a sentence without a regular apodosis Il. 3.59, Il. 13.68, etc.: Od. 3.103, Od. 8.236, etc.
App. 3 dual subj. (with irregular short vowel) ἐπείγετον Il. 10.361.

To oppress by
weight, weigh down Il. 12.452.
To bear hard upon, press, oppress: ἐπειγομένοισιν ἵκοντο (in sore straits) Il. 12.374. Cf. Il. 23.623.
Of wind, to beat upon something, blow hard: ὁππότʼ ἐπείγῃ ἲς ἀνέμου Il. 15.382.
So of wind and sea beating on (a ship) Od. 23.235.
Of a favourable wind, to speed (a ship) on her course Od. 12.167, Od. 15.297.
To press in pursuit, press hard upon: κεμάδα Il. 10.361.
Of fire, to assail, attack: θάμνοι ἐπειγόμενοι πυρὸς ὁρμῇ Il. 11.157.
To hurry on with, use all diligence in regard to: ὦνον ὁδαίων Od. 15.445.
To constrain, compel: ἀναγκαίη ἐπείγει Il. 6.85: Od. 19.73. Cf. Od. 11.54.
To put constraint upon, debar from freedom of action: ἐπείγετο βελέεσσιν Il. 5.622 = Il. 13.511.

div.head: a
div.p: To make haste. hasten, hurry: ἐπειγέσθω Il. 6.363.
With infin., to be eager to do something: μή τις ἐπειγέσθω οἶκόνδε νέεσθαι Il. 2.354. Cf. Od. 5.399.
To be eager for something to happen: δῦναι [ἠέλιον] ἐπειγόμενος Od. 13.30.
With acc., to be set on, be eager for a decision in the matter of: ἐπειγόμενοι τὸν ἐμὸν γάμον (eager for it though you be) Od. 2.97 = Od. 19.142 = Od. 24.132.
Without construction: ἐπειγομένην περ (curbing her impatience) Od. 17.570.

div.head: b
div.p: In pres. pple., in eager haste, hurrying, with all speed: τεῖχος ἐπειγομένη ἀφικάνει Il. 6.388. Cf. Il. 14.519, Il. 23.119.
Of an impersonal agency: ὅτʼ ὀπὸς γάλα ἐπειγόμενος συνέπηξεν Il. 5.902.
In a hurry: μὴ ἐπειγόμενοι ἀποπέμπετε Od. 11.339.
With genit., eager for: Ἄρηος Il. 19.142, 189: ὁδοῖο Od. 1.309, Od. 3.284, Od. 15.49.
With subj. in a conditional relative sentence. See Table at end III.B.a 3.
Acc. sing. masc. aor. pple. ἐπιδόντα.
To look upon, behold: κακὰ πολλά Il. 22.61.
3 sing. impf. ἐπῆεν Il. 5.127: Od. 21.7. ἐπέην Il. 20.276.
To be upon, to be fitted on or to something: κώπη ἐπῆεν Od. 21.7. Cf. Il. 5.127, Il. 20.276: Od. 2.344.
To be in existence so as to take up an inheritance: ἐπέσσεταί τις ὅς κεν ἔχῃσι δώματα Od. 4.756.
To approach, draw near, come, come up: προμνηστῖναι ἐπήϊσαν Od. 11.233. Cf. Od. 16.42, Od. 19.445.
In hostile sense: τόνδʼ ἐπιόντα δεδέξομαι ὀξέϊ δουρί Il. 5.238. Cf. Il. 13.477, 482, 836, Il. 15.164.
With dat.: ὅς μοι ἔπεισιν Il. 13.482.
Of noise, to come to, assail the ears of.
With dat.: τοῖς ὀρυμαγδὸς ἐπήϊεν Il. 17.741.
To go round a number of persons: δόσκεν ἀνὴρ ἐπιών Il. 18.546.
With acc., to go to, visit: ἀγρὸν ἔπειμι Od. 23.359.
Of a state or condition, to come upon one: γῆράς μιν ἔπεισιν Il. 1.29.
To go over, hold in review: φώκας ἔπεισιν Od. 4.411.
Then, thereupon, after that: πολλὰ δʼ ἐ. ἠρᾶτο Il. 1.35, ἕζετʼ ἐ. 48. Cf. Il. 1.121, 172, 312, 387, 440, etc.: Od. 1.44, 123, 144, 336, 363, etc.
Then, at that time: ἠέλιος ἐ. νέον προδέβαλλεν ἀρούρας Il. 7.421: = Od. 19.433. Cf. Il. 11.776: Od. 1.106.

Then, next, afterwards: κίκλησκʼ ἐ. Αἴαντε Il. 2.406. Cf. Il. 6.260, Il. 11.176, Il. 16.136, Il. 18.96, Il. 23.755, etc.: ὄφρʼ ἂν ἐ. παῖδες λίπωνται (after me) Od. 3.354, αὐτὰρ ἐ. δώσω . . . Od. 4.590, οὐδέ τις ἄλλος γίγνετʼ ἐ. ἀνέμων (succeeding it) Od. 12.326. Cf. Od. 3.58, Od. 9.203, Od. 15.261, etc.

In a contemplated case, in that case, then: οὐκ ἄν δʼ ἐ. κελοίμην . . . Il. 24.297. Cf. Il. 1.547, Il. 10.243, Il. 16.446, Il. 22.49, etc.: νήποινοί κεν ἐ. ὄλοισθε Od. 1.380, ἦ καὶ ἐ. λευγαλέοι ἐσόμεσθα (if we make the attempt) Od. 2.60. Cf. Od. 16.301, Od. 19.24, Od. 20.209, Od. 23.287, etc.
Then, therefore, why then: οὐ σύ γʼ ἐ. Tυδέος ἔκγονός ἐσσι Il. 5.812, εὔχεο σύ γʼ ἐ. Κρονίωνι (since you are set on going) Il. 24.290. Cf. Il. 7.360, Il. 9.444, etc.: Od. 7.200, Od. 17.185.
In virtue of something, therein: ἐ. δὲ πολλὸν ἀάσθη Il. 19.113.
Resuming and restating, then: ἐπόρουσε . . . τρὶς ἐ. ἐπόρουσεν Il. 5.436. Cf. Il. 20.445, etc.: Od. 3.62, etc.
Stating an alternative: φεύγωμεν, ἤ μιν ἐ. λιτανεύσομεν Il. 24.356. Cf. Il. 6.350, Il. 13.743, Il. 20.120, etc.: Od. 20.63.
Introducing a statement Od. 4.354, Od. 9.116, Od. 13.106.
In the end, in the result: τῇ καὶ ἐ. τελευτήσεσθαι ἔμελλεν Od. 8.510. Cf. Od. 8.520, Od. 21.24.
After all: ἔπ ρηξας καὶ ἐ. Il. 18.357. Cf. Od. 21.131.
To beat or hammer out (metal) upon or on to something: ἐπελήλατο χαλκός Il. 13.804, Il. 17.493.
To go on to, mount; in pf., to stand upon.
To draw tight (a rope) resting upon something Od. 22.467.
To get (horses) ready for yoking: ἐπέντυε ἵππους Il. 8.374.
To be fitting or suitable for.
With dat.: ὅς τις οἷ ἐ. Il. 9.392.
With dat.: νέῳ πάντʼ ἐ. Il. 22.71.
Impers., it is fitting, right, seemly.

div.head: a
div.p: With dat. and infin.: σφῶϊν ἐ. ἑστάμεν Il. 4.341.–

div.head: b
div.p: With acc. and infin.: ὅν τʼ ἐ. βουλὰς βουλεύειν Il. 10.146: ὧν ἐ. ἱκέτην [μὴ δεύεσθαι] Od. 7.193 = Od. 14.511. Cf. Od. 11.186.–

div.head: c
div.p: With infin. alone: λαοὺς οὐκ ἐ. ταῦτʼ ἐπαγείρειν Il. 1.126 (see ἐπαγείρω), ὅσσʼ ἐ. [ἀποδάσσασθαι] Il. 24.595.–
To thrust or press (a weapon) home Il. 5.856.
To put (one's strength) into an effort: ἐπέρεισεν ἶνʼ ἀπέλεθρον Il. 7.269: = Od. 9.538.
To pull to (a door): θύρην Od. 1.441.

To approach, draw near, come, come up: τοῦ υἱὸς ἐπῆλθεν Od. 15.256. Cf. Il. 1.535, Il. 10.40, Il. 23.234, etc.: Od. 2.13 = Od. 17.64, Od. 5.73, Od. 9.233, Od. 16.197, Od. 18.199, Od. 19.155, Od. 23.185.
In hostile sense: μίμνον ἐπερχόμενον Ἄσιον Il. 12.136. Cf. Il. 13.472, Il. 15.406, Il. 20.178, Il. 22.252.
To approach a person for a specified purpose: εἰ γέροντʼ εἴρηαι ἐπελθών Od. 1.188. Cf. Od. 17.382.
To come or present oneself: αὐτὸς ἐπελθών Od. 2.246, Od. 24.506. Cf. Od. 9.214.
To come to a specified place: μή τις ἐνθάδʼ ἐπέλθῃσιν Il. 24.651. Cf. Od. 24.354.
To come to, arrive at, reach, a specified or indicated place: ἧος ἐπῆλθον ἐς ποταμόν Od. 7.280. Cf. Od. 17.170.
Of a weapon, to make its way to, reach, touch.

p.gloss: To come upon, light upon, find.

div.p: Absol.: μή τις ἐπελθὼν δηλήσαιτο Od. 13.124. Cf. Od. 14.317.
With dat.: κλαιόντεσσιν ἐπήλυθεν ὕπνος Od. 12.311. Cf. Od. 5.472.
With acc.: ἐπήλυθέ μιν ὕπνος Od. 4.793. Cf. Od. 10.31 = Od. 13.282.
