Of a period of time, to come on, come upon one: ἐπήλυθε νύξ Il. 8.488, Il. 9.474. Cf. Od. 10.175, Od. 14.457, 475, Od. 17.606, Od. 22.198.
To come round: ὅτʼ ἐπήλυθον ὧραι Od. 2.107 = Od. 19.152 = Od. 24.142, Od. 11.295 = Od. 14.294.
With acc.: ἄγκεα Il. 18.321. Cf. Od. 4.268.
To go, betake oneself: ὁππόσʼ ἐπέλθω Od. 14.139.
A throwing in of one's word, a speaking uninvited.
Throwing words about at random, scurrilous Il. 2.275.
Coming on all through the year: καρπός Od. 7.118.
To give one's voice in approval or assent Il. 1.22 = 376.
To utter words of exultation, triumph, vaunting, derision: ἐπεύχεται αὔτως Il. 17.450. Cf. Il. 17.35: Od. 23.59.
With complementary infin.: ἐπευξάμενος βαλέειν Il. 10.368.
To utter such words over a smitten foe: ὅς μʼ ἔβαλε καὶ ἐπεύχεται Il. 5.119. Cf. Il. 11.449, Il. 13.373, 413, 445, Il. 14.453, Il. 20.388, Il. 21.427, Il. 22.330: Od. 22.286.
With dat.: τῷ ἐπεύξατο Il. 14.478. Cf. Il. 11.431, Il. 16.829, Il. 21.121, 409.
With dat. and complementary infin.: πᾶσι θεοῖσι νοστῆσαι Ὀδυσῆα Od. 14.423, Od. 20.238, Od. 21.203.
With dat.: θρήνυι πόδας Il. 14.241: Od. 17.410.
With acc.: ἑπτὰ πέλεθρα Il. 21.407. Cf. Il. 23.190, 238 = Il. 24.792.
To hold out for acceptance, offer, present: κοτύλην Il. 22.494. Cf. Il. 9.489: Od. 16.444.
Of presenting the breast to a suckling Il. 22.83.
To restrain or dam (a stream) Il. 21.244.
To hold oneself from action, hold back, refrain: Ἀντίνοος ἔτʼ ἐπεῖχε καὶ Εὐρύμαχος Od. 21.186 (Eu. does not seem to make the attempt till 245, and A. does not seem to make it at all).
To shut (a gate): πᾶσαι [πύλαι] ἐπώχατο Il. 12.340 (v.l. πάσας ἐπῴχετο).
[app. with ἐπη- (with metrical lengthening) for ἐπι-, fr. ἐπιβάλλομαι. See ἐπιβάλλω 2.]
Having, having the disposal of: νηός Od. 2.319.
The pieces fitted upon the top of the ἴκρια of the σχεδίη of Odysseus, and forming the upper surface thereof Od. 5.253.
[prob. ἐπ-, ἐπι- 16 + ηε- = αἰεί + suff. -τανος. Lasting for ever.]
Unfailing, constant, regularly afforded or given: κομιδή Od. 8.233, σῖτον Od. 18.360.
Ever-flowing, always full: πλυνοί Od. 6.86, ἀρδμοί Od. 13.247.
In neut. sing. ἐπηετανόν as adv., in never-failing abundance: ἐ. ἔχουσιν Od. 10.427. Cf. Od. 7.99.
Ever, all the year round: γανόωσαι Od. 7.128.
Of a garment, kept for a change ( = ἀμοιβάς): χιτῶνες Od. 14.513.

Of ὀχῆες, app., crossing each other(cf. ἐπαμοιβαδίς) Il. 12.456. (The κληΐς would secure the ὀχῆες to the gate at their point of intersection, and so make of the whole a solid structure without separate play in the parts.)
With subj. in a relative sentence corresponding to sentences with εἰ 4. See Table at end (P) B.a.3.
With subj. or opt. in conditional relative sentences. For the examples and constructions see Table III.B.a 3, (D) (34) (35) (36) (38) (49) (65).

p.gloss: To give one's voice in approval or assent to.

div.p: An epithet of general commendation, pleasing, charming, delightful, fair, or the like: δαιτός Il. 9.228: εἵματα Od. 8.366, ἄντρον Od. 13.103 = 347.
As epithet of places, fair, pleasant: πτολίεθρον Il. 18.512, Il. 22.121. Cf. Od. 4.606.
At the oar: ἑταῖροι ἥατʼ ἐπήρετμοι Od. 2.403.
Epithet of ships, fitted or furnished with oars Od. 4.559 = Od. 5.16 = Od. 17.145, Od. 5.141, Od. 14.224.
App., well-mannered, courteous: οὕνεκʼ ἐ. ἐσσι Od. 13.332, ἐπητῇ ἀνδρί Od. 18.128.
App., in succession, one after another: πυρσοὶ φλεγέθουσιν ἐπήτριμοι Il. 18.211. Cf. Il. 18.552, Il. 19.226.
(Commonly with anastrophe when immediately following the vb. or case-form (and see Od. 3.161).)
Position on or upon something, thereon: ἐπὶ δʼ ἀργύρεον ζυγὸν ἦεν Il. 9.187. Cf. Il. 7.223, Il. 11.630 (on the table): Od. 1.291, Od. 3.9, Od. 4.132, Od. 7.90, Od. 8.475, etc.
At a place, thereat: ἐπὶ σκέπας ἦν Od. 5.443 = Od. 7.282, Od. 6.210, Od. 12.336.
Denoting an occasion or cause, thereat, thereupon: ἐπὶ δὲ Τρῶες κελάδησαν Il. 8.542, γέλασαν δʼ ἐπὶ πάντες Il. 23.840. Cf. Il. 2.148, Il. 11.45, Il. 13.822, Il. 16.612, Il. 17.723, etc.: Od. 6.117.

Denoting (sometimes vaguely) that action, effort or the like takes place in a specified or indicated direction or is directed to or against something or to a specified or indicated object or end: κρατερὸν δʼ ἐπὶ μῦθον ἔτελλεν Il. 1.25, εἴ ποτέ τοι ἐπὶ νηὸν ἔρεψα (in thy honour) Il. 1.39, ἦμος ἐπὶ κνέφας ἦλθεν (came upon them) Il. 1.475, ἐπὶ φρεσὶ κέκασται (excels all) Il. 20.35. Cf. Il. 1.408, 528, Il. 3.461, Il. 4.384, Il. 9.539, Il. 10.99, Il. 11.235, etc.: ἀνέμων ἐπʼ ἀϋτμένα χεῦεν Od. 3.289, ἐπὶ χερσὶ μάσασθαι Od. 11.591. Cf. Od. 1.273, Od. 3.152, 161, Od. 8.245, Od. 14.195, Od. 17.241, Od. 18.64, etc.
Besides, in addition, too: ἐπὶ μέγαν ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι Il. 1.233, ἐπὶ ξύλα λέγεσθε Il. 8.507. Cf. Il. 5.705, Il. 15.662, Il. 18.529, Il. 21.373, etc.: Od. 12.399 = Od. 15.477, Od. 20.229.
Following, succession: πρὸ μέν τʼ ἄλλʼ, αὐτὰρ ἐπʼ ἄλλα Il. 13.799. Cf. Il. 13.800.
Accompaniment: ἐπὶ δʼ ἕψονται θεοὶ ἄλλοι Il. 4.63, ἐπὶ μείλια δώσω (δώσει) (with her) Il. 9.147, 289. Cf. Od. 9.297, Od. 12.349.
In answer or response: ἐπὶ δὲ στενάχοντο Il. 19.301 = Il. 22.515 = Il. 24.746, Il. 19.338, Il. 22.429, Il. 24.722. Cf. Il. 24.776.
Being in charge: ἐπὶ δʼ ἀνὴρ ἐσθλὸς ὀρώρει Il. 23.112. Cf. Od. 3.471, Od. 14.104.

To, towards, at, on, upon:
ἦλθε δʼ ἐπὶ ψυχή Il. 23.65. Cf. Il. 11.480, Il. 23.232, etc.: γέροντας ἐπὶ πλέονας καλέσαντες (to the council) Od. 7.189, οἷον ἐπʼ ἦμαρ ἄγῃσιν Od. 18.137. Cf. Od. 11.84, 90, 632, Od. 12.427, Od. 18.1, etc.
In hostile sense: ἐπὶ δʼ ὄρνυτο Il. 23.689. Cf. Il. 4.221, Il. 5.618, Il. 8.158, etc.: Od. 21.100.

On to, on, upon, over something: ἐπʼ ἄρα φάρμακα πάσσεν Il. 4.218, δέελον δʼ ἐπὶ σῆμά τʼ ἔθηκεν Il. 10.466. Cf. Il. 1.462, Il. 6.419, Il. 11.639, Il. 13.543, Il. 23.256, etc.: Od. 3.179, 459, Od. 8.443, Od. 10.520, Od. 12.47, Od. 19.58, etc.
Thrusting or pushing home: ἐπὶ κληῗδʼ ἐτάνυσσεν Od. 1.442. Cf. Il. 17.48.

div.head: a
div.p: On, upon: ἐπὶ χθονί Il. 1.88, ἐπὶ πύργῳ Il. 3.153. Cf. Il. 1.219, 462, Il. 4.248, 470 (over his body), Il. 5.42, etc.: Od. 1.211, Od. 3.5, 273, 408, etc.
With locative: ἐπʼ ἰκριόφω Od. 3.353, Od. 13.74, Od. 15.283. Cf. Od. 5.59, Od. 11.607.

In pregnant sense: ἐξ αὐτοὶ βαῖνον ἐπὶ ῥηγμῖνι θαλάσσης Il. 1.437. Cf. Il. 1.486, Il. 5.141 (against each other), Il. 11.5, Il. 13.359, Il. 22.97 (against), etc.: κατέθηκεν ἐπʼ ἀπήνῃ Od. 6.75. Cf. Od. 1.364, Od. 4.440, Od. 10.375, Od. 12.362, etc.
With locative: ἐπὶ στεφάνην κεφαλῆφι θήκατο Il. 10.30: Od. 19.389.
In reference to imposing, laying or conferring something upon a person: ἄλγεʼ ἐπʼ ἀλλήλοισι τιθέντες Il. 5.384, ἐπʼ αὐτῷ κῦδος ἔθηκεν Il. 23.400. Cf. Il. 6.357, etc.: Od. 11.524, Od. 19.592, etc.
Sim.: εἰ γὰρ ἐπʼ ἀρῇσιν τέλος γένοιτο Od. 17.496.
To bestowing a name: ἐπὶ πᾶσι τίθενται Od. 8.554.
To attaching to something: δησάμενοι ἐπὶ κληῗσιν ἐρετμά Od. 8.37.

div.head: b
div.p: At, by, beside: ἐπὶ νηυσίν Il. 1.559, πηγῇς ἔπι κηφισοῖο Il. 2.523. Cf. Il. 2.472 (over against)), 788, Il. 7.86, Il. 12.168, Il. 22.93 (app., in the hole), etc.: Od. 1.103, Od. 2.391, Od. 4.40, Od. 6.52, Od. 9.103, etc.
Sim., among, in the enjoyment of (wealth) Il. 9.482: Od. 1.218.
In closer definition of something: οὔτασε χεῖρʼ ἐπὶ καρπῷ Il. 5.458. Cf. Il. 18.594, etc.: Od. 24.398, etc.
With locative in reference to position: ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν Il. 13.308. Cf. Il. 13.309.

div.head: c
div.p: App., implying penetration, into, in: ἔγχος κατέπηξεν ἐπὶ χθονί Il. 6.213. Cf. Il. 23.876.
So in reference to the mind, into, in: τῷ ἐπὶ φρεσὶ θῆκεν Il. 1.55, etc. Cf. Od. 5.427, etc.

div.head: d
div.p: For, with a view to: ᾧ ἔπι πολλὰ μόγησα Il. 1.162. Cf. Od. 18.44.
In consideration of: μισθῷ ἔπι ῥητῷ Il. 21.445. Cf. Il. 10.304.

In the case of, in the matter of, on the occasion of, in honour of, for: μητρὶ φίλῃ ἐπὶ ἦρα φέρων (to her) Il. 1.572, αἴθʼ οὕτως ἐπὶ πᾶσι χόλον τελέσειεν Il. 4.178. Cf. Il. 4.235, 258, Il. 9.492, Il. 14.67, Il. 17.400, Il. 21.585, Il. 24.82, etc.: τοιῷδʼ ἐπʼ ἀέθλῳ Od. 11.548, ἐπὶ μηρία θέντες Ἀπόλλωνι Od. 21.267. Cf. Od. 3.164, Od. 16.19, Od. 18.414, Od. 24.91, etc.

div.head: e
div.p: Besides, in addition to: ἄλλʼ ἐπὶ τῇσιν Il. 9.639, μή τις ἐφʼ ἕλκεϊ ἕλκος ἄρηται (wound on wound) Il. 14.130, τόσους ἐπὶ τοῖσι χιτῶνας Il. 24.231. Cf. Od. 3.113, Od. 11.287, Od. 22.264, etc.
In comparison with: ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον Od. 7.216.

div.head: f
div.p: In reference to concomitance: ἀτελευτήτῳ ἐπὶ ἔργῳ (with your task unaccomplished) Il. 4.175, τῷδʼ ἐπὶ θυμῷ (with this . . .) Il. 13.485, ἐπʼ ἀρωγῇ Il. 23.574: ἀνηνύστῳ ἐπὶ ἔργῳ (with no end to the business) Od. 16.111. Cf. Od. 16.99, Od. 17.308, 454, Od. 24.511.
At the hands of: ἐπὶ ἴστορι Il. 18.501.

div.head: g
div.p: After, following: τῷ δʼ ἐπὶ τυδεΐδης ὦρτο Il. 7.163. Cf. Il. 8.262, etc.: Od. 7.120, Od. 20.162, etc.

div.head: h
div.p: In charge or superintendence of, over: ἐπʼ ὀΐεσσιν Il. 5.137, υἱὸν ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι λιπεσθαι 154. Cf. Il. 6.424, etc.: σημαίνειν ἐπὶ δμῳῇσιν Od. 22.427. Cf. Od. 15.89, Od. 20.209, Od. 21.363, etc.

div.head: i
div.p: To, towards, in the direction of: νηυσὶν ἔπι Il. 5.327, ἕλκʼ ἐπὶ οἷ Il. 11.239. Cf. Il. 2.6, Il. 4.251, Il. 20.53, etc.: Od. 17.330, Od. 22.205, etc.
Sim. πατρόκλῳ ὅγʼ ἐπʼ ὀφρύσι νεῦσεν Il. 9.620.
In reference to lighting or coming upon something: ἐπὶ σώματι κύρσας Il. 3.23. Cf. Il. 23.821.

In hostile sense, against, upon: ἧκεν ἑπʼ Ἀργείοισι βέλος Il. 1.382, ἐπʼ ἀλλήλοισι θορόντες Il. 11.70. Cf. Il. 3.15, Il. 5.124, Il. 8.327, Il. 11.294, etc.: Od. 2.316, Od. 10.214, Od. 13.60, Od. 22.8, etc.
So ἐφʼ ἵπποιιν μάστιγας ἄειραν Il. 23.362.
Of laughing at or exulting over a person: ἐπʼ αὐτῷ γέλασσαν Il. 2.270, Il. 23.784, τῷ δʼ ἐπὶ μακρὸν ἄϋσεν Il. 5.101, etc.: Od. 20.358 = Od. 21.376. Cf. Od. 20.374, Od. 22.412.
In reference to position, in the direction of, towards: ἐπὶ οἷ τετραμμένον Il. 13.542.

div.head: α
div.p: During, for the space of: ἐπʼ ἤματι δακρύσαντας Il. 19.229. Cf. Il. 8.529.

div.head: β
div.p: During, on: ὄς τις ἐπʼ ἤματι τῷδε μεθίῃσι μάχεσθαι Il. 13.234. Cf. Il. 19.110: ἐπʼ ἤματι μῆλον ἀγινεῖ (each day, day by day) Od. 14.105.

div.head: γ
div.p: In the space of: τοσσάδε μέρμερʼ ἐπʼ ἤματι μητίσασθαι (in a single day) Il. 10.48: τρὶς ἐπʼ ἤματι Od. 12.105. Cf. Od. 2.284.

div.head: a
div.p: To, towards, in the direction of: ἐπὶ νῆας Il. 1.12, τώ οἱ ὤμω ἐπὶ στῆθος συνοχωκότε Il. 2.218, ἀταρπιτὸς ἦεν ἐπʼ αὐτήν (leading to it) Il. 18.565. Cf. Il. 1.306, 440, Il. 2.808, Il. 4.78, etc.: Od. 1.149, 183, 274, Od. 2.260, etc.
In hostile sense Il. 5.590, Il. 13.101, etc.: Od. 17.295.
In quest of, for: ἐπὶ Νέστορα Il. 10.54. Cf. Il. 2.18, etc.: Od. 3.421, etc.
In reference to that to which one turns or proceeds: ἐπὶ ἔργα τράποντο Il. 3.422. Cf. Il. 2.381, etc.: Od. 8.395, Od. 14.455, Od. 24.394, etc.
To directing the sight or voice: γεγωνέμεν ἐπʼ Αἴαντος κλισίας Il. 11.7, ἐπὶ Θρῃκῶν καθορώμενος αἶαν Il. 13.4, etc.
To seeing to something: ἐπὶ ἔργα ἰδεῖν Od. 16.144.
To being brought into sorrow Od. 14.338.
In view of, for: πᾶσαν ἐπʼ ἰθύν Il. 6.79: Od. 4.434.

div.head: b
div.p: Indicating arrival at a point: ἐπὶ κλισίας ἱκέσθην Il. 1.328. Cf. Il. 2.17, etc.: Od. 10.117, Od. 12.430, etc.
In reference to time: οὐδʼ ἐπὶ γῆρας ἵκετο Od. 8.226.

div.head: c
div.p: In reference to adjusting to, bringing into conformity with, something: ἐπὶ ἶσα Il. 12.436 = Il. 15.413: ἐπὶ στάθμην Od. 5.245, Od. 17.341 = Od. 21.44, Od. 21.121, Od. 23.197.
To bringing into a specified formation: ὅς τίς σφιν ἐπὶ στίχας ἡγήσαιτο (into their ranks) Il. 2.687. Cf. Il. 3.113.
To being in such a formation: θρέξασκον ἐπὶ στίχας Il. 18.602.
Sim.: ἐπὶ πτολέμοιο γεφύρας ἥατο Il. 8.553.

div.head: d
div.p: On, upon. In reference to placing, setting, seating or sitting on or at something: ἕζετο θῖνʼ ἔφʼ ἁλός Il. 1.350, θῖνʼ ἔφʼ ἁλὸς εἰρυμέναι Il. 13.682. Cf. Il. 8.442, etc.: εἷσαν ἐπὶ σκέπας Od. 6.212. Cf. Od. 12.171, etc.
Sim.: ἐπʼ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ἵζει Il. 13.281, ἑζόμενος ἐπὶ γοῦνα (i.e. with his knees on the ground, sitting on his heels) Il. 14.437.
In reference to attaching: ἔδησαν ἐπʼ ὀμφαλόν Il. 24.273.
To falling on a part of the body: ἐπὶ στόμα Il. 6.43. Cf. Il. 5.586, etc.
To a part by which one is seized: ἑλὡν ἐπὶ μάστακα Od. 23.76.

div.head: e
div.p: In reference to position, on, at: νηῶν ἐπʼ ἀριστερά Il. 13.675. Cf. Il. 2.526, Il. 5.355, etc.: Od. 3.171, Od. 5.277.

div.head: f
div.p:
On to, on: ἐπὶ πύργον ἰοῦσαν Il. 3.154,
ἀποβάντες ἐπὶ χθόνα Il. 8.492. Cf. Il. 6.375, Il. 12.448, Il. 17.504, Il. 23.393, etc.: Od. 17.413, Od. 22.2, etc.

div.head: g
div.p: In reference to motion over or on something: πᾶσαν ἐπʼ αἶαν Il. 9.506, ἐλάαν ἐπὶ κύματα Il. 13.27. Cf. Il. 2.159, Il. 14.254, Il. 19.378, Il. 20.227, Il. 23.320, etc.: Od. 1.97, Od. 2.364, Od. 5.175, Od. 6.138, etc.
In reference to directing the sight: ὁρόων ἐπὶ πόντον Il. 1.350, etc. Cf. Od. 5.84, etc.

div.head: h
div.p: In reference to pouring liquid over or on something: ὕδωρ ἐπὶ χεῖρας ἔχευαν Il. 3.270, etc. Cf. Od. 1.146, etc.

And in gen., to diffusion, distribution, extent, existence, over or on a space or tract: Ἠὼς ἐκίδνατο πᾶσαν ἐπʼ αἶαν Il. 8.1, κλέος κέ οἱ εἴη πάντας ἐπʼ ἀνθρώπους (among them) Il. 10.213. Cf. Il. 7.63, 446, Il. 17.447, Il. 23.226, 742, etc.: Od. 3.3, Od. 4.417, Od. 7.332, Od. 12.386, Od. 14.403, Od. 17.386, etc.
To a surface on which a characteristic is displayed: ἐπὶ νῶτα δαφοινός Il. 2.308.
Sim.: [ἵππους] σταφύλῃ ἐπὶ νῶτον ἐΐσας (as measured across their backs) Il. 2.765.

div.head: i
div.p: In reference to going among, over or round persons: οἰχόμενοι ἐπὶ πάντας Il. 14.381. Cf. Il. 20.353: Od. 3.252.
Sim.: πόλλʼ ἐπὶ ἄστεʼ ἀλώμενος Od. 15.492, Od. 19.170. Cf. Od. 16.63.
In reference to division or distribution among persons: δασσάμενοι ἐφʼ ἡμέας Od. 16.385.

div.head: j
div.p: In reference to extent or distance: ὅσον τʼ ἐπὶ λᾶαν ἵησιν Il. 3.12. Cf. Il. 15.358, Il. 17.368, etc.: Od. 5.251, Od. 11.577 (covering), etc.

div.head: k
div.p: In reference to a part of the body on which one lies: ἐπὶ πλευρὰς κατακείμενος Il. 24.10.

div.head: l
div.p: In reference to time, for, during: μείνατʼ ἐπὶ χρόνον Il. 2.299. Cf. Il. 9.415, etc.: Od. 12.407, etc.
Sim.: εὗδον ἐπʼ ἠῶ καὶ μέσον ἧμαρ (on through . . .) Od. 7.288.

div.head: a
div.p: On, upon: ἐπʼ ὤμων Il. 1.46, ἐπʼ ἠϊόνος Il. 23.61. Cf. Il. 5.550, Il. 11.38, Il. 20.229 (see ἄκρος 3), Il. 22.225, etc.: Od. 1.162, 171, Od. 5.33, 82, Od. 10.170, etc.
In reference to leaning on a part of the body: ὀρθωθεὶς ἐπʼ ἀγκῶνος Il. 10.80.
To the part of a thing on which it stands: ἔγχεʼ ἐπὶ σαυρωτῆρος ἐλήλατο (i.e. were driven in by the butt) Il. 10.153.
In pregnant sense: ἐπʼ ἠπείροιο ἔρυσσαν Il. 1.485. Cf. Il. 3.293, Il. 18.422, Il. 24.190, etc.: τίθει ἐπʼ ἀπήνης Od. 6.252. Cf. Od. 7.162, Od. 9.85, Od. 15.547, etc.

div.head: b
div.p: At, by, in: ἐπὶ βουπρασίου Il. 11.756. Cf. Il. 18.557, Il. 22.153: μύλης ἔπι Od. 7.104. Cf. Od. 1.185, Od. 5.489, Od. 9.140, etc.–At anchor: ἐπʼ εὐνάων Il. 14.77.

div.head: c
div.p: Towards, in the direction of: ἐπὶ νηῶν Il. 5.700. Cf. Il. 3.5, Il. 11.546, Il. 21.454, Il. 23.374, etc.: Od. 3.171, Od. 5.238, etc.
Sim., app., to oneself, withdrawn into oneself: σιγῇ ἐφʼ ὑμείων Il. 7.195.
With a form in -φιν: ἐπʼ αὐτόφιν ἥατο σιγῇ Il. 19.255.

div.head: d
div.p: Along with, with: ὅσσα ἔοικεν ἐπὶ παιδὸς ἕπεσθαι Od. 1.278 = Od. 2.197.

div.head: e
div.p: In reference to time, in the time of, in the days of: ἐπʼ εἰρήνης Il. 2.797. Cf. Il. 5.637, etc.
So, app., ἐπὶ δώρων (in the time of gifts, not delaying and so missing the reward) Il. 9.602.
There is in a specified or indicated place, affecting or characterizing a specified or indicated person, or the like.
With or without dat.: οὔ τοι ἔπι δέος Il. 1.515, καλὸν εἶδος ἔπι Il. 3.45. Cf. Il. 5.178, etc.: ᾧ ἔπι κώπη Od. 8.403. Cf. Od. 2.58, Od. 11.367, Od. 14.92, etc.
To set on foot, instigate: τάδε ἔργα Od. 22.49.
To please, be pleasing or acceptable.
3 pl. impf. ἐπί̄αχον (or rather (cf. under ἰάχω) aor. ἐπίϝαχον, or with augment ἐπέϝαχον, ἐπεύαχον).
To shout in approval or assent Il. 7.403 = Il. 9.50.
In answer or defiance Il. 5.860 = Il. 14.148, Il. 13.835.
A return made for a passage in a ship Od. 15.449.

div.head: A
div.p: 2 sing. fut. in mid. form ἐπιβήσεαι Il. 8.165.
Dat. pl. masc. pple. ἐπιβησομένοισι Il. 23.379.
Acc. sing. masc. pple. ἐπιβησόμενον Il. 5.46, Il. 16.343.

div.head: I
div.p: Intrans. in all forms except those under (B).
With genit., to set foot upon, get upon: πύργων Il. 8.165. Cf. Il. 12.444.
To embark upon (a ship or raft): νεῶν Il. 8.512: σχεδίης Od. 5.177. Cf. Od. 4.708, Od. 9.101, Od. 13.319.
Of landing from a ship upon: πατρίδος αἴης Od. 4.521. Cf. Od. 7.196, Od. 9.83, Od. 11.167, 482, Od. 12.282.
So of coming to shore out of the sea: ἠπείρου Od. 5.399. Cf. Od. 23.238.
To mount (a chariot, etc.): ἵππων Il. 5.46. Cf. Il. 5.192, 221, Il. 8.44, Il. 11.512, Il. 24.322, etc.: Od. 6.78.
To mount (a horse): ἵππων ἐπεβήσετο (app. meaning one of them) Il. 10.513, 529.
To mount, place oneself upon (a bed): εὐνῆς Il. 9.133 = 275 = Il. 19.176: Od. 10.334, 340, 342, 347, 480.
Of a corpse, to take its place, be placed, upon (the pyre): πυρῆς Il. 4.99.

p.gloss: To make one's way to, proceed to.

div.p: So to make one's way to and reach: πόλιος Od. 6.262.
To set foot within; hence, fig., with genit., to have enjoyment of: ἐϋφροσύνης Od. 23.52.
To embark upon a course of, give oneself up to: ἀναιδείης Od. 22.424.
Absol., to go on one's own feet (as opposed to being carried) Il. 5.666.
With genit., to cause to embark upon (a ship): Ἀχαιοὺς νηῶν ἐπιβησέμεν Il. 8.197.
To set on shore from a ship upon: ἐμῆς πάτρης Od. 7.223.
To cause to mount (a chariot): ἵππων Il. 8.129.
To cause (a person) to take his place upon (the pyre) (i.e. slay him): πολλοὺς πυρῆς ἐπέβησεν Il. 9.546.

Fig., with genit., to bring within the pale of, bring into the
enjoyment of: ἐϋκλείης Il. 8.285.
To bring into a course of, lead to adopt: σαοφροσύνης Od. 23.13.
To throw or cast upon something indicated Il. 23.135.
To lay on (the lash): ἱμάσθλην Od. 6.320.
In mid., to throw oneself upon in eagerness to possess.
Of a ship, app., to head towards, stand for.

p.gloss: to bring within the pale of, involve in.

div.p: With genit.: κακῶν υἷας Ἀχαιῶν Il. 2.234.
One who mounts (a chariot), a (skilled) fighter from the chariot Od. 18.263.
Of an animal, the mounter, the male or mate Od. 11.131 = Od. 23.278.
App., a movable piece of wood to secure a gate, passing through a hole in one gate-post and fitting into a socket in the other Il. 24.453 (no doubt identical with the κληΐς of 455).
In mid., with acc., to call to for aid: θεούς Od. 1.378 = Od. 2.143.
App., to call to in thanksgiving: Ἀθήνην Il. 10.463.
[ἐπι- 10 + βουκόλος. Pleonastically, the herdsman in charge of (the herd). Cf. ἐπιβώτωρ, ἐπίουρος, ἐπιποιμήν, μετάγγελος.]
Of wind, to roar upon (and fan).
3 sing. subj. ἐπιβρί̄σῃ Il. 5.91, Il. 7.343, Il. 12.286.
To bear or press heavily upon someone: μὴ ἐπιβρίσῃ πόλεμος Il. 7.343.
To bring one's weight to bear upon the foe: μᾶλλον ἐπέβρισαν Il. 12.414.
Of rain or snow, to fall destructively or in excessive abundance Il. 5.91, Il. 12.286.
To fall in suitable abundance Od. 24.344.
A shepherd or goatherd: μήλων Od. 13.222.
To succeed, come on in due succession: [ἀλλὰ φύλλα] ἔαρος ἐπιγίγνεται ὥρῃ Il. 6.148.
To look upon, watch, see Od. 18.30.
To bend towards oneself: δόρυ Il. 21.178.
Fig., to bend, influence: νόον Il. 9.514.
To bend to one's purpose, bring over to one's views Il. 2.14 = 31 = 68.
To put restraint upon, restrain, repress: κῆρ Il. 1.569.
The great extensor muscle of the thigh Od. 17.225, Od. 18.74.
Grazing, inflicling a superficial wound: πῆχυν ἐ. βάλεν Il. 21.166.
To graze, inflict a superficial wound upon: χρόα Il. 4.139. Cf. Il. 11.388, Il. 13.553 (here, app., simply, to touch or reach): Od. 22.280.
To scratch a mark upon: κλῆρον Il. 7.187.
In neut. pl. ἐπιδέξια as adv., (in sequence) from left to right, in the sun's direction (i.e. in the lucky order): ὄρνυσθʼ ἑξείης ἐ. Od. 21.141.
App., on the right hand (i.e. in the lucky quarter): ἀστράπτων Il. 2.353.
With genit., lacking, lacking in, being without, not having: κρειῶν Il. 12.299. Cf. Il. 13.622: Od. 4.87.
Suffering want or being stinted in the matter of: δαιτὸς ἐΐσης Il. 9.225.
Falling short of: βίης Ὀδυσῆος Od. 21.253.
Falling short in the matter of: βίης Od. 21.185.
Absol., lacking the necessary strength Od. 24.171.
In neut. ἐπιδευές as abstract sb., lack: ἵνα μή τι δίκης ἐ. ἔχῃσθα Il. 19.180.
With genit., to lack, find or feel the want of: σεῦ Il. 18.77: τούτων Od. 15.371.
To fall short of (a person): κείνων ἀνδρῶν Il. 5.636.
To be unequal to, unfitted for: μάχης Il. 23.670, μάχης Ἀχαιῶν (against the . . .) Il. 24.385.
To stand in need of, seek to get, desire: χρυσοῦ Il. 2.229.
To make fast, secure: ἐπέδησε θύρας Od. 21.391.
[ἐπι- 2 + δῆμος in sense town. Cf. πανδήμιος.]
To dwell or remain in the city Od. 16.28.
Among one's people, at one's home Od. 1.194, 233.
Having a specified character in relation to one's own people as distinguished from strangers: ἐπιδήμιοι ἁρπακτῆρες (robbing your own folk (instead of your foes)) Il. 24.262.
1 pl. fut. mid. ἐπιδωσόμεθα (v.l. ἐπιβωσόμεθα) Il. 10.463.
To give by way of making up to a person: ἄλλο Il. 23.559.
In mid., with reciprocal sense, of parties to an oath, to grant to each other the sanction of the gods as witnesses: θεοὺς ἐπιδώμεθα Il. 22.254.
App. with a vague notion of mutually calling upon a god: Ἀθήνην Il. 10.463.
To whirl round (in preparation for a throw): λᾶαν ἧκʼ ἐπιδινήσας Il. 7.269: = Od. 9.538. Cf. Il. 3.378, Il. 19.268.
In mid.: τόδε θυμὸς πόλλʼ ἐπιδινεῖται Od. 20.218.

In pass., of flying birds, to
wheel towards each other: ἐπιδινηθέντε τιναξάσθην πτερά Od. 2.151.
App. = ἄντυξ 1: ἵπποι ἐξ ἐπιδιφριάδος ἱμᾶσι δέδεντο Il. 10.475.
(Put) on a chariot: εἰς ὅ κε δῶρα ἐπιδίφρια θήῃ (θείω) Od. 15.51, 75.
acc. sing. masc. aor. pple. ἐπείδω.
Capable of being taken by assault: τεῖχος Il. 6.434.
Befitting, fitting, meet, suitable: τύμβον Il. 23.246.
Adequate in amount or value: ἀμοιβήν Od. 12.382.
Absol. in neut. ἐπιεικές, what is fitting, meet, right: ἃς ἐ. ὀπυιέμεν ἐστίν Od. 2.207.
With copula to be supplied: ὡς ἐ. Il. 8.431, Il. 19.147, Il. 23.537: Od. 8.389.
So with infin.: ὅν κʼ ἐ. ἀκουέμεν Il. 1.547. Cf. Il. 19.21, Il. 23.50.
[app. ἐπι- 4 + (ϝ)είκω2. For the form cf. νεμεσητός 2.]
Unyielding, indomitable: μένος οὐκ ἐπιεικτόν Od. 19.493.
Ungovernable, not to be restrained: μένος Il. 5.892.
With fut. infin.: ἐμοὺς μύθους εἰδήσειν Il. 1.545.
With acc. and fut. infin.: ἐπιελπόμενος τό γε θυμῷ νευρὴν ἐντανύειν Od. 21.126.
In act., to put upon a person as a (bed-) covering: χλαῖναν Od. 20.143.

In pf. mid. in sense sim. to those of ἕννυμι II.2. Fig.: ἀναιδείην ἐπιειμένε (clothed with . . . as with a garment) Il. 1.149, ἐπιειμένοι ἀλκήν (clad upon with . . .) Il. 7.164 = Il. 8.262, Il. 18.157. Cf. Il. 9.372: Od. 9.214, 514.
[app. ἐπι- 19 + *ζάφελος in sim. sense, poss. fr. ζα- + φελ-, to swell. Cf. ὀφέλλω2.]
Thus, of wrath, swelling, bursting forth, furious: χόλος Il. 9.525.
A lid or cover: φωριαμῶν Il. 24.228.
genit. sing. neut. aor. pple. ἐπιτρέχω.
With dat.: τύμβῳ μενελάου (in way of insult or derision) Il. 4.177.

p.gloss: To leap on board of (a ship).
To leap or bound over (a space).

div.p: With acc.: τόσσον ἐπιθρῴσκουσιν ἵπποι Il. 5.772.
To rush to or at something Od. 16.297.
With infin., to be eager, strive: [νέκυν] ἐρύσσασθαι Il. 18.175.
[ἐπι- 5 + (ϝ)ισ-, οἶδα. See εἴδω C. One who has knowledge in a particular line.]
Thus app., one with knowledge or experience of something specified: μεγάλων ἔργων (deeds of prowess) Od. 21.26.
App., either headlong (as fr. ἐπὶ κάρη (ἐπί II.2.d)) or (with obscure derivation) sideways: χαράδραι ῥέουσαι ἐ. Il. 16.392.
Of ships, app., plunging their bows in the sea, or drifting side-ways, making leeway Od. 9.70.
To be laid or imposed upon a person: ἐπικείσετʼ ἀνάγκη Il. 6.458.
Of a door, to be shut: θύραι ἐπέκειντο Od. 6.19.
App., to cut the line of retreat of, cut off the retreat of Il. 16.394.
acc. pl. fem. pf. pple. pass. ἐπικλίνω.
Acc. pl. masc. pple. ἐπικέλσαντας Od. 9.138.
To put one's ship on shore, bring her to shore Od. 9.138.
Of a ship, to come to shore Od. 9.148.
To call upon, summon, invoke: Ἐρινῦς (i.e. to further his prayers) Il. 9.454.
To make fun of, mock, jeer at Il. 16.744: Od. 22.194.
In Il. 24.649 ἐπικερτομέων is app. to be taken as absol., and as referring to Achilles' tone in what follows as to Agamemnon.
Absol., to conceal one's thoughts or knowledge, withhold speech Il. 10.115: Od. 5.143, Od. 14.467, Od. 15.263, Od. 17.154, Od. 19.269, Od. 23.265.
In pass., of the water of a river, to be spread over, to flow upon.
So of the dawn, to be spread or shed over (a space) Il. 7.451, 458.
To praise, extol, applaud; ἀοιδήν Od. 1.351.

In acc. with a vb. of naming, as a second or derived name: ὅν τε κύνʼ Ὠρίωνος ἐπίκλησιν καλέουσιν Il. 22.29, Ἀστυάναξ, ὃν Τρῶες ἐπίκλησιν καλέουσιν (i.e. name thus) 506 (cf. Il. 6.402). Cf. Il. 7.138 (as a nickname), Il. 18.487: = Od. 5.273.
Adverbially in acc., in name, nominally (cf. πρόφασις, χάρις 2.b): ἐπίκλησιν βώρῳ [τέκεν] Il. 16.177.
Acc. pl. fem. pf. pple. pass. ἐπικεκλιμένας.
To put into position for closing a gate, put to: ἐπικεκλιμένας σανίδας καὶ ὀχῆα Il. 12.121.
With genit., using deceit in the matter of, cunning or wily in: μύθων Il. 22.281.
Cunning or skilful in the matter of: τόξων Od. 21.397.
As sb., a cozener or cheat Od. 11.364.
To listen to, give ear to: ἐπεὶ αἶνον ἐπέκλυεν Il. 23.652.
[ἐπι- 5 + κλώθω, to spin. Cf. κλῶθες. To spin the thread of one's destiny]
3 pl. aor. mid. ἐπεκλώσαντο Il. 24.525: Od. 1.17, Od. 8.579.
To assign as one's lot or portion: ὄλβον Od. 3.208, Od. 4.208, τά Od. 11.139, Od. 16.64.
To bring one's blow to bear upon, strike: βοῦν Od. 3.443.
To give one's services in aid, fight in another's cause Il. 5.614.
One who gives his services in aid, one who fights in support of another or in another's cause Il. 3.188, Il. 5.478, Il. 21.431.
Esp. of the allies supporting the Trojan cause Il. 2.130, 803, 815, Il. 3.451, 456, Il. 5.473, etc.
To grant accomplishment or fulfilment of (a wish or prayer) Il. 1.455 = Il. 16.238, Il. 8.242, Il. 15.599.
To hold rule: ὅτʼ ἐπικρατέωσιν ἄνακτες οἱ νέοι Od. 14.60 (as ἄνακτες (masters), i.e. when the young are masters).
To give directions, keep one's rule in evidence Od. 17.320.
With dat., to hold sway among or in: νήεσσιν Il. 10.214: νήσοισιν Od. 1.245 = Od. 16.122 = Od. 19.130.
To have the upper hand in battle, be victorious Il. 14.98.
In overwhelming force, with over-powering might Il. 16.67, 81.
Putting forth one's strength: ἰὸν ἧκεν ἐ. Il. 23.863.
A top or look-out place fitted to the mast at some distance above its base in the ἴκρια Od. 5.254, 318.
To shine or give its light on the occurrence of something specified: ἠέλιος ἐπέλαμψεν (there-upon) Il. 17.650.
To make a libation upon something specified: ἀνιστάμενοι ἐπέλειβον Od. 3.341.

p.gloss: To see, have vision, over (a space).

div.p: With genit.: φάρμακον κακῶν ἐπίληθον Od. 4.221.
In act., to cause to forget.

div.head: a
div.p: To forget, cease to think of: τείχεος τὸ πολίσσαμεν Il. 7.452. Cf. Il. 22.387: Od. 1.57.

div.head: b
div.p: To forget, fail to bethink or avail oneself of: τέχνης Od. 4.455, σχεδίης Od. 5.324.
[ἐπι- 8 + ληκ-, λάσκω. To make a sound in accompaniment.]
Hence, app., to beat time with the feet Od. 8.379.
In a grazing manner, so as to be wounded superficially Il. 17.599.
[ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5 + ἰλλίζω, conn. with ἰλλός, squinting.]

p.gloss: To make a sidelong glance at in order to incite to something.

div.p: With dat.: ἐπιλλίζουσί μοι ἑλκέμεναι δὲ κέλονται Od. 18.11.
To mock at a person Od. 2.323.
With genit., to aim at, seek to get: μεγάλων δώρων Il. 10.401.
To strive after, struggle for: νόστου Od. 5.344.
To steer for, head for: σκοπέλου Od. 12.220.
To strike: μάστιγι ἵππους Il. 5.748 = Il. 8.392. Cf. Il. 17.430: Od. 13.429, Od. 16.172.
To handle, touch, feel: ὀΐων νῶτα Od. 9.441. Cf. Od. 9.446.
Absol. Od. 9.302 (feeling for the mortal spot), Od. 19.468.
To keep feeling, finger; ξίφεος κώπην Od. 11.531.
To put the hand upon, examine (a wound) Il. 4.190.
(Written also as two words.) A witness invoked in sanction of something: Ζεὺς ἄμμʼ ἐ. ἔστω Il. 7.76. Cf. Od. 1.273.
App., sought out, that has been brought (i.e. by Eumaeus), and has not come unasked: ἀλήτην Od. 20.377.
To smile at a person, look towards him with a smile of propitiation or encouragement Il. 4.356, Il. 8.38: Od. 22.371.
With a smile of amusement or derision Il. 10.400.
To find fault, show displeasure: εὐχωλῆς (in the matter of . . .) Il. 1.65, 93, τέο ἐπιμέμφεαι; Il. 2.225.
To wait or tarry (a little) longer: νῦν ἐπίμεινον Il. 6.340. Cf. Il. 19.142: Od. 1.309, Od. 4.587, Od. 11.351.
To remain where one is, stay behind Od. 17.277.
With dat.: δόλον ἐπεμήδετο πατρί Od. 4.437.
1 pl. aor. opt. mid. ἐπιμνησαίμεθα Il. 17.103: Od. 4.191.
Aor. pple. pass. ἐπιμνησθείς Od. 1.31, Od. 4.189.
In mid. and pass., to remember, think of : Αἰγίσθοιο Od. 1.31. Cf. Od. 4.189.
To remember, bethink oneself of: χάρμης Il. 17.103.
In mid., to speak about: σεῖο Od. 4.191.
With dat.: ἔργον ᾧ ἐπιμίμνω Od. 14.66, Od. 15.372.
Mingled together, in a confused mass: πλῆτο ἐ. ἵππων τε καὶ ἀνδρῶν Il. 21.16. Cf. Il. 23.242.
In confusion, with all order lost: ὀρίνονται Il. 11.525. Cf. Il. 14.60.
Indiscriminately, with random rage: μαίνεται Od. 11.537.
In pass. with dat.,, to mingle with, have dealings or intercourse with: ἄμμι Od. 6.205. Cf. Od. 6.241.

In hostile sense: ἂψ ἐπιμισγομένων (as they joined battle (app. genit. absolute and referring to the whole of the combatants)) Il. 5.505, αἰεὶ Τρώεσσʼ ἐπιμίσγομαι (am always in touch with . . .) Il. 10.548.
To murmur or mutter at something: ἐπέμυξαν Ἀθηναίη τε καὶ Ἥρη (thereat) Il. 4.20 = Il. 8.457.
To distribute or give out among a company: σῖτον Il. 9.216, Il. 24.625: Od. 20.254.
To nod: κόρυθι δʼ ἐπένευεν (with his . . ., i.e. it nodded) Il. 22.314.
To nod in sanction of a promise Il. 15.75.
On forming part of the substance of, the kidneys: δημόν Il. 21.204.
To assign as one's lot or portion Il. 20.128.
Absol. with complementary infin.: τῷ ὣς μοῖρʼ ἐπένησε . . . κύνας ἆσαι Il. 24.210.
To swear falsely, perjure oneself: οὐδʼ ἐπιορκήσω Il. 19.188.
[app. ἐπι- 5 + ὅρκος. In violation of one's oath.]

In neut. ἐπίορκον as adv., of swearing, falsely, so as to perjure oneself: ὅτις κʼ ἐ. ὀμόσσῃ Il. 3.279, Il. 19.260, ἐ. ἐπώμοσεν Il. 10.332 (here of unintentional falsity, the fulfiment of the oath turning out to be impossible).
To have one's eye upon; hence, to exercise vigilance, use one's efforts, to prevent: ἐπιοσσομένω θάνατον ἑταίρων Il. 17.381.

In mid., to yield to inducement, persuasion or command, to do another's bidding, be ruled, obey: οὔ τις ἐπιπείσεται Il. 18.296. Cf. Il. 9.660: Od. 2.103 = Od. 10.466 = Od. 12.28 = Od. 24.138, Od. 10.406, 475, 550 = Od. 12.321 = Od. 19.148.
Of time, to come on or round: ἐπιπλόμενον ἔτος (the pple. adjectivally, revolving) Od. 7.261 = Od. 14.287.
With dat.: εἰπόντι οἱ ἐπέπτατο ὄρνις Il. 13.821: = Od. 15.160 = 525.
Of an arrow, to fly or speed to its mark Il. 4.126.
To approach or come near to a specified place: οὐ χιὼν ἐπιπίλναται Od. 6.44.
In pass., to wander or rove over or upon.

p.gloss: To sail over or upon, traverse.

div.p: To attack with words, to find fault with, chide.
In pres. only in forms fr. ἐπιπνείω.
3 pl. aor. subj. ἐπιπνεύσωσι Od. 9.139. Of wind
To blow upon a person Il. 5.698.
To blow in a particular (i.e. the desired) direction Od. 9.139.
To have a specified appearance: οὐδέ τοι δούλειον ἐπιπρέπει εἶδος (shows like a slave's) Od. 24.252.
To push forward towards (and for) a person: τράπεζάν σφωϊν Il. 11.628.
To send forth or let fly (an arrow) at.
To send forth (a person) on a specified or indicated mission: ἄνδρας Il. 9.520, Ἀχιλλῆα νηυσίν Il. 18.58 = Il. 18.439 (the dat. appears to be sociative, with the . . .).
To send forth (a person) towards or to.
To sneeze at, i.e. as giving a favourable omen to accompany.

p.gloss: To go round or among, inspect, review.

div.p: With acc.: στίχας ἀνδρῶν Il. 3.196, Il. 4.231, 250.

p.gloss: To range round or among with hostile intent.

div.p: To do sacrifice to an indicated divinity Od. 17.211.

p.gloss: To descend in the scales of fate upon, come upon.

div.p: With dat.: ὄφρʼ ἡμῖν ὄλεθρος ἐπιρρέπῃ Il. 14.99.

p.gloss: To flow over or on the surface of.

div.p: Fig., of bodies of men, to stream on and on Il. 11.724.
To thrust or drive home (the fastening of a gate): ἐπιβλῆτα Il. 24.454, 456.
[ἐπιρροθέω, to shout to (in encouragement), fr. ἐπι- 5 + ῥοθέω to make a sound. Cf. ῥόθιος.]
A supporter, aider, helper Il. 4.390, Il. 23.770.
Of hair, to ripple or flow forward on the occurrence of something: νεῦσε . . . χαῖται δʼ ἐπερρώσαντο (with the nod) Il. 1.529.
One who watches over something, a guardian or protector Il. 22.255, Il. 24.729.
One who looks (sharply) after something, a (keen) trafficker in or snatcher of something: ὁδαίων Od. 8.163.
One who spies upon (something), a spy.
To be angry or offended at something Il. 9.370: Od. 7.306 (should take offence).
The fold of skin above the eyes. Of a lion Il. 17.136.
[adv. fr. ἐπισμυγερός, fr. ἐπι- 19 + σμυγερός app. = μογερός, adj. fr. μόγος.]
In sad or grievous fashion, to one's cost Od. 3.195, Od. 4.672.
Brought upon oneself, such as one has oneself to thank for: κακόν Od. 18.73, Od. 24.462.
To urge a person or a horse on to exertion Od. 23.430: Od. 22.451.
Intrans. for reflexive, of wind, to rush, blow furiously Od. 5.304.
To shake something (threateningly) at a person: τῇ (sc. αἰγίδι) ἐπισσείων φοβέειν Ἀχαιούς Il. 15.230 (τῇ with φοβέειν).
3 sing. aor. ἐπέσσευε Od. 18.256, Od. 19.129, Od. 20.87.
3 sing. aor. mid. ἐπέσσυτο Il. 5.438, 459, Il. 9.398, Il. 21.227, etc.: Od. 4.841, Od. 6.20.
3 sing. pf. ἐπέσσυται Il. 1.173, Il. 6.361, Il. 9.42.
To set on or incite against a person Od. 14.399.
With dat., to set in motion or send against: κῆτός μοι Od. 5.421.
To send or cause to operate against: κακά μοι Od. 18.256 = Od. 19.129. Cf. Od. 20.87.
To hasten or speed towards a specified or indicated point: ἀγορήνδʼ ἐπεσσεύοντο Il. 2.208, ἐπεσσύμενον πεδίοιο (over the . . .) Il. 22.26. Cf. Il. 2.86, Il. 13.757, Il. 18.575: Od. 13.19.

In hostile sense, to rush, dart, dash, spring at or against someone or something: ἐπέσσυτο δαίμονι ἶσος Il. 5.438 = Il. 16.705 = 786 = Il. 20.447. Cf. Il. 16.411, Il. 20.288, Il. 21.234, 601: Od. 4.454.
With acc.: μνηστῆρας Od. 22.307. Cf. Il. 12.143, Il. 15.395.
Without indication of direction, to speed, rush: ἐπεσσύμενος πεδίοιο Il. 14.147.
In pf. pple., putting forth an effort, making a spring: ἐπεσσύμενος λάβε πέτρης Od. 5.428.
Speeding, running up: λάβε γούνων Od. 22.310.
To be set, bent, disposed, inclined in an indicated direction: εἴ τοι θυμὸς ἐπέσσυται Il. 1.173.
With complementary infin.: κτήμασι τέρπεσθαι Il. 9.398.
With ὥς τε and infin.: ὥς τε νέεσθαι Il. 9.42.
Going round and standing or stopping by each in turn: νείκεον Od. 12.392. Cf. Od. 13.54 = Od. 18.425.
Attending to each detail in succession: δόρπον ὁπλίζοντο Od. 16.453.

div.head: a
div.p: To know how to do, have skill, be skilled, in doing: δαίδαλα τεύχειν Il. 5.60, ἢ ἐπίστηται πολεμίζειν (will prove to be a fighter) Il. 16.243. Cf. Il. 2.611, Il. 5.222 = Il. 8.106, Il. 13.223, 238: Od. 9.49.

div.head: b
div.p:
To be able to do
(something difficult or puzzling): ὀστέʼ ἀλλέξαι Il. 21.320.
With neg., to be at a loss as to doing: οὔ πῃ θέσθαι ἐπίσταμαι Od. 13.207.
To have the strength to do: πῆλαι ἔγχος Il. 16.142 = Il. 19.389.

div.head: c
div.p: To know how to do, have the wit, knowledge, character, turn of mind, needed for doing: ἄρτια βάζειν Il. 14.92: = Od. 8.240. Cf. Il. 17.671, Il. 4.404.
To know so as to have skill in: ἔργα Il. 23.705: Od. 2.117 = Od. 7.111.

div.head: a
div.p: Skilled, skilful, expert, clever, astute: ἐπιστάμενος ἄκοντι (comitative dat., with the . . .) Il. 15.282. Cf. Il. 19.80: ἰητρὸς ἐπιστάμενος Od. 4.231. Cf. Od. 13.313, Od. 23.185.

div.head: b

p.gloss: Skilled in or in the use of.

div.p: With genit.: φόρμιγγος καὶ ἀοιδῆς Od. 21.406.

div.head: c
div.p: In moral sense, knowing the right, of good character or disposition Od. 14.359.
Absol., to know, have knowledge: ἐπιστάμεναι σάφα θυμῷ Od. 4.730.

Skilfully, deftly, dexterously: μίστυλλον Il. 7.317 = Il. 24.623, ὀδόντες ἔχον ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ἐ. (skilfully arranged or disposed) Il. 10.265. Cf. Od. 5.25, 245, Od. 11.368, Od. 12.307, Od. 17.341 = Od. 21.44, Od. 19.422, 457, Od. 20.159, 161, Od. 23.197.
[ἐπι- 2 + στα-, ἵστημι. One who stands by or beside.]
A suppliant or almsman; or perh., a follower or dependant Od. 17.455.
In mid.: ἐπεστενάχοντο δʼ ἑταῖροι Il. 4.154.
Filled to the brim: κρητῆρας ἐπιστεφέας οἴνοιο (for the genit. cf. next) Il. 8.232: Od. 2.431.
[ἐπι- 5 + στέφω in sense to pack close.]
To fill to the brim: κρητῆρας ἐπεστέψαντο ποτοῖο (genit. of material, with . . .) Il. 1.470, Il. 9.175: = Od. 1.148 = Od. 3.339 = Od. 21.271.
Skilful, clever, adroit: ἐ. βουλῇ τε νόῳ τε Od. 16.374.
A slip on which to haul up a ship Od. 6.265.
To make a sound under stress of something. Of the sea Il. 24.79.
Intrans. for reflexive, to turn oneself towards something: ἕλκεν ἐπιστρέψας Il. 3.370 (i.e. in pulling he turned partly round towards his friends).
Turning from one to another, taking one after another: κτεῖνεν Il. 10.483. Cf. Il. 21.20: Od. 22.308, Od. 24.184.
Going about or among: ἐ. ἦν ἀνθρώπων (had intercourse or dealings with (many) men) Od. 1.177.

Perh. a guard of metal fixed on the leg between the knee and the ankle and partly covering the κνημίς so as to supplement this in protecting against the chafing of the shield: κνημῖδας ἀργυρέοισιν ἐπισφυρίοις ἀραρυίας Il. 3.331 = Il. 11.18 = Il. 16.132 = Il. 19.370. Cf. Il. 18.459.
In a row, one after or beside another: εἰς ὅ κε κτεινώμεθʼ ἐ. Il. 11.668, ἀκτὴν ἐσανέβαινον ἐ. Il. 18.68. Cf. Il. 23.125.
An offering or putting forward: μύθου Od. 21.71.
To aim or direct a missile in an indicated direction.
In mid.: ἐπισχόμενος βάλεν ἰῷ Od. 22.15.
To restrain, control, manage: ἵππους Il. 17.465.
Dat. sing. masc. pple. ἐπιτειλαμένῳ Od. 17.21.
To lay, impose, inflict upon a person.
In mid.: νόστον λυγρόν, ὃν ἐπετείλατο Od. 1.327.
With dat.: χαλεπούς μοι ἐπετέλλετʼ ἀέθλους Od. 11.622.

div.head: a
div.p: To lay an injunction or charge upon, give an order or orders to, a person: ὣς ἐπέτελλεν Il. 9.259 = Il. 11.790. Cf. Il. 2.10, Il. 9.369, Il. 10.56, 72, Il. 11.768, 782, Il. 17.360, Il. 21.445: Od. 17.186.

div.head: b
div.p: With dat.: υἱέϊ σῷ Il. 24.112, ὧδέ μʼ ἐπέτελλε, μὴ . . . Il. 24.780 (with the assurance) that he would not...), cf. Il. 5.198, Il. 10.63, Il. 11.765, Il. 13.213, 753: Od. 17.9.

div.head: c
div.p: With dat. and the injunction directly reported Il. 11.785, Il. 17.668.

div.head: d
div.p: With acc. of what is enjoined or ordered: συνθεσιάων ἃς ἐπέτελλε (which he bade him remember) Il. 5.320. Cf. Il. 5.818.

div.head: e
div.p: With dat. and acc.: ἕκαστά μʼ ἐπέτελλεν Il. 23.107. Cf. Od. 23.361.
In mid.: κούροισι ταῦτʼ ἐπιτέλλομαι Il. 9.68. Cf. Il. 1.295, Il. 19.192, Il. 23.95: Od. 8.40.

div.head: g
div.p: With infin. to be supplied: ὄφρα μῦθον ἐνίσπω, ὃν Νέστωρ ἐπέτελλεν [ἐνισπεῖν] Il. 11.840.
In mid., to take delight in.
In sufficient number: ἐν ἐρέτας ἐ. ἀγείρομεν Il. 1.142: μνηστήρων σʼ ἐ. ἀριστῆες λοχόωσιν (in force; or perh. here rather to be taken in sense with set purpose) Od. 15.28.
Nom. dual masc. pple. ἐπιθέντε Od. 22.201.
To put or place upon something: οὐκ ἂν ταῦτʼ ἐπιθεῖτε; (sc. on the waggon) Il. 24.264.
To put (food) on the table: εἴδατʼ ἐπιθεῖσα Od. 1.140 = Od. 4.56 = Od. 7.176 = Od. 10.372 = Od. 15.139 = Od. 17.95.
To put or fit on something by way of completing or finishing or for ornament: ἐπέθηκε κορώνην Il. 4.111. Cf. Od. 19.256, Od. 21.45, Od. 23.194.
With dat., to impose (a penalty) upon: σοὶ θωήν Od. 2.192.
To give (fulfilment) to: οὐδὲ τέλος μύθῳ ἐπιθήσεις Il. 19.107. Cf. Il. 20.369.
To put to, shut (a door) Il. 14.169: Od. 22.157, 201.
To put in position (something covering or closing): νέφος Il. 5.751 = Il. 8.395: θυρεόν Od. 9.240 = 340, 314.
App., to bring into action: λόχον Od. 11.525 (see ἀνακλίνω 1).
To apply (something covering or closing) to.
With dat.: φαρέτρῃ πῶμα Od. 9.314. Cf. Od. 9.243, Od. 13.370.
To give in addition, add: οἴκοθεν ἄλλα Il. 7.364, 391. Cf. Il. 23.796: Od. 22.62.
To be patient, to acquiesce in something proposed Il. 23.591.

p.gloss: To lend a patient ear to, let oneself be ruled by.

div.p: With dat.: ἐπιτλήτω τοι κραδίη μύθοισιν ἐμοῖσιν Il. 19.220.
To steel oneself to endure something Od. 17.238.

p.gloss: To steel or resign oneself to do.

div.p: With infin.: ἐπιτολμάτω κραδίη ἀκούειν Od. 1.353.
The backstay of a mast (cf. πρότονοι) Od. 12.423.

p.gloss: To shoot at, use the bow against.
To commit or leave a duty

div.p: With dat. and infin.: Τρωσὶ φυλάσσειν Il. 10.421.
3 sing. pf. pass. ἐπιτέτραπται Il. 5.750, Il. 8.394.
In mid., of the mind, etc., to be turned or inclined in a specified direction, to be bent or set on doing.
With infin.: σοὶ θυμὸς ἐπετράπετο εἴρεσθαι (is set on . . .) Od. 9.12.

div.head: a
div.p: To turn over, commit, entrust, leave to: ᾧ λαοὶ ἐπιτετράφαται Il. 2.25 = 62: μέντορι οἶκον Od. 2.226. Cf. Il. 5.750 = Il. 8.394, Il. 17.509: Od. 15.24, Od. 22.289.

div.head: b
div.p: To leave or bequeath to: παισὶ κτήματα Od. 7.149.

div.head: c
div.p: To commitor leave an indicated duty to: τοῖσι μάλιστα Il. 10.59.

div.head: d
div.p: To leave it to (a person) to do: σοὶ οἴῳ πονέεσθαι Il. 10.116..

div.head: e
div.p: To leave a matter to, leave oneself in the hands of: θεοῖσιν Od. 19.502, Od. 21.279.
With dat., to yield or give up to: Ποσειδάωνι νίκην Il. 21.473.
To yield or give in to: γήραϊ Il. 10.79.
Genit. sing. neut. aor. pple. ἐπιθρέξαντος Il. 13.409.

p.gloss: To run towards in its course, tend to approach.

div.p: With dat.: ἅρμαθʼ ἵπποις ἐπέτρεχον Il. 23.504.
To run towards or up to a person, etc., with hostile intent: ἐπέδραμεν ὅς ῥʼ ἔβαλεν Il. 4.524. Of. Il. 5.617, Il. 10.354, Il. 14.421, Il. 18.527.
To run after or in pursuit of a competitor in a race. Of horses Il. 23.418, 447.
To run over (a space). Of horses: πόσσον ἐπιδραμέτην Il. 23.433.
Of a spear, to pass over (and graze) something: ἀσπὶς ἐπιθρέξαντος ἄϋσεν ἔγχεος (genit. absolute) Il. 13.409.
In pf., of light, to play or be shed upon something: λευκὴ ἐπιδέδρομεν αἴγλη Od. 6.45.
Of a mist, to be spread over something Od. 20.357.
Trippingly on the tongue, without stumbling: ἀγόρευεν Il. 3.213.
Fluently, too fluently, with a torrent of words Od. 18.26.
To lay (a hand or one's hands) upon.
With dat.: σοὶ χεῖρας Il. 1.89. Cf. Il. 19.261: Od. 16.438.
To grudge something to, be disinclined to grant something to: ᾧ κʼ ἐπιφθονέοις, ὁ δʼ εἶσιν ὀπίσσω Od. 11.149.
To burn up, consume: νεκρὸν πῦρ Il. 23.52.

p.gloss: To blaze or rage over or through.

div.p: To think of, have the wit to do: τὸ οὔ τις ἐπεφράσατο, μηροῦ ἐξερύσαι δόρυ (it did not occur to them) Il. 5.665.
To take (counsel): ἐπιφρασσαίμεθʼ ἂν βουλήν Il. 13.741.
To think of, have the wit to think of, devise: τὸν μῦθον ἀγορεῦσαι Od. 5.183 (the infin. complementary).
To devise, contrive: ὑμῖν ὄλεθρον Od. 15.444.
To mark, note something regarding: Ἀλκίνοός μιν οἶος ἐπεφράσατο Od. 8.94 = 533, ἵνα μή μιν ἐπιφρασσαίατʼ Ἀχαιοί (lest he should betray himself) Od. 18.94.
To mark, get into one's head.
With dependent clause: οὐκ ἐπεφράσω ὅσσον ἀρείων εὔχομʼ ἔμεναι Il. 21.410.
To get cognizance of, learn, hear: βουλήν Il. 2.282.
To mark or discern what should be marked or discerned: ὡς σὺ ἐπιφρονέουσʼ ἀγορεύεις (showing good discernment) Od. 19.385.
Sagacity or adroitness in an emergency Od. 5.437.
In pl., sense or prudence leading one to do something specified: αἲ γὰρ ἐπιφροσύνας ἀνέλοιο οἴκου κήδεσθαι Od. 19.22.
[app. ἐπι- 5 + φρήν. Applying the mind to something.]
Having good sense, well-balanced in mind, shrewd, sagacious Od. 23.12.–
Of counsel, wise, shrewd, sagacious Od. 3.128, Od. 16.242, Od. 19.326.
To lay hands upon, apply oneself to.
With dat.: δείπνῳ Od. 24.386. Cf. Od. 24.395.
3 pl. aor. pass. ἐπέχυντο Il. 15.654, Il. 16.295.
To pour over a person's hands: χέρνιβα Od. 1.136 = Od. 4.52 = Od. 7.172 = Od. 10.368 = Od. 15.135 = Od. 17.91.
In mid., to pile up on oneself, cover oneself with: χύσιν ἐπεχεύατο φύλλων Od. 5.487.
To pile up or dispose against something: πολλὴν ἐπεχεύατο ὕλην Od. 5.257 (i.e., app., set it outside the wicker-work as additional protection).
In pass., of persons, to stream or be spread over an indicated or specified space: τοὶ δʼ ἐπέχυντο Il. 15.654. Cf. Il. 16.295.
Absol. in pl., the dwellers on earth: ἄλλος ἐπιχθονίων Il. 24.220. Cf. Od. 17.115, Od. 24.197.
With dat., to attack, assail, lay hands upon: λύκοι ἄρνεσσιν Il. 16.352, Δαναοὶ Τρώεσσιν 356.
To assail with importunities, beset: μητέρι Od. 2.50.
To apply unguent to, anoint (one's person or a part thereof): παρειάς Od. 18.172.
To exercise the power of touch in an indicated direction. Fig.: ὅς τʼ ὀλίγον περ ἐπιψαύῃ πραπίδεσσιν (has even a little range with his wits) Od. 8.547.
A place where ships may lie under the lee of the land, a roadstead Od. 5.404.
With acc., to go towards, to go to join: μνηστῆρας ἐπῴχετο Od. 1.324.
In hostile sense, to assail, attack. Of Apollo: οὐρῆας Il. 1.50.
So absol.: ἐποιχόμενος κατέπεφνεν Il. 24.759: Od. 3.280 = Od. 15.411.
Of a hero under the inspiration of a divinity. Of Diomedes Il. 5.330, Il. 10.487.
To range, go about, go hither and thither: πάντοσε Il. 5.508, Μυρμιδόνας ἐποιχόμενος θώρηξεν Il. 16.155. Cf. Il. 6.81, Il. 10.167, 171, Il. 16.496 = 533, Il. 16.215: Od. 6.282.

p.gloss: To range or go hither and thither over.

div.p: Of sound: [ἀϋτὴ] πάσας [πύλας] ἐπῴχετο Il. 12.340 (v. l. πᾶσαι ἐπώχατο).
To go round a company: ἐπῴχετο οἰνοχοεύων Od. 1.143. Cf. Od. 17.346 = 351.
With acc., to range or go hither and thither round or among: πάντας ἐπῴχετο κελεύων Il. 17.356.
To go round or among, inspect, review: πάσας [φώκας] Od. 4.451.

p.gloss: To walk along (the web) following the shuttle, to work at (the web).

div.p: With acc.: ἱστὸν ἐποιχομένην Il. 1.31. Cf. Od. 5.62, Od. 10.222, 226, 254.
Hence, in gen., to ply (one's task): ἔργον ἐποίχεσθαι Il. 6.492: Od. 1.358, Od. 17.227, Od. 18.363, Od. 21.352.
To go to see about, busy oneself about: δόρπον Od. 13.34.
Absol., to go about a task: ἐποιχομένη ἔντυεν ἵππους Il. 5.720 = Il. 8.382.
To take an oath at one's bidding: ἐπόμνυον ὡς ἐκέλευεν Od. 15.437 = Od. 18.58. Cf. Il. 10.332.
In neut. ἐπομφάλιον as adv., on the boss (of a shield): βάλε σάκος ἐπομφάλιον Il. 7.267.
To have regard for, respect, shrink from incurring: Διὸς μῆνιν Od. 5.146.
To roast upon something indicated: ἐπώπτων ἔγκατα Od. 12.363.
[ἐπ-, ἐπι- 14 + ὀπτεύω, fr. ὀπ-. See ὁράω.]
To go over, visit, inspect: ἔργα Od. 16.140.
In mid., to reach towards a person in order to strike him: ἐπορεξάμενος οὔτασε χεῖρα Il. 5.335.
To rouse to action, stir up: μένος Il. 20.93, Il. 22.204.

div.head: a
div.p: To rouse or incite to action against, set on: Ἀθηναίην οἱ Il. 5.765. Cf. Il. 17.72.
To rouse or set in motion (a natural force) against: νηυσὶν ἄνεμον Od. 9.67. Cf. Od. 5.109.

div.head: b
div.p: To bring (something evil) upon: ὀϊζύν μοι Od. 7.271. Cf. Il. 15.613.

div.head: c
div.p: To cause (sleep) to come to: τῇ ὕπνον Od. 22.429.
In mid., to rouse or bestir oneself to action against, rush upon.
To rush at a foe, make an attack or assault: τρὶς ἐπόρουσεν Il. 5.436, Il. 16.784, Il. 20.445. Cf. Il. 3.379, Il. 13.541, Il. 16.330, Il. 20.284, 442, Il. 21.33, Il. 22.138.
To rush up in order to strip a fallen foe: ἐπόρουσε καὶ αἴνυτο τεύχεα Il. 11.580. Cf. Il. 13.550, Il. 15.579.

div.head: a
div.p: To rush at, attack, assail: αἰνείᾳ Il. 5.432. Cf. Il. 4.472, Il. 11.256, Il. 15.520, 525, Il. 16.320, Il. 21.144, 392.

div.head: b
div.p: To rush or speed to or towards as a helper: τυδεΐδῃ Il. 5.793.

div.head: c
div.p: Of sleep, to come irresistibly, fall, upon: Ὀδυσσῆϊ Od. 23.343.
Dat. sing. ἔπεϊ Il. 5.879. ἔπει Il. 1.395, 504, Il. 15.106.
Something said, an utterance or speech, a word: ἐ. ἔφατο Il. 1.361, ἅλιον ἐ. ἔκβαλον Il. 18.324. Cf. Il. 2.807, Il. 3.204, Il. 4.350, Il. 5.170, etc.: Od. 3.226, 374, Od. 4.503, Od. 8.241, etc.
What one has to say, discourse, words: ἵνʼ ἐ. ἀκούσῃς ἡμέτερον Od. 11.561.
An element of speech, a word: τά μοι ἔειπε, τῶν οὐδέν τοι κρύψω ἐ. Od. 4.350 = Od. 17.141.

In pl., speech, discourse, words: ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα Il. 1.201, ὄτρυνεν ἐπέεσσιν Il. 3.249, ἐπέεσσι καθάπτετο Il. 15.127. Cf. Il. 1.223, 304, 519, Il. 2.73, 75, etc.: Od. 2.189, 323, Od. 3.264, Od. 4.286, Od. 11.99, etc.
In pl., words, speech, as distinguished from action: ἔπεσιν ὀνείδισον Il. 1.211, ἐπέεσσί κʼ ἀθανάτοισι μαχοίμην Il. 20.367. Cf. Il. 16.628, Il. 20.200, 211, 256, 431: Od. 6.143, 146.
Contrasted in terms with χεῖρες Il. 1.77, Il. 16.630.
In pl.: ἐπέων ἠδὲ καὶ ἔργων Il. 11.703.
With βίη: ἢ ἔπει ἠὲ βίῃ Il. 15.106.

The sense of the word coloured by the context Il. 1.108 (a prediction), 150 (your orders), 216 (your injunction), 419 (your prayer), 543 (your intention), Il. 2.361 (the counsel), Il. 3.83 (a proposal), Il. 7.375 (proposal), 394 (proposal), Il. 8.8 (my announced purpose, my will), Il. 9.100 (say what is in your mind and hearken to what another has to say), Il. 11.652 (tidings), 788 (counsel), Il. 14.44 (the threat), 212 (your request), 234 (my request), Il. 15.156 (the commands), 162 (my commands), 178 (his commands), 566 (his exhortation), Il. 16.236 (my prayer), 686 (the injunction), Il. 17.701 (tidings), Il. 18.273 (counsel), Il. 19.121 (a piece of news), Il. 22.454 (the thing which I say (the thing being identified with the words)), Il. 23.544 (what you propose), Il. 24.75 (a suggestion), 92 and 224 (his injunction), 744 (counsel): Od. 3.243 (a question), Od. 4.137, 420 and 461 (questions), Od. 6.289 (counsel, directions), Od. 8.91 (his lays), 141 (this proposal of yours), 358 (your request), Od. 10.178 (exhortation), 428 (orders), Od. 11.146 (directions), 348 (this suggestion), Od. 12.222 (exhortation), 266 (injunction), Od. 14.131 (a story), Od. 15.536 = Od. 17.163 = Od. 19.309 (prediction), Od. 16.469 (the news), Od. 17.519 (lays), 584 (cf. Il. 9.100 above), Od. 18.166 (a warning), Od. 19.98 (cf. Il. 9.100 above), 565 (idle promises), Od. 20.115 (wish, prayer), 236 (prediction), Od. 21.278 (counsel).
Pple. ἐποτρύνας Od. 2.422, Od. 9.488, Od. 10.128, Od. 11.44, etc. Indin. ἐποτρῦναι Od. 10.531.
1 pl. aor. subj. mid. ἐποτρυνώμεθα Od. 8.31.

div.head: a
div.p: To rouse or stir to action, incite, urge, press, exhort: φάλαγγας Il. 6.83, Ὀδυσῆα Il. 8.92. Cf. Il. 10.130, Il. 15.43: Od. 1.89, Od. 5.139, Od. 8.185, Od. 14.461, Od. 17.395.

div.head: b
div.p: With complementary infin.: τάφρον διαβαινέμεν Il. 12.50. Cf. Il. 13.767 = Il. 17.117 = 683, Il. 15.456, Il. 16.525, 690, Il. 17.178: Od. 8.45.

div.head: c
div.p: With dat. and infin.: ἱππεῦσιν ἐλαυνέμεν ἵππους Il. 15.258. Cf. Od. 10.531.

div.head: d
div.p: With acc. and infin.: ἑὲ αὐτὸν μαχέσασθαι Il. 20.171. Cf. Od. 2.189, Od. 6.36, Od. 14.498, Od. 15.73.

div.head: e
div.p: With acc. of what one is urged to do: ὅττι κʼ ἐποτρύνῃ Il. 15.148.
To hasten on with, press on.
With dat.: νῶϊν ἐποτρύνει πόλεμον Od. 22.152.
With dat.: μὴ τοῖς ἵπποισιν ἀνὴρ ἐποχήσεται ἄλλος Il. 10.330. Cf. Il. 17.449.
With another numeral: ἑ. καὶ δέκα Od. 5.278, Od. 7.267, Od. 24.63.
Of seven layers of ox-hide: σάκος Il. 7.220, 222, 245, 266, Il. 11.545.
For seven years: ἤνασσεν Od. 3.304, μένον Od. 7.259, Od. 14.285.
[ἑπτά + ποδ-, πούς, foot, as a measure of length.]
Seven-foot: θρῆνυν (app. raised seven feet) Il. 15.729.
Epithet of the Boeotian Thebes Il. 4.406: Od. 11.263.
To handle, take into one's hands, turn over: τεύχεα Il. 6.321.

div.head: α
div.p: To beset: ἀ. Ὀδυσῆα Τρῶες ἕπον Il. 11.483.

div.head: β
div.p: To busy oneself about: ἀ. βοὸς ἕπετον κρέα Il. 11.776. Cf. Il. 7.316: = Od. 19.421, Od. 8.61.

div.head: b
div.p: With ἐπί, to attend to: ἐ. ἔργον ἕποιεν Od. 14.195.

div.head: c
div.p: With μετά, to direct, look after: μ. τυδέος υἱὸν ἕπουσαν Il. 10.516.

div.head: d
div.p: With περί, to pull about, handle: περὶ τεύχεʼ ἕπουσιν Il. 15.555.
Only in mid. Imp. ἕπευ Il. 13.465, Il. 15.556: Od. 15.281, Od. 23.52, 78.

Without
reduplication, imp. σπεῖο Il. 10.285 (app. for σπέο, the lengthening being due to the first arsis).
Infin. σπέσθαι Il. 5.423: Od. 4.38, Od. 22.324. (ἐφ-, μεθ-.)

div.head: a
div.p: To follow in company with, go or come with, accompany, a person or persons or something: ἀλλʼ ἕπεο Il. 10.146. Cf. Il. 10.246, Il. 13.381, 465, Il. 15.556, Il. 18.387, 572: ἡ δʼ ἕσπετʼ Ἀθήνη Od. 1.125. Cf. Od. 5.91, Od. 10.313, 448, Od. 14.45, 482, Od. 15.162, 281, 470, Od. 23.52, 78, Od. 24.5.

div.head: c
div.p: With ἅμα and dat.: τοκεῦσιν ἅμʼ ἕσπετο Il. 4.476. Cf. Il. 3.143, Il. 5.423, Il. 9.512, Il. 10.222, Il. 12.350, etc.: Od. 2.11, Od. 3.359, Od. 4.38, Od. 6.32, Od. 10.425, etc.

div.head: d
div.p: With μετά: μετὰ νέφος εἵπετο πεζῶν Il. 23.133.
With μετά and dat.: μετά σφιν εἵπετο Il. 18.234.

div.head: e
div.p: With σύν: σὺν δʼ εἵπετʼ Ὀδυσσεύς Od. 10.436.
With σύν and dat.: σὺν ἀμφιπόλοισιν ἕπεσθαι Od. 7.304.
With ἅμα: δύω ἅμʼ ἕποντο νομῆες Il. 18.525: Od. 17.214 = Od. 20.175.
With ἅμα and dat.: ἅμʼ ὕεσσιν ἑπέσθω Od. 15.397.

p.gloss: Of their dogs following with them.

div.p: With dat.: ἐννέα σφι κύνες ἕποντο Il. 18.578.
With μετά and acc.: ὡς εἴ τε μετὰ κτίλον ἕσπετο μῆλα Il. 13.492.
To go with as one's wife.
With dat.: σοὶ ἄλοχον σπέσθαι Od. 22.324.
With ἅμα and dat.: ἦ ἅμʼ ἕπηται (ἕπωμαι) Ἀχαιῶν [κείνῳ] ὅς τις ἄριστος Od. 16.76, Od. 19.528, τῷ κεν ἅμʼ ἑσποίμην Od. 19.579 = Od. 21.77. Cf. Od. 21.104.
To go with, fall to the lot of.
With dat.: τῷ κε νικήσαντι γυνὴ ἕποιτο Il. 3.255.

div.head: a
div.p: To follow a person as one's chief or leader: λαοὶ ἕποντο Il. 13.492. Cf. Il. 4.430: Od. 3.363.
To form part of an expedition, follow with the rest Il. 3.239, 240, Il. 24.400: Od. 11.493.

div.head: c
div.p: With ἅμα: ἅμα νέφος εἵπετο πεζῶν Il. 4.274. Cf. Il. 5.591, Il. 11.796, Il. 12.124, Il. 13.690, 717, etc.: Od. 23.127, Od. 24.117.
With ἅμα and dat.: σοὶ ἅμʼ ἑσπόμεθα Il. 1.158. Cf. Il. 2.524, 534, 542, 762, Il. 12.87, etc.: Od. 11.372, Od. 15.541, Od. 19.196.

div.head: a
div.p: To follow up, hang upon, the foe: αἰὲν ἀποκτείνων ἕπετο Il. 11.154. Cf. Il. 11.165, 168, 565, 754, Il. 15.277, Il. 16.372, Il. 17.730.

div.head: b
div.p: With ἅμα: Τρῶες ἅμʼ ἕποντο Il. 17.753.

div.head: c
div.p: App., with ἀμφί, to beset: ἀμφʼ Ὀδυσσῆα Τρῶες ἕποντο Il. 11.474 (prob. ἕπον should be read. See 483 under ἕπω1 2.a.α).
To be in a person's service: ἓξ δρηστῆρες ἕπονται Od. 16.248.
To be at the service of, fulfil the benests of.
With dat.: πρεσβυτέροισιν Ἐρινύες αἰὲν ἕπονται Il. 15.204.
To keep up with, play one's part with.
With dat.: ἕπεθʼ ἵπποις ἀθανάτοισιν Il. 16.154.
Sim. of the limbs, to keep up with one's spirit or strength, play their part: εἴθʼ ὡς . . . ὥς τοι γούναθʼ ἕποιτο Il. 4.314. Cf. Od. 20.237 = Od. 21.202.
To follow the motion of, fall forward following.
With dat.: ἑσπόμενος πέσε δουρί (i. e. as it was drawn back) Il. 12.395, ἑσπόμενος περὶ δουρί (transfixed by it and giving way before the blow; περί advbl.) Il. 13.570.
Of an inanimate object, to follow the motion of, come away with, something: ἔπαλξις ἕσπετο πᾶσα (came away, gave way) Il. 12.398.
With dat.: προτὶ φρένες δουρὶ ἕποντο (came away with it; προτί advbl.) Il. 16.504.
With ἅμα and dat.: τρυφάλεια ἅμʼ ἕσπετο χειρί Il. 3.376.
To fall in with something proposed, agree, concur: ἐπὶ δʼ ἕψονται θεοὶ ἄλλοι Il. 4.63. Cf. Od. 12.349.
Of a dowry, to go with, accompany.
With ἐπί and genit.: ἔεδνα ὅσσα ἔοικε φίλης ἐπὶ παιδὸς ἕπεσθαι Od. 1.278 = Od. 2.197.
Of honour, to accompany, attend, come to.
With dat.: Διὸς κούρῃσιν ἕπεσθαι τιμήν Il. 9.513.
With ἅμα and dat.: τούτῳ κῦδος ἅμʼ ἕψεται Il. 4.415.
Of a quality, to go with, be shown in (a person).
With dat.: ὅ τοι οὐκ ἕπετʼ ἀλκή Il. 8.140.
[ἐπ-, ἐπι- 4 + ὄνυμα, Aeolic form of ὄνομα.]

Of a name, given on account of some particular circumstance: Ἀλκυόνην καλέεσκον ἐπώνυμον, οὕνεκα . . . Il. 9.562: Ἀρήτη ὄνομʼ ἐστὶν ἐπώνυμον Od. 7.54 (app. because she had been prayed for, fr. ἀρή1), Ὀδυσεὺς ὄνομʼ ἔστω ἐπώνυμον Od. 19.409 (the reason for the name being given in the preceding lines).
To the earth, to the ground, on the ground: πῖπτον Il. 12.156, Il. 18.552. Cf. Il. 16.459, Il. 17.619, 633: Od. 15.527, Od. 22.20, 85, 280.
3 sing. ἠράσατο Il. 16.182. ἠράσσατο Il. 20.223: Od. 11.238.
To love, be in love with: σεο Il. 3.446 = Il. 14.328.
In aor., to fall in love with: ὁπότʼ ἠρασάμην Ἰξιονίης ἀλόχοιο Il. 14.317. Cf. Il. 16.182, Il. 20.223: Od. 11.238.
To be fond of (something), long for, lust after (it): πολέμου Il. 9.64, φυλόπιδος Il. 16.208.
A feast to which the partakers contributed in shares (cf. εἰλαπίνη) Od. 1.226, Od. 11.415.

An epithet of general commendation, pleasing, charming, delightful, fair, or the like: ὁμηλικίην Il. 3.175. Cf. Il. 6.156, Il. 19.347, 353, Il. 21.218: δαῖτα Od. 8.61, Od. 20.117, ἑτάροισιν ἐ. (a pleasing sight) Od. 9.230. Cf. Od. 4.13, Od. 23.300.
With genit.: κρειῶν ἐρατίζων Il. 11.551 = Il. 17.660.
To do work, work, labour: σφίσιν ἐργάζεσθαι ἀνάγκῃ Od. 14.272 = Od. 17.441.
Of a piece of apparatus, to do its work, operate Il. 18.469.

To do, perform: ἔργα ἀεικέα Il. 24.733. Cf. Od. 17.321, Od. 20.72 (complementary infin.), Od. 22.422 (do.),
Od. 24.210.
To work upon, work up: χρυσόν Od. 3.435.
To shut up, confine: συφεοῖσιν (in the . . .) Od. 10.238.

Something done or performed or to be done or performed, a deed: ἃ Ζεὺς μήδετο ἔργα Il. 2.38, ὑπέσχετο μέγα ἐ. Il. 13.366. Cf. Il. 3.130, Il. 5.757, Il. 9.595, Il. 16.120, Il. 18.77, etc.: Od. 1.338, Od. 2.63, Od. 3.275, Od. 10.199, Od. 18.221, etc.
For ἐ. contrasted in terms with ἔπος see ἔπος 3.

One's work, the work in hand or before one: μὴ ἀμβαλλώμεθα ἐ. Il. 2.436, ἀτελευτήτῳ ἐπὶ ἔργῳ Il. 4.175, ὄφρʼ ἐπὶ ἔργα τράπωνται Il. 23.53. Cf. Il. 2.137, Il. 7.465, Il. 18.473, Il. 19.150, 242: Od. 2.252, Od. 5.243, Od. 9.250 = 310 = 343, Od. 14.195, Od. 17.227, Od. 18.363, Od. 22.479.
Toilsome work, toil, labour: ἐ. ἀεικὲς ἔχοντα Il. 19.133.
A task: ἔργα κʼ ἀεικέα ἐργάζοιο Il. 24.733.
A kind of work or activity, a sphere of action: ἐν πάντεσσʼ ἔργοισι δαήμονα Il. 23.671. Cf. Il. 4.258: ἔργα κάκʼ ἔμμαθεν Od. 17.226. Cf. Od. 8.245, Od. 14.228, Od. 15.320, Od. 18.362, Od. 20.378.
The process or condition of working, work, action: ἀνηνύστῳ ἐπὶ ἔργῳ (with no end to the business) Od. 16.111.
Carrying into effect, action: πλεόνων ἐ. ἄμεινον Il. 12.412. Cf. Il. 9.374.

div.head: α
div.p: With qualifying words: ἐ. Ἄρηος Il. 11.734. Cf. Il. 16.208.

div.head: β
div.p: Without such words: ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἐ. ἐτύχθη Il. 4.470. Cf. Il. 4.539, Il. 12.271, 416: Od. 22.149.– περὶ ἔργα τέτυκτο (in . . .) Il. 17.279: Od. 11.550.

div.head: b
div.p: One's work in war, one's prowess: παρʼ ἔμʼ ἵστασο καὶ ἴδε ἐ. Il. 17.179: Od. 22.233. Cf. Il. 6.522.
In pl., deeds of prowess: ἐπιίστορα ἔργων Od. 21.26.
Work on the land, tillage: ἔρις ἔργοιο Od. 18.366. Cf. Od. 14.222, Od. 18.369.
A piece of work in the arts, a piece of craftsmanship: χαρίεντα ἔργα τελείει Od. 6.234 = Od. 23.161.
A work, occupation, affair: θαλάσσια ἔργα Il. 2.614: Od. 5.67.

div.head: a
div.p: The work, a piece of work, an occupation, proper to women: ἀμφίπολοι ἐπὶ ἔργα τράποντο Il. 3.422, ἀμφιπόλοισι κέλευε ἐ. ἐποίχεσθαι Il. 6.492. Cf. Il. 6.324, 490: = Od. 1.356 = Od. 21.350, Od. 1.358, Od. 4.683, Od. 19.514, Od. 21.352.

div.head: b
div.p: In pl., their various crafts or occupations: ἀμύμονα ἔργα ἰδυίας Il. 9.128. Cf. Il. 9.270, Il. 18.420, Il. 19.245, Il. 23.263, 705: ἔργʼ ἐπίστασθαι Od. 2.117 = Od. 7.111. Cf. Od. 13.289 = Od. 16.158, Od. 15.418, Od. 20.72, Od. 22.422, Od. 24.278.

div.head: c
div.p: In pl., skill in such crafts, craftsmanship: οὐ χερείων ἔργα (in . . .) Il. 1.115. Cf. Il. 9.390, Il. 13.432.

div.head: d
div.p: The materials of their work: ἀκὴν ἔμεναι παρὰ ἔργῳ (by their (your) work) Od. 21.239, 385,

A matter, affair, business, thing: εἰ σοὶ πᾶν ἐ. ὑπείξομαι (in everything) Il. 1.294, λοίγια ἔργα 518, τάδε ἔργα (these troubles) Il. 3.321. Cf. Il. 2.252, Il. 5.429, Il. 6.348, Il. 8.9, Il. 9.228, etc.: ἐν πᾶσι ἔργοισιν Od. 7.52, μὴ ἀμφαδὰ ἔργα γένοιτο Od. 19.391. Cf. Od. 2.280, Od. 3.56, Od. 16.373, Od. 17.78, 274, Od. 19.323.
App. in vague sense thing: χερμάδιον, μέγα ἐ. Il. 5.303, Il. 20.286.
A state of affairs: εἴσιδεν ἐ. ἀεικές Il. 14.13.

div.head: a
div.p: Something made, the work of . . . : πέπλοι ἔργα γυναικῶν Il. 6.289. Cf. Il. 7.444, Il. 19.22: Od. 4.617 = Od. 15.117, Od. 7.97, Od. 10.223, Od. 24.75.
Something due to action, the work of . . . : τόδε ἐ. [ἐστὶν] Ἀθηναίης Od. 16.207.

div.head: b
div.p: A device or representation: τελαμών, ἵνα θέσκελα ἔργα τέτυκτο Od. 11.610.

div.head: c
div.p: A piece of tilled land, a farm or estate: ἀνδρῶν πίονα ἔργα Il. 12.283, ἵκετο ἔργʼ ἀνθρώπων (app. meaning the world of men) Il. 19.131. Cf. Il. 2.751, Il. 5.92, Il. 16.392: πατρώϊα ἔργα Od. 2.22, οὔτε βοῶν οὔτʼ ἀνδρῶν φαίνετο ἔργα (tilled with oxen or by the hand of man) Od. 10.98, [ᾧ] θεὸς ἐ. ἀέξῃ Od. 14.65. Cf. Od. 2.127 = Od. 18.288, Od. 4.318, Od. 6.259, Od. 7.26, Od. 10.147, Od. 14.66, 344, Od. 15.372, 505, Od. 16.140, 144, 314, Od. 24.388.

div.head: ἔργω1,
div.p: 3 sing. aor. ἐέργαθε Il. 5.147. ἔργαθε Il. 11.437.
Acc. sing. masc. aor. pple. pass. ἐρχθέντα Il. 21.282.
Nom. pl. fem. pple. ἐεργμέναι Il. 5.89.
3 pl. plupf. ἐέρχατο Od. 10.241. ἔρχατο Il. 17.354: Od. 9.221, Od. 14.73. (ἀνεέργω, ἀπο-, διεέργω, προεέργω, συν-.)
To ward or keep off: [βέλος] ἀπὸ χροός Il. 4.130.
To ward or keep off from.
With genit.: παιδὸς μυῖαν Il. 4.131. Cf. Il. 17.571.
To keep at a distance, prevent the approach of: τῆλέ με εἴργουσι ψυχαί Il. 23.72.
To keep apart: βόε ζυγὸν οἶον ἀμφὶς ἐέργει Il. 13.706 (i.e. they are as close together as the yoke admits).
To keep off or from contact with something: ἀπὸ χθονὸς ἔεργε Il. 14.349.
To keep (a ship) away, head (her) off: καπνοῦ ἐκτὸς ἔεργε νῆα Od. 12.219.
To separate, sever: ἀπʼ αὐχένος ὦμον Il. 5.147. Cf. Il. 11.437.
To shut up, confine: κλαίοντες ἐέρχατο Od. 10.241. Cf. Od. 9.221, Od. 10.283, Od. 14.73, 411.
To coop up: ἐρχθέντʼ ἐν ποταμῷ Il. 21.282.
To debar from freedom of movement, constrain to movement in a specified direction: ἂψ ἐπὶ νῆας ἔεργεν Il. 16.395.
To pack together: σάκεσσιν ἔρχατο πάντῃ (were formed into, formed, a barrier with their shields) Il. 17.354.
In reference to a dike or embankment, to draw it tight so as to form a continuous barrier in order to confine a river: γέφυραι ἐεργμέναι Il. 5.89.
To form into a fence or containing substance: ἔνθα φρένες ἔρχαται ἀμφὶ κῆρ (contains, surrounds, the heart) Il. 16.481.

To bound: ὅσον ἐκ νηῶν ἀπὸ πύργου τάφρος ἔεργεν Il. 8.213 (app., the space which, measuring along a line drawn (outwards at any point) from the ships, the trench bounded at a distance from the wall, i.e. the space between the wall and the trench).
To skirt, pass along: ἐπʼ ἀριστερὰ λαὸν ἐέργων Il. 12.201 = 219 (see ἀριστερός 2.b).
3 sing. -ε Il. 9.540. From *ἔργω (*ϝέργω) (the fut. and aor. forms written also ἑ-) Fut. ἔρξω Od. 5.360, Od. 11.80.
Acc. sing. masc. pple. ἔρξαντα Il. 5.650: Od. 23.277.
2 sing. pf. ἔοργας (ϝέϝοργας) Il. 3.57, Il. 21.399, Il. 22.347.
With acc. of person affected by the action: εὖ μιν ἕρξαντα Il. 5.650.

To do, perform, accomplish: μυπίʼ ἐσθλά Il. 2.272. Cf. Il. 3.57, Il. 8.356, Il. 9.320, Il. 10.503, Il. 14.261, Il. 15.148, Il. 21.399, Il. 22.347: ἔργα βίαια Od. 2.236, οἷα μενοινᾷς ἔρδειν Od. 22.218. Cf. Od. 1.293, Od. 8.490, Od. 11.80, Od. 14.289, Od. 15.360, Od. 19.92, Od. 22.318, Od. 23.312.
With double acc. of what is done and of the person or thing affected: ὅ με πρότερος κάκʼ ἔοργε Il. 3.351. Cf. Il. 5.175 = Il. 16.424, Il. 9.540: Od. 4.693.
To do or offer (sacrifice): ἑκατόμβας Il. 1.315, Il. 2.306. Cf. Il. 11.707: Od. 7.202, Od. 11.132 = Od. 23.279, Od. 13.350, Od. 23.277.
To ask, inquire, make inquiry: δεύτερον ἐρέεινεν Il. 3.191. Cf. Il. 3.225: Od. 19.42, Od. 24.262.
To ask or inquire about: ἵπποι οὓς ἐρεείνεις Il. 10.558. Cf. Il. 6.145, Il. 21.153: Od. 24.281.
To question (a person): μιν Il. 6.176. Cf. Od. 5.85, Od. 7.31, Od. 11.234, Od. 20.190, Od. 23.365.
With double acc. of person questioned and of what is inquired about: πόσιν ἕκαστα Od. 4.137. Cf. Od. 1.220.
To irritate, provoke to anger: μή μʼ ἐρέθιζε Il. 1.32, Il. 24.560. Cf. Od. 9.494.
In milder sense, to tease, provoke, worry: Ἥρην Il. 4.5. Cf. Il. 5.419: Od. 20.374.
To provoke to fight, try to bring to close quarters Il. 17.658.
To provoke or rouse into making disclosures Od. 19.45.
To keep from peace or rest, trouble: ὀδύναι μʼ ἐρέθουσιν Od. 4.813. Cf. Od. 19.517.
3 sing. aor. mid. ἐρείσατο Il. 5.309, Il. 11.355.
Pple. ἐρεισάμενος Il. 2.109, Il. 8.496, Il. 12.457, Il. 16.736.
3 sing. aor. pass. ἐρείσθη Il. 7.145, Il. 11.144, Il. 12.192.
3 sing. plupf. ἠρήρειστο Il. 3.358, Il. 4.136, Il. 7.252, Il. 11.436.
To press closely, be in close contact with, so that mutual support is afforded: ἀσπὶς ἀσπίδʼ ἔρειδεν Il. 13.131 = Il. 16.215.
To press, strive, carry on a contest.
With σύν, in reference to the dead, to bring together(the lips), compose (the mouth): σὺν στόμʼ ἐρεῖσαι Od. 11.426.
To put one's weight or strength into a blow, thrust, etc.: ἐπὶ δʼ ἔρεισεν Il. 11.235 = Il. 17.48.
With instrumental dat.: ἐρείδοντες βελέεσσιν Il. 16.108.
In pass., of a missile, to force its way, pass: διὰ θώρηκος ἠρήρειστο Il. 3.358 = Il. 4.136 = Il. 7.252 = Il. 11.436.
To cause to lean or stand, lean, prop (against something): πύργῳ ἔπʼ ἀσπίδʼ ἐρείσας Il. 22.97. Cf. Il. 22.112: Od. 8.66 = 473, Od. 22.450.

div.head: a
div.p: To lean or support oneself (upon or with something): τῷ ἐρεισάμενος Il. 2.109, Il. 8.496, ἐρείσατο χειρὶ γαίης (on the ground with his hand) Il. 5.309, Il. 11.355. Cf. Il. 14.38, Il. 19.49, Il. 22.225: Od. 10.170.

div.head: b
div.p: To lean or be set against something so as to afford support: λᾶεξύλου ἑκάτερθεν ἐρηρέδαται Il. 23.329.

div.head: c
div.p: To hang down (on to something), rest (upon it): οὔδεϊ χαῖται ἐρηρέδαται Il. 23.284.

div.head: d
div.p: To lie or be stretched out (upon something): ὕπτιος οὔδει ἐρείσθη Il. 7.145, Il. 11.144, Il. 12.192.

div.head: e
div.p: To stand (against something), be ranged (round about along it): θρόνοι περὶ τοῖχον ἐρηρέδατο Od. 7.95.
In aor., to be rent: ἤρικε κόρυς Il. 17.295.
To pull or throw down: ἐπάλξεις Il. 12.258. Cf. Il. 14.15, Il. 15.356, 361.
Referring to the gloom of the underworld Od. 24.106.
Dark, threatening: αἰγίδα Il. 4.167, λαίλαπι Il. 12.375, Il. 20.51.
To take as food, eat, munch. Of men or horses: λωτόν Il. 2.776, κρῖ Il. 5.196, Il. 8.564: λωτόν Od. 9.97.
Of fishes, to gnaw away: δημόν Il. 21.204.
Of birds, to peck up: πυρόν Od. 19.553.
To ply the oar, row Il. 9.361: Od. 9.490, Od. 11.78, Od. 12.194.
An oar: προέρεσσαν ἐρετμοῖς Il. 1.435: εὐῆρες ἐ. Od. 11.121. Cf. Od. 4.580, Od. 6.269, Od. 8.37, Od. 11.77, Od. 12.171, Od. 13.22, Od. 16.353, etc.
Acc. sing. masc. pple. ἐρυγόντα Il. 20.406.
To roar: ἤρυγεν ὡς ὅτε ταῦρος ἤρυγεν Il. 20.403. Cf. Il. 20.406.
Of the sea Il. 17.265: Od. 5.403, 438. (Or the passages relating to the sea may be taken in a sense sim. to (2), to send forth its spray, break in foam.)
To belch or spew forth: φόνον αἵματος Il. 16.162.
To redden: αἵματι γαῖαν Il. 11.394. Cf. Il. 18.329.
To make search, hunt, quest Il. 18.321.
Of dogs, to follow (the scent): ἴχνιʼ ἐρευνῶντες Od. 19.436.
To furnish with a roof, roof: νηόν Il. 1.39 (app. referring to a temporary structure of branches),
Uninhabited, desolate: νῆσον Od. 3.270. Cf. Od. 12.351.
Abandoned, forsaken, left to one's own devices: τὰ δʼ ἐρῆμα φοβεῖται Il. 5.140.
3 sing. pa. iterative ἐρητύσασκε Il. 2.189, Il. 11.567.
To hold back, hold in check, check, restrain, curb: φῶτα ἕκαστον Il. 2.164, 180. Cf. Il. 1.192, Il. 2.75, 189, Il. 9.462, 635, Il. 11.567, Il. 13.280, Il. 18.503: Od. 9.493 = Od. 10.442, Od. 16.43.
To get under control, bring back to discipline: κήρυκές σφεας Il. 2.97, ἐρήτυθεν καθʼ ἕδρας (settled themselves) 99, 211.

div.head: a
div.p: To check oneself, come to a stand, stop: παρὰ νηυσὶν ἐρητύοντο Il. 8.345, Il. 15.367. Cf. Il. 15.3.

div.head: b
div.p: To hold back from going, remain in a specified place: ἐρητύοντο αὖθι Od. 3.155.

p.gloss: With high-arched or with powerful neck.

div.p: Epithet of Zeus: Ζηνὸς ἐριβρεμέτεω Il. 13.624.
Having rich clods, fertile, having fertile lands: φθίῃ Il. 1.155. Cf. Il. 2.841, Il. 3.74, Il. 5.44, Il. 13.793, Il. 17.172, etc.: Od. 13.235.
With thundering hooves: πόδες ἵππων Il. 11.152.
Of seashores, on which the sea roars, sounding Il. 20.50.
Echoing, resounding: αἰθούσης Il. 24.323: Od. 3.493 = Od. 15.146 = 191. Cf. Od. 3.399 = Od. 7.345, Od. 20.176, 189.
To quarrel, wrangle, dispute, contend Il. 1.574, Il. 2.342: Od. 18.403.
To contend, maintain one's position: οὐ δυνήσεται ἐριδαινέμεν οἶος Od. 1.79.
With dat.: εὖρός τε νότος τʼ ἀλλήλοιιν Il. 16.765.
To compete or contend with a person.
In mid.: ἀργαλέον ποσσὶν ἐριδήσασθαι Ἀχαιοῖς (for the Achaeans to contend (sc. with Odysseus) in the race) Il. 23.792.
To be rivals, vie with one another Od. 2.206.
To engage in rivalry or competition Od. 21.310.
3 sing. opt. ἐρίσειε Od. 23.126. ἐρίσσειε Il. 3.223: Od. 15.321, Od. 19.286.
Nom. dual mase. pple. ἐρίσαντε Il. 1.6.
3 sing. aor. subj. mid. ἐρίσσεται Od. 4.80.
To be at variance, quarrel, wrangle, dispute: διαστήτην ἐρίσαντε (having conceived offence) Il. 1.6, περὶ ἴσης Il. 12.423.
With dat.: βασιλεῦσιν Il. 2.214, 247, κείνῳ ἐρίσαντες Il. 13.109.
With dat. and infin.: ἀλλήλοιϊν μαχέσσασθαι Od. 18.38.
To engage in rivalry or competition: περὶ μύθων Il. 15.284.
To rival, compete with, vie with, a person: Νέστωρ οἶος ἔριζεν Il. 2.555. Cf. Od. 19.286.
To match oneself with, stand up to in fight.
With dat. of that in which one vies with a person: ποσίν Il. 13.325.
With double dat.: δρηστοσύνῃ οὐκ ἄν μοι ἐρίσσειεν ἄλλος Od. 15.321.
With dat. and acc.: εἰ Ἀφροδίτῃ κάλλος ἐρίζοι (in . . .) Il. 9.389. Cf. Od. 5.213.

Epithet of ἑταῖρος, ἑταῖροι (and in Od. 1.346, Od. 8.62, 471 of ἀοιδός), worthy, faithful, trusty or the like Il. 3.47, 378, Il. 4.266, Il. 8.332 = Il. 13.421, Il. 16.363, Il. 23.6: Od. 1.346, Od. 8.62 = 471, Od. 9.100, 172, 193, 555, Od. 10.387, 405, 408, 471, Od. 12.199, 397 (here merely conventional) = Od. 14.249, Od. 14.259 = Od. 17.428, Od. 19.273.
Showing good growth, flourishing: ἀλωάων ἐριθηλέων Il. 5.90, μυρίκης ὄζους Il. 10.467, ἔρνος ἐλαίης Il. 17.53.

An epithet of general commendation, glorious, radiant, splendid, illustrious, sumptuous, or the like: θεῶν δῶρα Il. 3.65, Il. 20.265, ἥβης Il. 11.225, Λητοῦς Il. 14.327, δαῖτα Il. 24.802: Od. 3.66 = Od. 20.280, Od. 10.182, Od. 13.26, γαίης ἐρικυδέος υἱόν Od. 11.576, θεῶν τέκνα 631.
Epithet of oxen Il. 20.497, Il. 23.775: Od. 15.235.
The wild fig-tree: ἐρινεὸν τάμνε νέους ὄρπηκας (double acc. of whole and part) Il. 21.37. Cf. Od. 12.103, 432.
A particular tree referred to as a landmark: λαὸν στῆσον παρʼ ἐρινεόν Il. 6.433. Cf. Il. 11.167, Il. 22.145.

div.head: a
div.p: As executor (in pl. as executors) of a parental curse Il. 9.454, 571: Od. 2.135, Od. 11.280.

div.head: b
div.p: As protecting the rights of an elder brother: πρεσβυτέροισιν Ἐρινύες αἰὲν ἕπονται Il. 15.204.

div.head: c
div.p: As protecting beggars: πτωχῶν Ἐρινύες Od. 17.475.–

div.head: d
div.p: As sending ἄτη: ἄτης, τήν οἱ ἐπὶ φρεσὶ θῆκʼ Ἐρινύς Od. 15.234. Cf. Il. 19.87.

div.head: e
div.p: Invoked as guarding the sanctity of an oath Il. 19.259.

div.head: f
div.p: App. regarded mainly or merely as maleficent: [πανδαρέου] κούρας ἔδοσαν Ἐρινύσιν ἀμφιπολεύειν Od. 20.78.
Upholding the laws ordering the physical universe: Ἐρινύες ἔσχεθον αὐδὴν [ἵππου] Il. 19.418.
App., with the idea of personality lost, meaning merely curses: οὕτω κεν τῆς μητρὸς ἐρινύας ἐξαποτίνοις Il. 21.412.
= ἐριούνης. Epithet or a name of Hermes Il. 20.72, Il. 24.360, 440, 457, 679.

Strife, contention, wrangling: ἔριδι ξυνέηκε μάχεσθαι (in . . . ) Il. 1.8, λῆγʼ ἔριδος 210, εἵνεκʼ ἐμῆς ἔριδος (in my quarrel) Il. 3.100. Cf. Il. 1.177 = Il. 5.891, Il. 1.319, Il. 9.257, Il. 18.107, Il. 19.58, 64, Il. 20.253, Il. 23.490: Od. 3.136, 161, Od. 16.292 = Od. 19.11, Od. 18.13, Od. 20.267.
In pl., instances of this, quarrels, wranglings: ἔριδας καὶ νείκεα Il. 2.376. Cf. Il. 20.251.
The strife of battle: ἔριδος καὶ ἀϋτῆς Il. 5.732. Cf. Il. 5.861, Il. 7.210, Il. 11.529, Il. 13.358, Il. 14.389, etc.
Of the hostile action of Hephaestus against Xanthus Il. 21.359.
Of the hostile action of Xanthus against Achilles: τί μοι ἔριδος; (quasi- partitive genit.; what have I to do with . . . ?) Il. 21.360.
Of the fighting of the cranes and the Pygmies Il. 3.7.

Rivalry, competition: ἐξ ἔριδος μάχεσθαι (in pure rivalry or combativeness, making a match of it) Il. 7.111. Cf. Il. 7.301: ἔριδα προφέρουσαι Od. 6.92, ἔρις ἔργοιο (a match) Od. 18.366. Cf. Od. 4.343 = Od. 17.134, Od. 8.210.
Epithet of Zeus Il. 13.54, Il. 19.355, Il. 21.184: Od. 8.289.
An occasion of quarrel or strife Il. 4.38.
Of wine, the product of rich grapes, full-bodied Od. 9.111 = 358.
Epithet of the aegis, awe-inspiring Il. 2.447, Il. 15.361.
Of gold, precious, highly prized Il. 9.126 = 268.
Having his altar in the ἕρκος (see ἕρκος 2). Of Zeus Od. 22.335.

div.head: a
div.p: A fence or enclosing wall: ἕρκεα ἀλωάων Il. 5.90. Cf. Il. 18.564: ἕρκεος αὐλῆς Od. 22.442 = 459. Cf. Od. 7.113, Od. 24.224.–ἕρκος ὀδόντων, the(double) row formed by the teeth (as we should say, the lips or the mouth): ἐπεί κε [ψυχὴ] ἀμείψεται ἑ. ὀδόντων Il. 9.409, ποῖόν σε ἔπος φύγεν ἑ. ὀδόντων; Il. 4.350 = Il. 14.83: Od. 1.64 = Od. 5.22 = Od. 19.492 = Od. 23.70, Od. 3.230, Od. 21.168. Cf. Od. 10.328.

div.head: b
div.p: Fig., of a person or persons: ἑ. πολέμοιο (against . . . ) Il. 1.284, ἑ. Ἀχαιῶν (their defence) Il. 3.229, Il. 6.5, Il. 7.211, ἑ. ἔμεν πολέμοιο (to stem the tide of war) Il. 4.299.
Sim. of a piece of armour, etc.: ἑ. ἀκόντων Il. 4.137, Il. 15.646. Cf. Il. 5.316.
So also: φράξαντο νῆας ἕρκεϊ χαλκείῳ (with a ring of steel) Il. 15.567.
The enclosed space in which a house stands = (or at any rate including) the αὐλή. In reference to the κλισίη of Achilles Il. 16.231 = (in reference to Priam's palace) Od. 24.306.
To the house of Odysseus Od. 23.190.

So in pl. in reference to this house (perh. with a vague notion of separate parts making up the space): αἴθουσαί τε καὶ ἕρκεα καὶ δόμοι Od. 8.57. Cf. Od. 16.341 = Od. 17.604, Od. 20.164, Od. 21.238 = 384 (here app. referring to the premises generally).
A shore or prop put under a ship drawn up on shore in order to keep her upright: ὑφʼ ἕρματα τάνυσσαν Il. 1.486. Cf. Il. 2.154.
Fig., of persons: ἕρμα πόληος Il. 16.549: Od. 23.121 (a or the buttress or stay).
App. with transference of notion from upholding to causing: ἕρμʼ ὀδυνάων Il. 4.117.
A young tree, a sapling Il. 17.53, Il. 18.56 = 437: Od. 6.163, Od. 14.175.
Love, desire: ἔρως με φρένας ἀμφεκάλυψεν Il. 3.442. Cf. Il. 14.294, 315: Od. 18.212.
Desire, inclination, or appetite (for something): μολπῆς καὶ ὀρχηθμοῖο Il. 13.638, γόου Il. 24.227.
Having the power of movement: ὅσσʼ ἐπὶ γαῖαν ἑρπετὰ γίγνονται Od. 4.418.
Of a man broken by grief or suffering, to move slowly and heavily: ἑρπύζων παρὰ πυρκαϊήν Il. 23.225. Cf. Od. 1.193, Od. 13.220.
To exercise the power of movement proper to a living being, to move: ὅσσα τε γαῖαν ἔπι πνείει τε καὶ ἕρπει Il. 17.447: = Od. 18.131. Cf. Od. 12.395, Od. 17.158.

To go, come, move (connoting mischance, difficulty or the like): ἐνθάδε ἔρρων (on this ill-omened journey, this fool's
quest) Il. 8.239, Il. 9.364: οἴῳ ἔρροντι (wandering about in desperation) Od. 4.367.
Of the movement of the halting Hephaestus Il. 18.421.

In imp., be off, let him be off, take yourself off, let him take himself off (more or less in way of imprecation) Il. 8.164, Il. 9.377 (let him go his own way to bane), Il. 20.349 (let him go for what I care), Il. 22.498, Il. 23.440 (go your own mad way), Il. 24.239: Od. 5.139 (let him go if he chooses), Od. 10.72, 75.
-ης, ἡ (ϝέρση). Except in Od. 9.222 with prothetic ἐ, ἐἐρση.
In pl., drops of water from a cloud, rain-drops: ὑψόθεν ἧκεν ἐέρσας Il. 11.53. Cf. Il. 14.351.
A young lamb or kid newly yeaned Od. 9.222.
Of a corpse, fresh, with the look of health Il. 24.419, 757.
acc. sing. masc. aor. pple. ἐρεύγομαι.
To make red, redden: ἐρυθαίνετο γαῖα Il. 10.484. Cf. Il. 21.21.
To hold in restraint, detain Od. 1.199.
To restrain, keep from going: ἐρύκανεν ἑταίρους Od. 10.429.
Infin. ἐρυκακέειν Il. 5.262: Od. 3.144, Od. 11.105, Od. 20.313. (ἀπ-, κατ-.)

To restrain from doing or continuing to do something, to curb, keep or hold back, check: μηδέ μʼ ἔρυκε μάχης (from . . . ) Il. 18.126. Cf. Il. 8.206, Il. 21.384, Il. 24.156 = 185: ἕτερός με θυμὸς ἔρυκεν Od. 9.302. Cf. Od. 11.105, Od. 14.283, Od. 20.313, Od. 21.227.
To restrain from action, keep inactive: λαόν Il. 24.658.

To confine, shut up, keep from egress or escape, detain: πόντος, ὃ πολέας ἐρύκει Il. 21.59. Cf. Il. 16.369, Il. 21.62, 63: ἔρυξον ἐνὶ μεγάροισι γυναῖκας Od. 19.16. Cf. Od. 1.14, Od. 4.466, Od. 8.317, Od. 9.29.
In mid.: ἐν νήσῳ ἐρύκεαι (let yourself be . . .) Od. 4.373.
To detain or keep with one in hospitality or in a friendly way: ξείνισʼ ἐείκοσιν ἤματʼ ἐρύξας Il. 6.217. Cf. Od. 4.594, 599, Od. 7.315, Od. 15.68, Od. 16.82, Od. 17.515.
Sim., in pass., to be kept or looked after in an indicated place: οὐδʼ αὐτὸς ἐρύκεσθαι μενεαίνω Od. 17.17.
to separate or lie between two bodies of men: ὀλίγος χῶρος ἐρύκει Il. 10.161.
In reference to troops, to rally, get together: λαὸν ἐρυκάκετε Il. 6.80. Cf. Il. 13.751.
To keep assembled or in an indicated place: λαόν Il. 23.258: Od. 3.144.
In reference to horses, etc., to pull up, rein in Il. 3.113, Il. 10.527.
To hold in, keep in hand Il. 11.48 = Il. 12.85, Il. 12.76.
To hold, stand by the heads of Il. 24.470.
To stop a person in his career or course: δουρὶ βαλὼν ἠρύκακεν Il. 20.458.
In mid., to check oneself in one's course: μὴ ἐρύκεσθον Il. 23.443.
To prevent the passage or progress of, check, stop: τάφρον, ἥ χʼ ἵππον ἐρυκάκοι Il. 7.342. Cf. Il. 8.178, Il. 12.465, Il. 15.297, Il. 21.7: Od. 22.138.
To debar from approach, keep aloof: τρεῖς κέ μιν μῆνας οἶκος ἐρύκοι Od. 17.408.

p.gloss: To ward off, keep off, guard from,

div.p: [χαλκὸν] ἐρύκακε τρυφάλεια Il. 11.352. Cf. Il. 20.268 = Il. 21.165, Il. 21.594.
With dat.: κακόν, τό οἱ οὔ τις ἐρύκακεν Il. 15.450 = Il. 17.292. Cf. Od. 5.166.
A means of protection, a defence or guard: χροός Il. 4.137.
Pres. pple. ἐρύων, -οντος Il. 4.467, 492, Il. 15.464, Il. 22.493.
3 pl. fut. ἐρύουσι Il. 11.454, Il. 15.351, Il. 22.67.
3 sing. aor. εἴρυσε (ἐϝέρυσε) Il. 16.863: Od. 2.389. εἴρυσσε Il. 3.373, Il. 18.165: Od. 8.85. ἔρυσε Il. 13.598, Il. 17.581.
Pple. ἐρύσας Il. 23.21, Il. 24.16: Od. 10.303. ἐρύσσας Od. 9.99.
Infin. ἐρύσαι Il. 17.419: Od. 14.134, Od. 22.176. ἐρύσσαι Il. 8.23, Il. 21.175.
3 sing. εἰρύσσατο Il. 22.306: Od. 22.79. ἐρύσσατο Il. 4.530, Il. 21.200, Il. 22.367: Od. 19.481.
Infin. ἐρύσασθαι Il. 22.351. ἐρύσσασθαι Il. 18.174, Il. 21.176: Od. 21.125.
Pass. 3 pl. pf. εἰρύ̄αται (ϝεϝερυ-) Il. 14.75. εἰρύ̆αται Il. 4.248: Od. 6.265.
3 pl. plupf. εἰρύ̄ατο Il. 14.30, Il. 15.654. εἴρυντο Il. 18.69.
Nom. pl. fem. pple. εἰρῡμέναι Il. 13.682.
To drag, haul, pull: κοῖλον δόρυ ἐρύσαντας ἐπʼ ἄκρης Od. 8.508. Cf. Il. 3.373, Il. 24.16: Od. 9.99, Od. 12.14, Od. 17.479, Od. 22.187.
Of dragging the body of a foe from the fight: νεκρὸν ἐρύοντα ἰδών Il. 4.467. Cf. Il. 4.492, Il. 16.781, Il. 17.230, 235, 287, 396, 419, Il. 18.165, 540, Il. 23.21.
Of so dragging the body of a friend Il. 5.573, Il. 17.581, 635 = 713, Il. 18.232.
To draw or pull in a specified direction: ἐξ ὤμοιο ὀϊστόν Il. 5.110. Cf. Il. 8.21, 23, 24, Il. 13.598, Il. 16.863, Il. 21.175: Od. 10.303.
To draw (a person) away, cause (him) to quit something.
In mid.: οὐκ ἂν τόνδʼ ἄνδρα μάχης ἐρύσαιο; (from the . . .) Il. 5.456.
To draw or pull (a person) from a specified position: ἀφʼ ἵππων ὦσε χειρὶ ἐρύσασα Il. 5.836.
